jobs.title: Ingénieur des ventes – Machines industrielles
jobs.description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Ingénieur des ventes -- Machines industrielles (H/F) --- Ingénieur des ventes -- Machines industrielles (H/F) ====================================================== \*\*Merci de consulter cette annonce.\*\* Notre cabinet de recrutement \*\*FOKUS Talent\*\* est spécialisé dans les secteurs high\\-tech. Nous accompagnons une centaine de conseils d'administration, dirigeants et responsables RH en Suisse et à l'international pour des recrutements clés. Derrière cette annonce, il y a une entreprise qui recherche vos compétences et votre potentiel. À la fin du processus, vous signerez un \*\*CDI directement avec l'entreprise\*\* (FOKUS Talent ne fait pas de consulting ni de mise à disposition). Tout au long du processus de recrutement, nous vous transmettons des informations détaillées sur la structure, en toute transparence et en toute confidentialité. Vos données ne sont jamais transmises sans votre accord préalable ni sans que vous connaissiez le nom de votre futur employeur. \*\*À ce stade, nous pouvons vous dire que...\*\* Cette entreprise industrielle basée dans le canton du Vaud conçoit et développe des \*\*équipements de production automatisés destinés à une clientèle internationale\*\*. Afin de poursuivre son développement sur plusieurs marchés stratégiques, elle recherche aujourd'hui un·e \*\*Ingénieur des ventes\*\* capable de prendre en charge le développement commercial d'une zone géographique et d'accompagner des clients industriels dans leurs projets d'investissement. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où la vente nécessite de comprendre les enjeux industriels du client, de construire une solution avec les équipes techniques et de piloter des cycles commerciaux pouvant impliquer plusieurs interlocuteurs et décideurs. \*\*Challenges\*\* Votre objectif sera de développer durablement votre territoire en combinant \*\*prospection, gestion de comptes existants et développement d'un réseau international de partenaires\*\*. Vous devrez identifier de nouveaux projets industriels, comprendre les besoins et contraintes des utilisateurs, puis coordonner les différentes expertises internes afin de construire une proposition technique et commerciale pertinente. Le challenge consiste également à transformer des cycles de vente complexes en projets rentables, tout en développant une relation de confiance à long terme avec les clients. \*\*Vos missions\*\* \*\*Développement commercial international\*\* \* Prendre en charge le développement des ventes sur les marchés et territoires qui vous seront confiés. \* Identifier de nouvelles entreprises susceptibles d'investir dans les technologies proposées. \* Construire une démarche de prospection adaptée aux spécificités de chaque marché. \* Développer de nouvelles opportunités auprès de clients industriels et les accompagner jusqu'à la décision d'investissement. \* Négocier les conditions commerciales et conduire les discussions jusqu'à la conclusion des contrats. \*\*Gestion \\\& développement des comptes\*\* \* Entretenir une relation régulière avec les clients existants et identifier leurs futurs besoins. \* Développer le potentiel commercial des comptes déjà actifs. \* Comprendre les projets d'investissement, contraintes de production et objectifs industriels de vos interlocuteurs. \* Construire une relation commerciale durable avec les différents décideurs impliqués. \*\*Solutions technico\\-commerciales\*\* \* Analyser les besoins clients afin de proposer une configuration adaptée à leur environnement de production. \* Préparer et coordonner les propositions commerciales et techniques avec les spécialistes internes. \* Faire le lien entre le marché et les départements ingénierie, développement et service. \* Participer aux réflexions concernant l'évolution des solutions et transmettre de manière structurée les attentes observées sur le terrain. \*\*Réseau \\\& représentation internationale\*\* \* Développer et animer un réseau de partenaires commerciaux sur les marchés concernés. \* Identifier de nouvelles collaborations permettant d'accroître la présence de l'entreprise à l'international. \* Représenter la société auprès des clients, partenaires et acteurs de votre secteur. \* Participer à des salons professionnels et événements industriels internationaux. \* Effectuer régulièrement des déplacements afin de rencontrer les clients et développer les marchés directement sur le terrain. ### Requirements \*\*Profil recherché\*\* \* Formation technique supérieure dans les domaines de la \*\*mécanique, mécatronique, ingénierie industrielle\*\* ou parcours jugé équivalent. \* Expérience d'au moins \*\*5 ans dans la commercialisation de solutions ou équipements techniques B2B\*\*. \* Une expérience dans la vente de \*\*machines, lignes de production, équipements automatisés ou biens d'investissement industriels\*\* constitue un réel avantage. \* Capacité à comprendre un besoin industriel et à échanger avec des interlocuteurs techniques comme avec des décideurs commerciaux. \* Expérience des cycles de vente impliquant prospection, élaboration d'offres, négociation et conclusion de contrats. \* Très bonnes capacités relationnelles et aptitude à développer des partenariats sur le long terme. \* Autonomie, persévérance et capacité à organiser efficacement votre activité commerciale. \* \*\*Allemand langue maternelle\*\*, avec une bonne maîtrise du \*\*français et de l'anglais\*\*. Toute langue supplémentaire constitue un avantage. \* Aisance dans un contexte international et multiculturel. \* Disponibilité pour voyager régulièrement à l'étranger, représentant environ \*\*30 à 50 % du temps de travail\*\*. \*\*Ce que vous trouverez ici\*\* \* Une fonction commerciale internationale avec une réelle autonomie sur votre territoire. \* Des solutions industrielles à forte composante technique nécessitant une véritable approche de vente conseil. \* Des contacts directs avec des entreprises et décideurs industriels à travers différents marchés internationaux. \* Une collaboration quotidienne avec des équipes techniques, ingénierie, service et développement. \* La possibilité de suivre vos opportunités depuis l'identification du besoin jusqu'à la concrétisation du projet. \* Un rôle permettant d'avoir une influence directe sur le développement commercial et la présence internationale de l'entreprise. \*\*Processus de recrutement\*\* Veuillez noter que seuls les candidats titulaires d'un \*\*passeport suisse ou européen\*\* peuvent être pris en compte pour ce poste. Merci de postuler via notre site carrière. Si votre profil correspond, nous vous contacterons pour un échange confidentiel. En cas de souci technique, écrivez\\-nous à \*\*jobs @ fokustalent . ch\*\* \*\*Cooptation\*\* Vous connaissez un profil qui pourrait correspondre à ce poste ? Recommandez\\-le et bénéficiez de notre programme de parrainage. Une prime est versée pour chaque embauche issue de vos recommandations. !\[FOKUS Talent Sàrl\]( ) \* FOKUS Talent Sàrl avenue de la Gare 10 1003 Lausanne \* \[ \](\< \>) jpid5a05542jm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

jobs.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

 

About the Engineering team

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

 

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5, that looks like this.

 
 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

 

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 5 we'll also look for

  • Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

  • Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

  • Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

 

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Account Executive (Enterprise)
jobs.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Every large group in Europe has bought an AI assistant, or is buying one this year. The next decision is harder: how their teams' own work runs on agents, across their own systems, governed, on top of what they already pay for. That is what Dust sells, and this role owns that decision inside a handful of France's largest groups.

You will be one of our first Strategic Account Executives. We are looking for people who have been at the top of every team they have joined, wherever they started.

The Role

  • 5 to 8 named groups, 5,000+ employees, mostly headquartered in France. You own each relationship globally, across subsidiaries and countries.

  • Some are already customers. They started with one team and grow as more teams build their own agents. Their renewals are where your account grows, and you run them.

  • The others you open. We go in through the executive who owns the group's AI programme, before any tender is written. Our founders and executives work your accounts with you, and so do the consulting firms that run these programmes.

  • Deals of €300K to €1M+ a year, decided by the executive committee, with IT, security, procurement and the business in the room.

  • You run the deal team: solutions engineers, customer success, partners and founders, brought in when you decide.

  • You write the playbook. How Dust sells to large groups is being built now, by the people in this seat.

What success looks like

  • 90 days: an account plan for each group, the owner of the AI programme identified in all of them, and a first executive meeting held in at least half.

  • 12 months: a first group-level deal signed, and one existing account growing across new teams.

Who we are looking for

  • You have been at or near the top of every team you joined. Tell us your rank in each role, and where you started. We care more about how far you have come than about the logos on the way.

  • You have opened large accounts yourself, without a big brand or an inherited list doing the work.

  • You have led a deal decided at executive level, with procurement and legal involved, and you can walk us through every step of it.

  • You have grown an account after the first deal, and you think in what an account is worth in three years.

  • You use AI in your own work. If you have built an agent, show us.

  • Fluent French and English. Based in Paris or moving here, with regular travel in France and Europe.

We do not screen on years of experience or on the size of your last employer. If you have been the best at what you did and want a bigger game, apply.

What is hard

  • Our brand is smaller than the labs'. You will win on what Dust does next to the assistant a group already chose, not on our name.

  • Large groups move slowly and decide at the top. A unit that loves the product does not make a group deal; you will learn to find the person who does.

  • The playbook is unfinished. You will be writing it while you use it.

What you get

  • OTE €180k OTE 50/50 split, uncapped accelerators, and a significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed company.

  • Founders on your accounts, a small team that decides fast, and room to lead as the Strategic team grows. We are not promising a title; we will look here first when we need one.

  • Health cover, relocation support, Paris office, regular trips to San Francisco.

How we hire

A call with Talent, a deep dive on your largest deals with the hiring manager, a live executive meeting role-play, then a half-day where you present an account plan for a group of your choice, and a conversation with a founder. We decide within [2–3] weeks of your first call.

In your application, tell us your rank on your team in each of your last roles, and one deal you are proud of.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

jobs.title: Elektriker (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Chipindustrie – von Anfang an!

Deine Rolle bei Black Semiconductor

Bei Black Semiconductor entwickeln wir eine neue Generation der Halbleitertechnologie. Mit unserer ersten Produktionsanlage FabOne in Aachen schaffen wir die Grundlage für die Chipfertigung der Zukunft.

Dafür suchen wir dich! Als Elektriker*in wirst du Teil unseres Facility-Teams und unterstützt den Aufbau, die Inbetriebnahme und den Betrieb der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau, Installation und Inbetriebnahme der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage.

  • Wartung, Prüfung und Instandhaltung elektrischer Anlagen und Niederspannungssysteme.

  • Fehlersuche und Störungsbehebung an elektrischen Installationen und Steuerstromkreisen.

  • Lesen und Interpretieren von Stromlauf-, Schalt- und Verdrahtungsplänen.

  • Mitarbeit bei der Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung unserer Gebäudeautomation (FMCS), einschließlich Steuerungs- und Visualisierungssystemen.

  • Koordination und Unterstützung externer Elektrofachfirmen sowie Sicherstellung einer fachgerechten und sicheren Ausführung.

  • Unterstützung bei elektrischen Prüfungen, technischer Dokumentation und Materialbeschaffung.

Das bringst du mit

jobs.title: Field CISO
jobs.description:
Onwards Together!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

Our Team's Vision:

Illumio is the breach containment company. Built on Zero Trust principles, the Illumio platform combines real-time visibility with segmentation and AI-powered detection and response, helping organizations stop the spread of breaches and ransomware across hybrid, multi-cloud, and on-premises environments before they become disasters. Illumio Segmentation contains attackers by stopping lateral movement across the enterprise, and Illumio Insights delivers AI-driven visibility and detection across hybrid cloud environments.

Illumio was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Microsegmentation Solutions, Q3 2026, earning the highest scores in current offering and strategy of any vendor evaluated, and is recognized as a Customers’ Choice in Gartner Peer Insights for Network Security – Microsegmentation. Global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, energy and utilities, government, manufacturing, retail, and telecommunications trust Illumio to reduce cyber risk and build resilience. For more information, visit illumio.com.

Our Values

Our values reflect how we work together in practice — not just what we aspire to. They show up in everyday decisions, how we collaborate across teams, and how we treat each other while building and delivering our work. If these values resonate with you, you’ll likely feel at home here.

• Bring Your Best: We hold ourselves to a standard of excellence for our customers and each other, regardless of circumstance.

• Build Trust: We act with integrity, transparency, and follow-through, earning trust in every interaction.

• Seek Truth: We pursue facts over assumptions, stay curious, and remain open to being wrong.

• Onwards Together: We move forward as one team, supporting each other through challenges and wins alike.

• Leverage Differences: We treat diverse perspectives and backgrounds as a source of strength and better decisions.

As Field CISO & Principal Architect, this person is Illumio’s most credible external voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment — engaging CISOs and CTOs at strategic accounts as a peer, shaping the category narrative with industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms), and representing the company at industry events. This person also personally owns the technical backbone of pre-sales for the category: the Use Case Map, demo environments, POC/POV frameworks, and reference architectures that the rest of the global SE team (AMS, EMEA, APAC) builds on.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Field Leadership & Evangelism

• Serve as Illumio’s foremost executive voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment, in the field and in public — conferences, webinars, analyst briefings, and published content.

• Build and maintain analyst relationships (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms) to shape how the category is defined and evaluated in the market.

• Engage CISO- and CTO-level stakeholders directly on the most strategic opportunities, drawing on firsthand operating experience to act as a peer and trusted advisor alongside regional SE leads and AEs.

• Partner with Sales and GTM leadership to shape go-to-market and revenue acceleration strategy.

• Partner with Product Marketing and Product Management to shape positioning, messaging, and roadmap priorities, informed directly by field and firsthand operator signal.

Technical Architecture & Enablement Ownership

• Own and continuously evolve the Use Case Map, Demo Runbook, and reference architectures used across the global SE organization.

• Personally design and build flagship demo environments and POC/POV frameworks, including integration patterns and success-criteria templates.

• Partner directly with product engineering to translate roadmap into sellable, demoable capability, and drive pre-sales enablement to sell-ready status and beyond.

• Maintain deep, current hands-on fluency with the Illumio platform — including segmentation, hybrid cloud detection and response, and broader Zero Trust architecture concepts.

Enterprise Pre-Sales & POC Execution

• Lead or co-lead the most strategic and complex opportunities globally, engaging directly alongside AMS, EMEA, and APAC SE teams.

• Architect and execute high-stakes POCs/POVs, including technical prerequisites, integration scoping, success-criteria definition, and executive readout.

• Act as the final technical and executive escalation point for deals across regions, ensuring a consistent, credible narrative in front of customers.

Team Enablement & Capability Building

• Design and deliver training curriculum and certification paths for the global SE team.

• Build battlecards, FAQs, and RFP response libraries, keeping the team current against an evolving competitive landscape.

• Mentor SE Leads and SEs on segmentation and breach containment concepts, positioning, and objection handling — bringing an operator’s perspective on how real security teams evaluate and adopt these solutions.

Product & Market Feedback Loop

• Serve as a structured, credible voice of the field back to Product Management on roadmap priorities, feature gaps, and competitive intelligence.

• Track and analyze the competitive landscape across microsegmentation, Zero Trust, and cloud detection and response, including new entrants and adjacent incumbents extending into the space.

Required Qualifications

• Prior experience as a CISO, Deputy CISO, or senior security executive (VP/Director of Information Security) is required — this role is intentionally sourced from the CISO community to bring firsthand business, technical, and operational credibility to the field.

• 10+ years of experience leading enterprise security programs, with direct, hands-on exposure to network segmentation, Zero Trust architecture, incident response and breach containment, or cloud security.

• Demonstrated ability to speak credibly to both engineering and executive/board audiences — translating technical risk into business terms and back again.

• Demonstrated track record as an external-facing voice: conference speaking, analyst engagement, published thought leadership, or peer-community leadership (e.g., CISO forums, ISACs).

• Proven hands-on architecture and build capability — this is not a strategy-only role; the person must be able to personally build and demo complex technical environments.

• Demonstrated experience engaging CISO- and CTO-level stakeholders, ideally as a former peer, on strategic, multi-stakeholder decisions.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to move fluidly between deep technical detail and executive narrative.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

• Willingness and ability to travel 30–50% for customer, analyst, and industry engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior title of CISO, Deputy CISO, Field CISO, or VP/Director of Information Security at an enterprise or mid-market organization.

• Direct operational experience running a segmentation, Zero Trust, or breach containment program.

• Experience with microsegmentation, CNAPP, cloud security posture management, or hybrid cloud detection and response tooling.

• Existing relationships with analyst firms (Gartner, Forrester, and others) covering network security, Zero Trust, or security operations.

• Experience integrating or building go-to-market plans around a new or acquired product line.

• Published thought leadership — blogs, whitepapers, podcasts, or conference talks — on breach containment, Zero Trust, or cyber resilience.

Our Commitment:

Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions drives our success and makes us stronger together. We are dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse culture and emphasizing inclusion and belonging.

jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Als (Senior) Sales Manager (w/m/d) bekommst du die Chance, aktiv zum Erfolg und Wachstum unseres Unternehmens beizutragen. Du hast die Möglichkeit, dein Gehalt durch deine starke Leistung und Motivation flexibel zu gestalten.

 

Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Proaktive Kundengewinnung: Du begeisterst neue Kund:innen im Segment der vermögenden Privatkundschaft und positionierst LIQID als starken, vertrauenswürdigen Partner im digitalen Wealth Management.

  • Qualifizierte Ansprache: Auf Basis hochwertiger Leads nimmst du proaktiv Kontakt zu Interessent:innen auf, führst strukturierte Erst- und Folgegespräche und baust so von Beginn an eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung auf.

  • Onboarding & Übergabe: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss sorgst du für einen reibungslosen Übergang der gewonnenen Kund:innen an unser Relationship-Management-Team.

  • Team- & Marktfeedback: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Teamlead Sales und Kolleg:innen zusammen, teilst aktiv Feedback zu Kundenbedürfnissen, Markttrends und Materialien und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um unsere Vertriebsaktivitäten weiterzuentwickeln.

  • CRM & Nachverfolgung: Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten strukturiert und transparent in unserem CRM-System und trägst so zu einer effektiven Nachverfolgung und Steuerung des Vertriebs bei.

Das bringst du mit

Background:

  • Du hast ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium abgeschlossen oder eine Ausbildung in der Finanzbranche gemacht, zum Beispiel als Bankkaufmann/-frau, Investmentkaufmann/-frau oder Versicherungskaufmann/-frau.

  • Außerdem bringst du erste Erfahrung im aktiven Vertrieb von Finanzprodukten mit, idealerweise in der Finanzanlagenvermittlung, Vermögensverwaltung oder im (Private) Banking.

  • Du weißt also genau, wie man anspruchsvolle Kund:innen abholt und professionell informiert.

Skills & Qualifikationen:

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Kapitalmärkte und Anlageprodukte und kannst komplexe Inhalte verständlich und überzeugend vermitteln.

  • Mit deiner Akquisitions- und Abschlussstärke sowie deinem professionellen Auftreten gewinnst du schnell das Vertrauen neuer Kund:innen.

  • Kommunikation ist deine Stärke; klar, empathisch und auf Augenhöhe.

  • Außerdem bist du sicher im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, Reporting-Tools und digitalen Vertriebsplattformen.

  • Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch, und gute Englischkenntnisse bringst du ebenfalls mit.

Mindset:

  • Du bist hochmotiviert, zielorientiert und packst Dinge gerne aktiv an. Sales ist für dich nicht nur ein Job, sondern etwas, das dich antreibt; du liebst den direkten Kundenkontakt und interessierst dich für Kapitalmärkte.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und mit echtem Erfolgswillen. Gleichzeitig verbindest du Überzeugungskraft mit Empathie und einem starken Servicegedanken, genau das macht dich zu einer authentischen und überzeugenden Ansprechperson.

 

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!


Das bieten wir dir

  • Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

  • Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

  • Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

  • Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus.

So geht es für dich weiter

  • Erster Austausch: In einem ersten Gespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team möchten wir die Gelegenheit nutzen, dich näher kennenzulernen und grundlegende Informationen zu besprechen.

    Videointerview mit dem Hiring Manager: In einem fachlichen Dialog prüfen wir, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen mit den Anforderungen der Position übereinstimmen.

  • Persönliches Treffen: Hier hast du die Gelegenheit, das Team zu treffen und praxisnahe Einblicke in die Tätigkeiten eines Sales Managers zu gewinnen.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland.   • Strong troubleshooting skills, and familiarity with incident, change and problem management processes

  • Experience supporting production services in a 24x7 or on-call environment

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Robotics Platform
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  


About the role

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth.

As a robotics platform software engineer intern, you will help build our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will  gather requirements from internal customers, work on communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems.


What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain parts of the robotics platform, e.g. APIs, health monitoring and machine configuration management

  • Contributing to high quality code, improving robustness and maintainability of existing code


    • What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • Hands-on experience in Software Engineering

  • Solid Software Engineering skills

  • Programming skills in a systems language like C++ or Rust, Python is nice to have

  • Experience in computer networking

  • Experience in information security

  • Experience working with embedded systems

  • Experience working on production grade software system

  • Open source contributions

jobs.title: Manufacturing Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.


About the role

We are looking for a manufacturing systems engineer to own the production process and make it ready for a significant scaleup. You will work closely with our engineering and production team in Zürich to make our production more reliable and scalable.


This role is very hands-on and you will spend a lot of your time on the shop floor solving issues and improving production hand in hand with assembly technicians. You will be building out a world class production system to support a rapidly growing supply base.   


What you will do

  • Own how our product is built from start to finish

  • Create and maintain production process documentation, both for internal and external manufacturing

  • Improve workstation layout, flow design and tooling from incoming goods to product shipping

  • Support make vs buy decisions and supplier selection

  • Support new product introduction from development to production

  • Close DFM feedback loop to improve manufacturability


    • What we're looking for

  • A university degree in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics Engineering or equivalent practical experience

  • 3+ years experience in manufacturing / process engineering in mid volume manufacturing

  • Taken a product from prototype to repeatable series production before

  • Solid understanding of mechanical and electrical systems

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in United Kingdom.

Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems.


Accountabilities

You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.

  • Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.

  • Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.

  • Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes.

  • Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance.

  • Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels.

  • Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools.

  • Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines.

  • Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them.

  • Taking end-to-end ownership: Write technical specifications, plan and deliver projects independently, communicate progress asynchronously, and remain accountable for monitoring and improving solutions after deployment.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating production-ready AI systems. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and applying sound judgment to complex automation and security challenges. Required qualifications include:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review.

  • Between 6 and 12 months of experience shipping LLM-based systems to production and supporting agentic workflows used by real end users.

  • Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code.

  • Experience developing autonomous or multi-step agents with tool integrations, using technologies such as the Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks.

  • Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls.

  • Knowledge of identity and access management systems such as Okta or similar identity providers, including SSO protocols (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based access, and device policies.

  • Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password.

  • Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code.

  • Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring.

  • Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust.

  • Experience monitoring and controlling AI expenditure across providers through API key limits, cost centers, budgets, and actionable alerts.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.

  • A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs.

  • Ability to understand stakeholder needs, translate ambiguous requests into actionable technical requirements, and explain complex concepts to both executives and subject matter experts.

  • A proactive and autonomous working style, with the ability to prioritize effectively, challenge unsafe or low-value requests constructively, and communicate progress across time zones.

  • A strong sense of ownership, including the ability to validate solutions with users, monitor performance after deployment, and continuously iterate.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cryptocurrency, blockchain, payments, or fintech, particularly within regulated or audit-focused environments.

  • Experience creating reusable agent skills, plugins, or shared prompt libraries for organizational use.

  • Familiarity with model gateways such as OpenRouter, LiteLLM, or Portkey, including key management, model routing, and fallback strategies.

  • Experience extending open-source coding agents such as OpenCode or Pi.

  • Awareness of emerging agent identity standards, including MCP enterprise-managed authentication and Okta Cross App Access.

  • Knowledge of context and retrieval engineering, including vector stores, agent memory, and permission-aware retrieval systems.

  • Background in machine learning engineering, including model evaluation, fine-tuning, and model routing.

  • Experience working with agent runtimes and sandbox environments such as Modal, n8n, or containerized infrastructure.

  • Public technical contributions, such as open-source tools, servers, technical articles, or presentations demonstrating experience with production AI agents.

    • Benefits

  • Remote-first work environment: Join a globally distributed workforce and work remotely.

  • Health insurance: Access medical, dental, and vision coverage, with employee and dependent coverage fully provided in certain countries, depending on the applicable plan.

  • Retirement benefits: Benefit from a company-matched 401(k) contribution of up to 3% for eligible employees in the United States.

  • Home office allowance: Receive a one-time allowance of $1,500 to set up your home workspace.

  • Professional development: Access an annual book allowance of $200 to support continuous learning.

  • Connectivity reimbursement: Receive $75 per month toward internet or phone expenses.

  • Flexible time off: Benefit from flexible paid time off arrangements.

  • Work equipment: Receive a company-issued laptop.

  • Well-being support: Access egg-freezing benefits, mental health resources, and employee wellness programs.

  • Inclusive workplace: Work in an environment committed to equal opportunity, accessibility, and providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
Crypto.com is a global cryptocurrency platform serving traders and investors in markets around the world. The CDC product line is our international crypto trading app — spanning spot, perpetual contracts, and card rips — and we are building the next generation of trading products for a global audience.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Growth to sit at the intersection of user acquisition, creative strategy, martech, and measurement. This is not a single-lane role. You’ll own the day-to-day performance of our UA program across paid channels and every market we operate in, but you’ll also lead three critical sub-functions — creative, martech, and measurement — that today sit with senior leadership and need a dedicated operator to take them to the next level.

You’ll work directly with our agency partners, product teams, data science, and platform reps (Meta, Google, Apple) across regions. You’ll inherit a scaled UA program with multiple products launching simultaneously, a global market footprint, and a martech stack that’s being built in real time. If you’re the kind of person who can context-switch between a Meta CAPI payload spec and a creative brief in the same afternoon, this role was made for you.


Responsibilities

User Acquisition Operations

  • Own the weekly operating rhythm for CDC paid UA — spend plans, pacing, optimization decisions, and performance reporting across all channels (Meta, Google, Apple Search, programmatic DSPs, affiliates, regional platforms, and emerging networks), across every market we operate in
  • Manage the relationship with our performance agency on a daily basis — standups, creative briefings, channel strategy, spend allocation, and trading decisions
  • Drive channel-level optimization using CAC, CPFT, pLTV ROAS, and lower-funnel conversion metrics. You’re expected to know what’s working, what’s not, and why before anyone asks
  • Lead GTM execution for new product launches and market openings (spot, perpetual contracts, card rips, new offer structures) — from tracking readiness through creative production through spend activation
  • Build and maintain the weekly trading deck and leadership updates. Present performance narratives to VP and C-level stakeholders with clarity and confidence
  • Own the competitive monitoring cadence — Sensor Tower, app store rankings, ad intelligence — across key markets, and translate competitive signals into channel and creative decisions
  • Own market prioritisation — which countries we open, in what order, and what each market needs in localisation, payment rails, and channel mix before we commit spend

    •  

    Sub-function: Creative Strategy

    Our creative pipeline is currently managed between agency and leadership. This role takes ownership of the full creative lifecycle for performance marketing.

  • Own the creative learning agenda — what hooks, formats, and concepts we’re testing, what’s winning, and what to kill. Maintain a structured view of creative performance by channel, format, and audience
  • Lead creative briefing for the agency and UGC creators. Translate product updates, offers, and cultural moments into production-ready briefs with clear deliverables and timelines, localised for each market we run in
  • Drive format expansion beyond static display — UGC video, social-native content, meme-format creative, and AI-assisted production pipelines
  • Establish a rapid refresh cadence to combat creative fatigue across channels, and ensure channel-specific sizing and placement specs are met
  • Coordinate with brand and content teams on production shoots, scripting, and asset capture for UA use

    •  

    Sub-function: Martech

    Our martech stack spans AppsFlyer, Segment, Firebase, Google Tag Manager, Meta CAPI, Impact (affiliates), and multiple ad platform integrations. Today this is led by our VP with execution support from a solo martech lead. This role becomes the strategic owner.

  • Serve as the growth team’s primary point of contact for all tracking, attribution, and signal infrastructure. You’re the person who knows whether events are firing, payloads are complete, and platform signals are flowing
  • Partner with our martech lead to prioritize and unblock implementation work — new product event instrumentation, platform pixel/CAPI builds, conversion upload pipelines, and deep link configuration
  • Own the relationship with platform measurement teams (Google gTech, Meta measurement partners, AppsFlyer TAMs) across regions and ensure their recommendations translate into shipped work
  • Drive martech readiness for every product launch and offer change. If tracking isn’t ready, you’re the one who flags it and owns the escalation
  • Understand the full signal chain from user action to ad platform optimization loop — SDK events, server-to-server integrations, CAPI payloads, consent parameters, and AEM eligibility requirements
  • Handle the multi-market layer — regional MMP configuration, multi-currency revenue handling, and market-specific consent and privacy regimes

    •  

    Sub-function: Measurement

    Measurement maturity is the constraint on scaling. This role owns the roadmap for closing attribution gaps and building toward incrementality-based decision-making.

  • Own the attribution framework — last-click, MECE logic, promo code overlap rules — and ensure it’s consistently applied across reporting, agency data, and leadership updates
  • Define and maintain measurement plans for each product line (spot, perps, rips) including KPI definitions, LTV attribution windows, and what “success” looks like at each funnel stage
  • Lead the build-out of conversion feedback loops for each platform — Google Ads click ID upload pipelines, Meta CAPI integration, and Apple SKAN/AdAttributionKit readiness
  • Partner with data science on pLTV model validation, cohort economics tracking, and the eventual transition from CPA to ROAS-based bidding
  • Scope and prioritize incrementality testing (geo holdouts, per-channel lift measurement) and marketing mix modeling as the program matures
  • Maintain reporting credibility — when agency data and Tableau data don’t match, you’re the person who investigates, explains, and fixes it
  • Normalise reporting across currencies and markets so performance is comparable country to country, and so a CAC in one region means the same thing as a CAC in another

    • Requirements:
  • 5+ years in performance marketing or growth, with direct ownership of paid UA budgets across Meta, Google, Apple Search, and at least one programmatic partner
  • Hands-on experience with mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch), server-to-server integrations, and ad platform conversion APIs (Meta CAPI, Google Ads S2S)
  • Experience marketing trading or investing products — you understand funding rates, spreads, deposit and withdrawal flows, and why an active trader’s value profile looks different from a casual user’s
  • Track record running paid UA across multiple international markets — localisation, regional channel mix, a multi-time-zone operating rhythm, and market-by-market regulatory nuance
  • Strong working knowledge of attribution models, SKAN/AdAttributionKit, AEM eligibility, and the privacy-era signal landscape
  • Experience managing or closely partnering with a performance creative function — you’ve briefed UGC creators, reviewed ad concepts, and made data-backed creative decisions
  • Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities. You’ll be launching multiple products, fixing attribution gaps, and building new measurement infrastructure simultaneously
  • Exceptional communication skills — you can explain a CAPI payload issue to an engineer and a CAC trend to a CMO in the same day
  • Experience in crypto, trading, fintech, or financial services is strongly preferred — you’ve marketed a product where the user is putting capital at risk. What matters most is that you’ve scaled paid UA in a high-velocity, multi-product environment

    • Why This Role:
  • You’re joining at an inflection point — new products launching, measurement stack being built, creative pipeline evolving. The person in this seat will shape how all of it comes together
  • You’ll have real ownership across UA, creative, martech, and measurement. This is not a channel manager role — it’s a multi-discipline growth operator role with a clear path to director
  • You’ll work with a small, senior team that moves fast and makes real decisions. No layers of approval — the VP is your skip and the CMO is one level above that
  • Part of Crypto.com — a global platform with the resources and ambition to build a category-defining product, and the speed and autonomy of a startup growth team
  • Global remit — the markets you open and the playbooks you build will define how we scale internationally, not just in one country

jobs.description:
Customer Success Operations & Business Analyst (H/F)

Stage de 6 mois – à partir de janvier 2027
Localisation : Paris

Prêt(e) à rejoindre la révolution Legal Tech ?

DiliTrust est un éditeur SaaS mondial qui transforme les directions juridiques grâce à une technologie de pointe.
En rejoignant nos équipes, vous intégrerez une scale-up SaaS en forte croissance, avec l’ambition de devenir une future licorne de la LegalTech. Vous travaillerez au cœur du business, en collaboration étroite avec les équipes Customer Success, Sales et la direction, et contribuerez directement à des décisions structurantes pour l’organisation.

Vision

En tant que fournisseur de logiciels SaaS, DiliTrust est une entreprise mondiale dédiée à offrir une suite intégrée de solutions juridiques et de gouvernance. Notre vision est de digitaliser les directions juridiques à travers le monde et de devenir un leader mondial de la Legal Tech.

Notre impact

De la génération de rapports d’assemblées générales à la gestion du cycle de vie des contrats assistée par l’intelligence artificielle, nos équipes contribuent chaque jour au succès de DiliTrust et à la satisfaction de ses clients dans un contexte international.

Notre reconnaissance

DiliTrust est à l’avant-garde de l’innovation en Legal Tech et s’attache à offrir un environnement de travail positif, entrepreneurial et stimulant.

Le rôle

Au sein de l’équipe Customer Success, vous contribuerez à structurer et à améliorer les opérations de l’équipe grâce à l’analyse de données, à la fiabilisation du CRM et à la mise en place d’outils de pilotage.
Votre mission sera de donner davantage de visibilité à l’équipe sur la performance et la santé du portefeuille clients, tout en participant à la construction de l’organisation Customer Success de demain. Les analyses, tableaux de bord et processus que vous développerez auront un impact direct sur les décisions de l’équipe et sur le suivi de nos clients.

Missions

1. Construire l’organisation de demain

  • Participer aux analyses relatives à l’organisation 2027 de l’équipe Customer Success et formuler des recommandations à partir des données disponibles.
  • Contribuer à la refonte du score de santé client et préparer les supports des comités avec la direction Customer Success.

2. Donner de la visibilité à toute l’équipe

  • Concevoir et maintenir des tableaux de bord HubSpot permettant de suivre les indicateurs clés de l’activité : rétention, croissance, activité et performance du portefeuille.
  • Préparer les chiffres clés des rituels d’équipe et des revues de performance, et construire des business reviews clients percutantes, de l’analyse des données jusqu’à la préparation des supports.

3. Rendre notre CRM fiable et utile

  • Contribuer à la qualité et à la fiabilité des données HubSpot : comptes, propriétaires, fiches entreprises et informations relatives au suivi client.
  • Participer au regroupement des outils de suivi client dans HubSpot et travailler avec les équipes Sales afin de fluidifier le passage de relais ainsi que le suivi des renouvellements.

4. Simplifier et automatiser

  • Rédiger des modes opératoires clairs et accessibles afin d’harmoniser les pratiques de l’équipe au quotidien.
  • Contribuer à l’automatisation du suivi d’une partie du portefeuille client, identifier les possibilités de simplification et proposer des améliorations concrètes.

Profil recherché

Vous êtes actuellement étudiant(e) en école de commerce, d’ingénieurs, en université ou dans une formation spécialisée en business analytics, gestion de projet, stratégie, opérations ou relation client.
Vous êtes à la recherche d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027 et vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement SaaS, international et en forte croissance.
Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
  • Votre esprit analytique et votre capacité à transformer des données en recommandations concrètes.
  • Votre rigueur et votre attention portée à la qualité des informations.
  • Votre capacité à structurer des sujets complexes et à les présenter de manière claire et synthétique.
  • Votre autonomie, votre sens de l’initiative et votre capacité à proposer des améliorations.
  • Votre aisance relationnelle et votre goût du travail en équipe, notamment avec des interlocuteurs Customer Success, Sales et Direction.

Connaissances techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise d’Excel ou de Google Sheets : analyse de données, recherche d’informations, tableaux croisés dynamiques et mise en forme de données.
  • Intérêt marqué pour les CRM et les outils de pilotage de la performance.
  • Une première expérience avec HubSpot ou un autre CRM serait un plus.
  • La connaissance des principes de création de tableaux de bord, d’automatisation et de qualité des données serait appréciée.
  • Français courant et bon niveau d’anglais professionnel.

Process

  • Entretien avec un membre de l’équipe Talent Acquisition.
  • Entretien avec le/la manager.
  • Entretien technique ou étude de cas pratique.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Manager based in Switzerland.

Join a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment transforming how businesses approach sales through advanced AI-powered technology. In this role, you will take ownership of an existing customer portfolio, building strategic relationships and identifying opportunities to drive sustainable revenue growth. You will work closely with decision-makers to understand their business objectives, optimize product adoption, and deliver measurable value. Combining account development, consultative selling, and commercial strategy, you will play a key role in strengthening customer partnerships and expanding business opportunities. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams in a remote-first environment that encourages autonomy, innovation, and continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on customer success while contributing to the growth of an ambitious technology business.


Accountabilities

  • Manage and develop a portfolio of existing customer accounts, building strong relationships with key stakeholders and understanding their business objectives, priorities, and challenges.

  • Drive revenue expansion by identifying, developing, and closing upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.

  • Create and execute strategic account plans to maximize customer potential, strengthen partnerships, and identify new growth opportunities.

  • Build trusted relationships with key decision-makers, including senior executives, positioning the platform as a strategic solution for their business needs.

  • Identify opportunities to increase product adoption by understanding customer workflows, pain points, and evolving requirements.

  • Lead commercial discussions and negotiations, including pricing, contract expansions, and renewals where applicable.

  • Monitor customer engagement, account performance, and overall portfolio health to identify potential risks and proactively address retention and growth opportunities.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, and other internal teams to ensure a consistent customer experience and align account development strategies.

  • Track and report key performance indicators, including revenue growth, expansion pipeline, and individual account performance.

  • Share customer feedback and market insights while contributing to the continuous improvement of account management processes, workflows, and best practices.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in account management, sales, or a similar commercial role, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and strategic account development.

  • Experience managing existing customer portfolios and ideally owning revenue targets or commercial quotas.

  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at different organizational levels.

  • Strong commercial awareness and a consultative sales approach, with the ability to identify customer needs, negotiate effectively, and close expansion opportunities.

  • Excellent organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, monitor performance, and prioritize opportunities effectively.

  • Comfortable working in a remote-first environment and collaborating across multiple teams and functions.

  • A high level of ownership, initiative, and urgency, combined with the ability to adapt and deliver results in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • A customer-oriented mindset and a proactive approach to building long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive salary: Attractive compensation package based on experience and qualifications.

  • Health insurance: Healthcare coverage to support your well-being.

  • Stock options: Opportunity to participate in the company's long-term growth through equity.

  • Collaborative work environment: Join a supportive, dynamic team that values innovation, initiative, and professional development.

  • Annual company trip: Enjoy a yearly company-wide trip to a surprise destination.

  • Startup environment: Be part of a rapidly growing, post-Series A business with established product-market fit and strong backing from Y Combinator.

  • Professional growth: Work alongside ambitious professionals and contribute directly to the development of an innovative AI-powered sales platform.
