jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Netherlands.

Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems.


Accountabilities

You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.

  • Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.

  • Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.

  • Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes.

  • Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance.

  • Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels.

  • Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools.

  • Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines.

  • Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them.

  • Taking end-to-end ownership: Write technical specifications, plan and deliver projects independently, communicate progress asynchronously, and remain accountable for monitoring and improving solutions after deployment.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating production-ready AI systems. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and applying sound judgment to complex automation and security challenges. Required qualifications include:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review.

  • Between 6 and 12 months of experience shipping LLM-based systems to production and supporting agentic workflows used by real end users.

  • Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code.

  • Experience developing autonomous or multi-step agents with tool integrations, using technologies such as the Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks.

  • Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls.

  • Knowledge of identity and access management systems such as Okta or similar identity providers, including SSO protocols (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based access, and device policies.

  • Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password.

  • Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code.

  • Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring.

  • Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust.

  • Experience monitoring and controlling AI expenditure across providers through API key limits, cost centers, budgets, and actionable alerts.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.

  • A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs.

  • Ability to understand stakeholder needs, translate ambiguous requests into actionable technical requirements, and explain complex concepts to both executives and subject matter experts.

  • A proactive and autonomous working style, with the ability to prioritize effectively, challenge unsafe or low-value requests constructively, and communicate progress across time zones.

  • A strong sense of ownership, including the ability to validate solutions with users, monitor performance after deployment, and continuously iterate.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cryptocurrency, blockchain, payments, or fintech, particularly within regulated or audit-focused environments.

  • Experience creating reusable agent skills, plugins, or shared prompt libraries for organizational use.

  • Familiarity with model gateways such as OpenRouter, LiteLLM, or Portkey, including key management, model routing, and fallback strategies.

  • Experience extending open-source coding agents such as OpenCode or Pi.

  • Awareness of emerging agent identity standards, including MCP enterprise-managed authentication and Okta Cross App Access.

  • Knowledge of context and retrieval engineering, including vector stores, agent memory, and permission-aware retrieval systems.

  • Background in machine learning engineering, including model evaluation, fine-tuning, and model routing.

  • Experience working with agent runtimes and sandbox environments such as Modal, n8n, or containerized infrastructure.

  • Public technical contributions, such as open-source tools, servers, technical articles, or presentations demonstrating experience with production AI agents.

    • Benefits

  • Remote-first work environment: Join a globally distributed workforce and work remotely.

  • Health insurance: Access medical, dental, and vision coverage, with employee and dependent coverage fully provided in certain countries, depending on the applicable plan.

  • Retirement benefits: Benefit from a company-matched 401(k) contribution of up to 3% for eligible employees in the United States.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Programme Manager
jobs.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do
  • Build and maintain sufficient understanding of the underlying technology to challenge constructively, identify delivery implications, and represent technical status accurately. The role is not expected to act as the technical authority.
  • Translate customer requirements, contractual obligations, and engineering inputs into clear delivery plans, milestones, priorities, and actionable work packages.
  • Own the day-to-day delivery of defence programmes or significant technical workstreams, ensuring agreed scope, schedule, quality, and delivery objectives are achieved.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to understand the technical scope, maturity, progress, risks, and constraints of underlying engineering activity.
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery across engineering, operations, quality, commercial, and external suppliers.
  • Prepare clear, concise programme materials, including status reports, decision papers, review packs, and customer updates, that support timely, high-quality decisions.
  • Support and coordinate technical reviews, technical discussions, and reporting; ensure actions, decisions, and technical dependencies are captured and closed.
  • Work directly with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders in delivery meetings, programme reviews, and technical discussions.
  • Manage day-to-day relationships with technical partners and subcontractors, coordinating deliverables, resolving technical queries, and holding suppliers to agreed schedule and quality expectations.
  • Ensure applicable safety, quality, assurance, and regulatory frameworks are understood and appropriately integrated into programme delivery. Work with relevant technical and assurance authorities to ensure compliance requirements, verification activities, and evidence needs are planned and tracked.

    • Who you are
  • At least 5 years’ experience in programme or project delivery within aerospace, defence, engineering, deep-tech, or another high-consequence technical environment.
  • A degree or comparable professional background in engineering, physics, materials science, systems engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Demonstrable experience working between technical detail and programme execution, converting analysis into practical delivery action.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment
  • Exposure to customer-facing delivery, programme reviews, supplier management, or subcontractor coordination.
  • Experience with planning, risk management, dependency management, change control, and delivery reporting.
  • Fluent English, with confidence operating in bilingual and cross-cultural settings. German is not a requirement, but is preferred.

    • What we offer
  • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.  
  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, defence, and business functions, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.  
  • High ownership and autonomy; no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.  
  • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly and broken processes are fixed rather than tolerated.  
  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, excellence, and direct feedback.  
  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.  
    • At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
     
    Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
     
    You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

  • You thrive partnering with business leaders and executives, developing long-term relationships, closing deals, and aligning key stakeholders at each stage of the sales lifecycle

  • Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community
  • Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission

jobs.description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
 
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the job:

As an Enterprise Account Executive in London you’ll help accelerate growth across the UK’s leading banks, insurance companies, and fintech businesses. You'll report into the Sales Director, FSI based in the London office.

You’ll work as part of an immediate close-knit team of five, while collaborating with a broader UK and global sales organisation that includes Sales Development Representatives, Solutions Engineers, Customer Success Managers, Marketing, Partnerships, and Leadership.

You’ll manage a balanced portfolio of approximately 10 existing customers to renew and expand, alongside around 90 prospective accounts. 

Financial services is a key strategic priority for Contentsquare. It’s the newest but fastest growing vertical. In this role, you’ll help some of the UK’s most influential financial institutions make better digital decisions through Contentsquare’s experience intelligence platform and ecosystem of technology partnerships, including Microsoft and Snowflake.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Manage the full sales cycle for Contentsquare’s experience intelligence platform across UK financial services accounts.
  • Develop and execute strategic enterprise account plans to drive new business, account expansion, and retention.
  • Prospect into and build relationships with senior executives and decision-makers across Product, Marketing, Design and Data teams. 
  • Own renewal activity in close partnership with the Customer Success Manager, ensuring customers continue to realise value from Contentsquare.
  • Establish and navigate senior-level relationships, from initial engagement through to executive sponsorship.
  • Articulate the business value of complex enterprise technology and connect it to customers’ digital transformation priorities.
  • Leverage Contentsquare’s broader sales ecosystem and technology partnerships to create compelling customer solutions.
  • Represent Contentsquare as a trusted strategic partner to leading UK financial services organisations.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Experience selling enterprise SaaS solutions, including new business and account expansion.
  • Experience selling into financial services is a plus, but not required.
  • A proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.
  • The ability to articulate the business value of complex technology and link it to measurable customer outcomes.
  • The ability to develop senior-level relationships quickly and effectively.
  • Experience with a recognised sales methodology such as MEDDICC, SPIN, or Challenger.
  • Motivation to work in a hybrid environment, spending three days per week in our London office.
Why you should join Contentsquare
We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.
 
Here are a few we want to highlight:
- Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year
- Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies
- Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)
- Lifestyle allowance
- A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work
- Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success
- We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts
- And more benefits tailored to each country
 
Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
 
Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our Job Candidate Privacy Notice to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal here. 
 
Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Senior Data Engineer on our Maritime Models team, you will take technical ownership of the core data pipelines and distributed storage architectures powering Kpler's vessel tracking and predictive analytics. You will design, scale, and optimize high-throughput batch and streaming pipelines that ingest raw maritime telemetry and transform it into actionable intelligence. Working with distributed NoSQL systems like Apache HBase at scale, your work directly ensures the freshness, accuracy, and reliability of the data models our global customers depend on.

 


Key Responsibilities

 

  • Architect, build, and operate high-throughput batch and streaming data pipelines using Java, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, and Airflow.

  • Design, tune, and maintain scalable distributed NoSQL databases, prioritizing Apache HBase performance for high-volume time-series maritime telemetry.

  • Drive end-to-end operational excellence across containerized cloud environments on AWS using Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and GitOps workflows.

  • Define and enforce system reliability metrics, monitoring pipeline latency, data completeness, and uptime to meet strict operational SLAs.

  • Partner with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and SRE teams to translate complex maritime modeling requirements into robust, production-grade infrastructure.

  • Mentor peer engineers, drive code review standards, and leverage modern AI development tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to elevate team productivity.

    •  


    Experience & Background

    What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Data Engineer designing, scaling, and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in distributed NoSQL data stores, specifically Apache HBase, for high-volume time-series storage and query optimization.

  • Strong proficiency in software engineering using Java.

  • Demonstrated experience with stream processing and orchestration tools such as Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, and Apache Airflow.

  • Solid background operating containerized services on AWS cloud environments using Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.

    • Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.

  • Experience working with geospatial data technologies (e.g., GeoServer) or spatial indexing algorithms.

  • Exposure to AI-assisted software development tools like Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code.

  • Domain familiarity with maritime tracking, AIS telemetry, or supply chain logistics.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst (Companies/Ownership)
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

As a Senior Data Analyst within our Data Platform team, you will be the subject matter expert behind Kpler’s company and ownership datasets. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, structure and ongoing development of company-level data, including ownership, management, operator and corporate hierarchy information.

Your deep understanding of the maritime industry and its corporate landscape will help establish a reliable source of truth for asset ownership, supporting our wider data platform strategy and enabling other datasets, products and teams to build on consistent, trusted information.

Starting with maritime companies, you will help expand our coverage over time to include other asset classes and related industries, such as ports, terminals, refineries, commodities and infrastructure. You will use your industry judgement to lead complex data investigations, identify gaps and drive improvements in data quality and coverage with a high degree of independence.

While technical data skills are important, this role places particular emphasis on your industry expertise and ability to translate complex ownership structures into clear business rules and reliable data models. You will also collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Market Analysts and other Data Analysts to strengthen our data capabilities and support commercial and customer-facing teams.

jobs.title: ML Engineer - Power
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Kpler, you will play a key role in developing and deploying predictive models that power our global commodity, energy, and maritime intelligence platforms. Working closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product teams, you will bridge the gap between machine learning experimentation and production-grade software delivery. Your work will directly transform complex data flows into real-time, actionable insights that help world-leading trading firms, industrial leaders, and analysts make critical decisions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and deploy ML pipelines: Design, build, and maintain production-grade machine learning workflows and microservices for power market forecasting and electricity grid modeling.

  • Bridge research and engineering: Transition statistical and machine learning prototypes from initial experimentation into scalable, production-ready Python applications.

  • Manage time-series and event data systems: Design and optimize database schemas in PostgreSQL to handle high-throughput time-series data, event streams, and normalization routines.

  • Implement robust MLOps practices: Establish automated model training, backtesting, evaluation, tuning, and feature/model versioning standards across deployments.

  • Drive data engineering quality: Construct clean ingestion and transformation pipelines, ensuring high integrity, validation, and low-latency access across analytical models.

  • Champion software excellence: Write modular, well-tested Python code, actively participating in peer code reviews, CI/CD automation, and Agile delivery processes.


    • Experience & Background
    What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • Software engineering foundation: Approximately two to five years of experience as a data-focused software engineer.

  • Python mastery: Significant experience working with large production Python codebases, rather than working exclusively in notebooks.

  • Domain knowledge: Deep understanding of electricity-grid fundamentals, including generation, transmission, and electricity markets.

  • Data engineering & databases: Experience in data engineering, including working with PostgreSQL or similar databases, database design, data normalisation, and managing time-series and event data.

  • DS & ML research rigor: Proven experience in data science and machine learning research, encompassing statistics, hypothesis testing, model training, evaluation, backtesting, tuning, and model selection.

  • MLOps & versioning: Practical experience in machine learning engineering, specifically including model and feature versioning.

  • Engineering practices & communication: Confidence working with Git, code reviews, and Agile methodologies, supported by strong written and spoken English.

    • Nice-to-haves

  • Cloud platforms: Experience deploying ML workloads on AWS or GCP using Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Workflow orchestration: Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, or MLflow.

  • Streaming technologies: Exposure to real-time streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka).

jobs.title: Big Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Odaseva provides enterprise data management and security solutions that help organizations exercise sovereignty over their critical data.
Companies representing 10% of global market capitalization trust Odaseva, including Schneider Electric, Volkswagen and Robert Half.
Its Excalibur Data Platform enables customers to protect, secure, move, and use data and code independently of application vendors.
The platform supports complex and high-volume use cases, including backup, archiving, zero-copy, BCDR & High Availability, data federation, and semantic AI orchestration.
Customer-controlled end-to-end encryption raises the bar for enterprise security.
With 11 patents, Odaseva manages 50 trillion records and supports 100 million users. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Pipeline Development & Operations: Design, build, handle, and monitor Spark data pipelines for large-volume data lake ingestion (handling hundreds of TBs).

  • Platform & Cost Optimization: Continuously optimize the performance, reliability, and costs of big data pipelines and infrastructure.

  • Databricks, Snowflake & Cloud Engineering: Deeply leverage Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS Redshift, alongside cloud provider solutions (AWS S3, Glue/Athena, Lambda) for scalable data engineering.

  • Lakehouse Architecture: Demonstrate strong expertise in managing, creating, and optimizing Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg tables.

  • Secure Data Management: Apply security-by-design, data governance, and compliance best practices across storage, compute, and sharing layers.


    • Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in data engineering or backend data platforms, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience building and operating big data pipelines.

  • Hands-on engineer background with proven track record handling large volumes of data (at least hundreds of TB).

  • Deep knowledge of at least one data lake platform among Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS Redshift.

  • Strong expertise in Apache Spark (creation, handling, and monitoring of pipelines) and lakehouse table formats (Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg).

  • Strong Python or Java and SQL skills, cloud infrastructure (AWS S3, Athena, Glue), and IaC/observability practices.

  • Solid understanding of cost management principles, data security, governance, and data modeling.

  • Equivalent engineering school degree or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or Applied Mathematics.

  • Fluent in English and French, with clear communication, ownership mindset, and strong collaborative skills.


    • Where you'll be
  • Based in Paris (75002), France.
  • Hybrid: 3 days in the office / 2 days remote work.
  • Full time permanent contract position.

jobs.title: Wordt jij onze Topschilder!
jobs.description: Ben jij een ervaren schilder of juist iemand die zijn vaardigheden verder wil ontwikkelen? Bij Succes! Solliciteer dan vandaag nog en bouw mee aan mooie projecten met Succes! Uitzendbureau!Succes! Daarmee voegen wij waarde toe aan de arbeidsmarkt en creëren we de perfecte match tussen mens en bedrijf.

jobs.title: Begeleider Signalering- en Ondersteuningsteam  Assen - Meppel - Nooitgedacht
jobs.description: Als begeleider in het Signalering- en Ondersteuningsteam werk je op verschillende locaties binnen Vanboeijen. Je hebt geen vaste werkplek, maar wél een vaste rol van betekenis: je wordt ingezet bij intensieve en complexe zorgvragen en brengt rust, richting en ontwikkeling. Je biedt onvoorwaardelijke begeleiding aan bewoners, sluit aan bij hun behoeften en draagt bij aan een veilige en stabiele leefomgeving.Je herkent signalen, duidt gedrag en handelt vanuit de Vanboeijen Manier en Triple C. Is een opdracht afgerond? Dan ga je door naar een nieuwe locatie waar jouw kennis en ervaring opnieuw het verschil maken.Daarnaast versterk je teams in de dagelijkse praktijk. Je coacht collega-begeleiders, deelt je expertise over methodieken en interventies en bent een voorbeeld in professioneel handelen, juist wanneer het spannend wordt. Samen met de gedragsdeskundige en zorgmanager stel je plannen van aanpak op, vertaal je observaties naar concrete doelen en blijf je scherp evalueren. Zo lever je een directe bijdrage aan duurzame verbetering van de zorg.Toe aan meer inhoud, invloed en afwisseling in je werk als zorgprofessional? In het Signalering- en Ondersteuningsteam van Vanboeijen zet je jouw ervaring in waar die het hardst nodig is en maak je elke dag zichtbaar verschil.

jobs.title: HSE Manager (Health, Safety & Environment)
jobs.description: Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen een productieomgeving, met ruime kennis van veiligheid, arbeidsomstandigheden en milieubeheer. jobs.description: Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie of operationele werkomgeving. jobs.description: AU PAIR OR CHILDCARE?  Two very different choices The au pair programme is a cultural exchange programme : a young person from abroad comes to live with your family for a year. Regular childcare is official, regulated care provided by professionals . Below you can see the differences at a glance.  CULTURAL EXCHANGE PROGRAMME Au pair programme  OFFICIAL CHILDCARE Daycare, out-of-school care or childminder  What is it? A young person from abroad lives with your family for up to twelve months to get to know the Netherlands, and helps out. Professional care for children aged 0 to 12, in a group or with a childminder.  Legal framework A residence purpose with its own rules. jobs.description: And How Can You Retain Young Temporary Workers? 19-10-2026 Written by: Sude Tomak Young employees have become an essential part of the logistics, production and horticulture sectors. Yet many employers find it challenging to retain Gen Z workers. Young people tend to change jobs more frequently and have different expectations of their employers. But does this mean they are less loyal? Not necessarily. Above all, they want clear expectations, to feel valued and to have opportunities to develop their skills. Job Security, Salary and Personal Attention A good salary remains important. According to Deloitte's 2026 global survey, the cost of living is a major concern for Gen Z. Young people are therefore looking for more than just an enjoyable job. They also want financial security and stability. However, it is about more than money. Gen Z values employers who listen to them, make clear agreements and pay attention to their personal circumstances. Personal Support Makes the Difference At OPUS, we see how important personal contact is. That is why we stay in regular contact with our employees, not only when they start a new job, but also throughout their employment. How is the job going? Are there any problems? And what can we do to help someone move forward? These conversations help us understand what is happening and allow us to provide support more quickly. Practical matters also deserve attention. For example, we help employees find suitable transport options and support them with questions about their work and personal circumstances. Sometimes it is the small things that make a big difference in how someone experiences their job. Opportunities to Grow Gen Z wants to move forward. Young people value opportunities to learn new skills and build a future. At OPUS, we therefore also focus on professional development. jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Onze klant is actief in IT-infrastructuur en technologische oplossingen voor bedrijven. Vanuit een sterk technisch team ondersteunen ze klanten bij het ontwerpen, implementeren en onderhouden van hun IT-omgeving. Je komt terecht in een moderne werkomgeving met een open sfeer, waar initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling sterk worden aangemoedigd.

Jobomschrijving

  • Je vertaalt klantvragen naar innovatieve en technisch haalbare IT-oplossingen rond infrastructuur, servers, netwerken, storage, Azure en meer.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met de Sales Manager en Operations Manager en levert technische input voor offertes, presentaties en klantgesprekken.
  • Je bereidt projecten technisch volledig voor en zorgt daarna voor een duidelijke overdracht naar de System Engineers.
  • Je bewaakt de technische kwaliteit van projecten en voert controles uit van voorbereiding tot oplevering.
  • Je denkt mee over technische keuzes, resourceplanning en procesverbeteringen en springt bij grote projecten occasioneel mee in een klantgesprek voor extra technische afstemming.

  • Je hebt een bacheloropleiding en een 5 tal jaar ervaring als System Engineer of in een gelijkaardige technische infrastructuurrol.
  • Je beschikt over een stevige technische basis in IT-infrastructuur, servers, netwerken, storage, Azure of vergelijkbare technologieën.
  • Je wil evolueren van technische uitvoering naar advies, projectvoorbereiding en technische architectuur.
  • Je communiceert vlot met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders en durft initiatief te nemen.
  • Ervaring met HPE, Aruba, Proxmox of gelijkaardige technologieën is een plus.

jobs.title: Process Development Manager, Asiakasprosessit
jobs.description: Suomalainen arki vaatii energiaa. Ja tekijöitä. Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan joustavaa ja polttamatonta energiajärjestelmää! Me Helenissä tarjoamme helpompaa ja mutkattomampaa arkea kaikkialla Suomessa. Helen Oy on vähittäissähkönmyynnin markkinajohtaja Suomessa. Tarjoamme sähkön, lämmön ja jäähdytyksen lisäksi ratkaisuja alueelliseen sekä uusiutuvaan energiaan. Vähennämme suunnitelmallisesti päästöjämme kehittäen fiksumpaa energiajärjestelmää tavoitteena nettonollapäästöt sekä polttoon perustuvasta energiantuotannosta irtautuminen vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Päästäksemme kunnianhimoisiin tavoitteisiimme ja palvellaksemme asiakkaitamme entistä sujuvammin, etsimme Process Development Manageria Kasvu ja asiakasdata -tiimiimme. Tehtävä on 18 kuukauden määräaikaisuus. Asiakkaan matka ensikontaktista uuden lämmitys- ja/tai jäähdytystuotteen tai -palvelun käyttöönottoon kulkee monen tiimin ja järjestelmän kautta. Haluamme tämän polun välittyvän asiakkaalle mahdollisimman sujuvana prosessina. Process Development Managerina rakennat kokonaiskuvan Lämpö ja jäähdytys -liiketoiminnan asiakasprosesseista ja viet niitä kohti yhtenäisempiä toimintatapoja. Tunnistat prosessien yhtäläisyyksiä, kipupisteitä ja hukkaa sekä etsit keinoja tehdä samankaltaiset asiat fiksummin, mahdollisuuksien mukaan yhdellä tavalla ja yhdellä järjestelmällä. Samalla rakennat pohjaa prosessiautomaatiolle ja tekoälyn hyödyntämiselle tunnistamalla prosesseissa käytettävän ja syntyvän datan. Roolissasi vastaat Liiketoiminnan asiakasprosessien end-to-end-kokonaisuuden rakentamisesta ja prosessikartasta Helenin prosessikäsikirjan ja -mallin mukaisesti. Priorisoitujen prosessien määrittelystä ja mallintamisesta prosessijärjestelmään Nykytilan kuvaamisesta yhdessä prosesseissa työskentelevien kanssa sekä kipupisteiden ja hukkien tunnistamisesta asiakkaan ja sisäisen tehokkuuden näkökulmasta. Prosessien ryhmittelystä ja lean-periaatteisiin perustuvista harmonisointiehdotuksista, jotka parantavat sekä asiakkaan kokemaa arvoa että sisäistä tehokkuutta. Prosesseissa käytettävien tietojärjestelmien ja työkalujen keskittämis- ja alasajoehdotuksista yhteistyössä Business Ownereiden, IT:n ja kokonaisarkkitehtuurin kanssa.Tuotosten hallitusta luovutuksesta prosessinomistajille ja ylläpitäjille sekä ylläpitomallista ja tulosten esittämisestä liiketoiminnan johdolle.Odotamme sinulta Soveltuvaa ylempää korkeakoulututkintoa, esimerkiksi tuotantotalouden, tietojärjestelmätieteen, kauppatieteiden tai energiatekniikan alalta Vähintään 5 vuoden kokemusta prosessien kehittämisestä, mallintamisesta, kokonaisarkkitehtuurista tai konsultoinnista Näyttöjä yksikkörajat ylittävästä kehitystyöstä ja muutosten läpiviennistä matriisiorganisaatiossaKokemusta prosessimallinnuksesta ja prosessimallinnustyökaluista (esim. IMS, QPR, ARIS tai Signavio)Vahvaa analyyttisuutta ja jäsentelykykyä - kykyä hahmottaa laajoja kokonaisuuksia ja nähdä niistä yhteneväisyydetHyviä vuorovaikutus- ja fasilitointitaitoja sekä taitoa sitouttaa eri yksiköiden asiantuntijat yhteiseen toimintamalliin ja esittää monitahoiset asiat selkeästi ja visuaalisestiItseohjautuvuutta ja tapaa viedä sovitut tuotokset maaliin aikataulussaEduksesi katsomme lean-osaamisen (esim. Green Belt), kokemuksen energia-alan (erityisesti kaukolämpö- ja jäähdytysliiketoiminnan) asiakasprosesseista sekä kokemuksen tekoälytyökalujen hyödyntämisestä. Tuleva tiimisi, Kasvu ja asiakasdata -tiimi, vastaa Helenin lämpö- ja jäähdytysliiketoiminnan asiakasdatasta, asiakastiedon hallinnasta, analytiikasta ja myynnin tukemisesta. Meillä prosessikaavio ei ole seinälle unohtuva taulu vaan työkalu, jolla asiakkaan arki helpottuu ja jonka päälle rakennetaan seuraavan sukupolven tekoälyavustajat. Hyvän lisän tiimiimme toisi rohkea uudistaja, joka uskaltaa haastaa ja tuoda uusia näkökulmia esiin - ihmisläheinen kollega, jonka kanssa isotkin muutokset ratkotaan yhdessä. Heleniläisenä pääset nauttimaan erilaisista henkilöstöeduistamme kuten hyväntekeväisyystyöpäivästä, vapaa-ajan tapaturvavakuutuksesta, etätyömahdollisuudesta ulkomailla, Flex-edusta ja henkilöstösähköstä. Toimistomme sijaitsee Ruoholahden We Landissa, ja työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla. Tehtävän palkka määritellään tehtävän vaativuuden sekä osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Kiinnostuitko? Mahtavaa! Voit lähettää hakemuksen rekryjärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään 29.11.2026. Huomioithan, että saatamme edetä rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana. Voit kysyä meillä työskentelystä ja tehtävästä tarkemmin tulevalta esihenkilöltäsi Johannes Isohookanalta (045 651 2490 / johannes.isohookana(at)helen.fi). Hän on parhaiten tavoitettavissa puhelimitse perjantaina 13.11. klo 9-11, torstaina 19.11. klo 13-15 tai keskiviikkona 25.11. klo 9-11. Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

jobs.title: Lead Software Developer, SCADA
jobs.description: Lead Software Developer. Siinä on energiaa - Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää! Me Helenissä tarjoamme helpompaa ja mutkattomampaa arkea kaikkialla Suomessa. jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that builds trust, sparks innovation, and strengthens team culture.

 

About Superhuman

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on it daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com.

 

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our Detection & Response Team to achieve our ambitious goals. This role will contribute to our D&R team as hands-on practitioner across incident response, detection engineering, threat hunting, and threat intelligence. You'll plan, execute, and debrief complex security operations, leveraging those insights to enhance our threat mitigation capabilities and build robust, automated security tooling across all Superhuman environments.

Additionally, you'll own key workstreams in executing and advancing our security vision, translating strategic objectives into tactical implementations through strong technical execution and innovative solution building, with particular emphasis on automation and AI-powered security solutions. You'll conduct research across security domains and automation technologies, identifying opportunities to enhance our capabilities through cutting-edge approaches and intelligent automation. Finally, you'll bring an attacker mindset into Superhuman’s engineering and security culture, thinking like a threat actor to defend our systems in a way that is grounded in how real attacks happen.

Superhuman's engineers and researchers have the freedom to innovate and uncover breakthroughs—and, in turn, influence our product roadmap. The complexity of our technical challenges is growing rapidly as we scale our interfaces, algorithms, and infrastructure. Curious how we build and operate our AI agents? Check out our engineering blog, and explore our threat-hunting AI here.

As a Security Engineer, you will:

  • Own the IR strategy end-to-end, building, maintaining, and operating the systems and tooling that strengthen our ability to detect, contain, and recover from security incidents at scale

  • Build and maintain automated threat detection systems, AI-driven alert triage solutions, and security intelligence pipelines that scale with business growth

  • Conduct threat hunting and detection engineering, developing detection-as-code, hunting-as-code, and intelligence-as-code capabilities.

  • Research and develop cutting-edge security automation and AI-powered security solutions to deepen and scale our ability to identify threats, including autonomous security agents.

  • Operate without traditional scope limitations, following attacker kill chains to uncover security gaps that scoped teams miss.

  • Lead complex security investigations, including insider threat scenarios and sophisticated attack campaigns.

  • Maintain incident response capabilities and serve as part of the Incident Command on-call schedule.

  • Embed attacker mindset thinking throughout the organization through education and collaboration with engineering teams.

Qualifications

  • Has 3+ years of relevant experience in security engineering, with expertise across multiple disciplines including incident response and detection engineering (threat intelligence, threat hunting experience is nice to have too)

  • Proven incident response leadership and complex security investigation experience.

  • Automation and development skills in Python, Go, or similar languages, with experience building production security tooling.

  • Knowledge of cloud security architecture.

  • Research mindset with an ability to identify novel attack vectors and develop creative, pragmatic solutions.

  • Thrives in ambiguous environments and can deliver meaningful results at a rapid pace while managing multiple competing priorities.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with CI/CD security integration, identity and access management concepts, and security orchestration.

  • Experience with large-scale Kubernetes clusters.

  • Background in AI/ML applications for security, including experience with or interest in developing autonomous security systems.

 

Compensation and Benefits

  • Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

 

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.

For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

Compensation: €80K – €150K

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Key Account Management Team


Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.
We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe on Public Sector accounts (Ministries and other public entities).
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?


As a Key Account Manager, you will:

  • Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts in the Public Sector

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships with key stakeholders and display a customer-centric approach to identify the main needs and allow our clients to achieve their goals through Alan

  • Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them

  • Ensure successful onboarding of new accounts and promote Alan health partner positioning to generate massive adoption by employees and admins

  • Analyze and present consumption reports to customers through business reviews

  • Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing customers

  • Renegotiate contracts to guarantee both great value for money to our customers and sustainable profitability

  • Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • You have at least 6 years of experience in a customer-facing role including frequent interactions with C-Levels

  • You have full working proficiency in French (excellent oral and written communication)

  • You have at least advanced level in English

  • You are experienced in dealing with very large organizations and potentially with unions

  • You have the tact and empathy that make great negotiators

  • You are an expert in positive lobbying with key stakeholders and create long-term relationship based on trust and transparency

  • You are very analytical, very comfortable with presenting deep data analysis to clients and solving complex problems

  • You have great active listening skills and are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message

  • You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market

  • You are currently based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux or Marseille.


It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits. Having experience with or within the Public Sector space is also a nice to have.


For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-E level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Bordeaux or Marseille.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your  time as you  wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly  flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

  • Measurement: Set KPIs for every project (reach in the target, qualified leads, pipeline influenced, brand perception). Run test-and-learn with Growth and Data. Manage budgets, vendors and deadlines.

  • Have 7+ years of in-house brand marketing (B2C, B2B or B2B2C). Paid media or media planning is a big plus.

  • Have led at least two B2B campaigns or brand projects end to end, and can walk us through the problem, your choices and the measurable result.

  • Have managed agencies and budgets and made trade-offs when resources were tight.

  • Are a generalist across campaigns, content, partnerships, events and PR, with sharp creative judgment you can defend with senior stakeholders.

  • Set brand KPIs and link brand work to pipeline or lead quality.

jobs.title: Research Scientist – Foundation Models and Multimodal AI
jobs.description:
About us

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.
Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.
K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK, Germany.

Please submit your CV in English

About the role:

 We are seeking a driven Research Scientist with hands-on expertise in Foundation Models (FMs) and Multimodal AI to help drive the next phase of our machine learning platform.

In this role, you will bridge cutting-edge AI research and practical application. Rather than training massive base models from scratch, your focus will be on fine-tuning, adapting, and aligning open-weights foundation models across diverse data modalities (e.g. structured tabular data, single-cell scRNA-seq, image representations, and natural language) to build multimodal systems.

 

In particular, you will be responsible for:

  • Model adaptation and optimization: Adapt, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art open-source foundation models (e.g., domain-specific transformers, vision-language models) using fine-tuning and transfer learning strategies.

  • Multimodal integration: Design and implement cross-modal alignment architectures (e.g., contrastive learning, projection heads, unified embedding spaces) to fuse structured, sequential, and text/image data layers.

  • Pipeline and evaluation engineering: Build rigorous, domain-tailored benchmarking frameworks and evaluation pipelines to validate model reliability, generalization, and downstream task performance.

  • Applied R&D collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams (data engineers, domain specialists, and software engineers) to integrate adapted models into scalable production and inference workflows.

  • Low-hanging fruit innovation: Identify high-impact, incremental improvements in data pre-processing, embedding representation, and fine-tuning to maximize model performance without unnecessary computational overhead. 

 

About you

Required qualifications / experience:

  • Education: Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.

  • Experience: 2-4 years of post-degree experience applying deep learning and foundation models to complex datasets.

  • Foundation models: Demonstrated experience adapting and fine-tuning foundation models.

  • Multimodal learning: Proven experience with cross-modal representation learning, joint embedding alignment (e.g., CLIP-style architectures), or vision-language models.

  • Technical stack:

    • Advanced proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face ecosystem).

    • Hands-on experience with fine-tuning techniques.

    • Familiarity with data engineering tools for handling large-scale or multi-modal datasets (Parquet, AnnData, HDF5).

 Preferred qualifications/bonus:

  • Experience working with biological or omics data (e.g., scRNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, clinical and/or histology data).

  • Experience deploying or scaling models using containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

  • Track record of open-source contributions or peer-reviewed publications at top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR) or domain-specific journals.

 

 #LI-HB1

What we offer

  • Flexible work organization

  • Friendly and informal working environment

  • Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds

Recruitment Process & Security

  • Please complete the form and submit your CV.

  • Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

  • Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

  • Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

  • Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Ashby).

  • The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com.

  • The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

  • Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

  • Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/

  • Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities

  • Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address contact the following authorities:

    • [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/

    • [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime

    • [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

jobs.title: Commercial Lead - Dämmung (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

Wir bauen das größte Dämmungsunternehmen Deutschlands. Willst du von Anfang an dabei sein?

Vor wenigen Monaten haben wir Dämmung als eigenständiges Geschäftsfeld bei Enpal gestartet, und wir wachsen schnell. In dieser Rolle gestaltest du den Aufbau entscheidend mit. Du verantwortest Themen entlang des gesamten Funnels, von der ersten Kundenanfrage bis zur Installation, arbeitest eng mit dem Leadership zusammen und siehst unmittelbar, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.

  • Du ownst die Business Cases für neue Initiativen und Angebote und entscheidest mit, was wir skalieren.

  • Du verantwortest die Performance unseres Funnels vom Lead bis zur Installation und setzt an den Hebeln an, die am meisten bewegen.

  • Du orchestrierst Projekte zwischen Sales, Operations und Bau und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen unser Angebot und unseren Pitch weiter.

  • Du treibst Automatisierung und KI voran, damit unsere Prozesse mit dem Wachstum Schritt halten.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung in Venture Development, Business Development, Strategy oder Consulting mit, gerne auch aus einem Startup oder Scale-up.

  • Du bist zahlenaffin und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten.

  • Du denkst analytisch und in Prozessen und gehst trotzdem gern neue Wege.

  • Hohes Tempo und wechselnde Prioritäten motivieren dich, statt dich zu bremsen.

  • Du hast bereits Projekte mit vielen Beteiligten zum Erfolg gebracht und überzeugst durch klare Kommunikation.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, übernimmst Ownership und kommst auch ohne fertige Strukturen schnell ins Handeln.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

  • Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. jobs.description:
Enpal.Cool: Eine neue Abteilung mit Start-up-Spirit

Berlin/Brandenburg | 70.000 € OTE | ungedeckelte Provision | vor Ort

Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie möglich – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox und Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Mit Enpal.Cool bauen wir eine neue Abteilung für moderne Klima- und Energielösungen auf. Gesucht werden starke Sales Manager:innen im Raum Berlin/Brandenburg, die Lust haben, von Tag 1 an Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Team etwas Neues aufzubauen.

Die Mission

Das Verkaufstalent kommt zum Einsatz, um in jedem Gespräch durch Kompetenz und Überzeugungskraft aus vorqualifizierten Interessent:innen erfolgreiche Aufträge zu generieren. Dabei geht es nicht nur um den Verkauf eines Produkts: Die Lösungen verbessern die Lebensqualität von Menschen und machen ihre Energieversorgung zukunftsfähig.

Der typische Tag

  • Das Pre-Sales-Team stellt täglich vorqualifizierte Termine bereit.

  • Ein modernes CRM-System sorgt für transparente Prozesse, effiziente Arbeitsabläufe und einen jederzeit guten Überblick über die Kund:innen.

  • Die enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertriebsteam und die aktive Mitgestaltung der entstehenden Prozesse gehören zur Rolle.

  • Das Team arbeitet eng zusammen und entwickelt die neue Abteilung mit viel Dynamik und echtem Start-up-Spirit.

Das Profil

Gesucht wird eine Person, die:

  • Gespräche gezielt lenken und konzentriert auf einen erfolgreichen Abschluss hinarbeiten kann,

  • motiviert ist, Ziele nicht nur zu erreichen, sondern zu übertreffen,

  • auch in herausfordernden Situationen ruhig, fokussiert und lösungsorientiert bleibt,

  • echte B2C-Vertriebserfahrung mitbringt

  • schnell ins Handeln kommt, Eigenantrieb zeigt und keine langen Anlaufzeiten braucht,

  • aufgeweckt, dynamisch und hungrig auf Ergebnisse ist,

  • gerne im Team arbeitet und zu einer positiven, produktiven Atmosphäre beiträgt,

  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mitbringt.

Auch mit wenig Erfahrung, zum Beispiel rund einem Jahr Berufserfahrung, ist eine Bewerbung willkommen. Entscheidend ist nicht, dass bereits jede Anforderung perfekt erfüllt wird, sondern dass Drive, Lernbereitschaft und echtes Entwicklungspotenzial vorhanden sind.

  • 70.000 € OTE und ungedeckelte Provision 😊

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle beim Aufbau von Enpal.Cool

  • Warme Leads und ein klarer Fokus auf erfolgreiche Kundengespräche

  • Vorqualifizierte Termine pro Tag durch das Pre-Sales-Team

  • Ein eng zusammenarbeitendes Team mit echtem Start-up-Spirit

  • Kurze Wege, viel Dynamik und die Chance, Prozesse von Anfang an mitzugestalten

  • Ein modernes CRM-System und transparente Arbeitsabläufe

  • Eine Aufgabe mit echtem Impact: Lösungen, die morgen sauberen Strom und mehr Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen

Arbeitsort

Die Rolle ist grundsätzlich auf tägliche Präsenz im Office in Berlin/Brandenburg ausgelegt. Die neue Abteilung soll gemeinsam vor Ort aufgebaut werden.

Für außergewöhnliche Top-1-%-Talente, die zwingend eine Remote-Lösung benötigen, kann im Einzelfall eine individuelle Lösung geprüft werden.

Interesse?

Nicht alle Anforderungen werden erfüllt? Das ist kein Ausschlusskriterium. Wenn Energie, Ehrgeiz, B2C-Vertriebserfahrung und Lust auf echten Aufbau vorhanden sind, freuen wir uns auf eine Kontaktaufnahme und ein unverbindliches Erstgespräch.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst das Onboarding neuer Vertriebspartner sowie ihrer Vertriebler und begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

  • Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich die Planung, Organisation und Durchführung von vertrieblichen Veranstaltungen im Bereich PV und erneuerbare Energien, um Vertriebspartner bei der Erweiterung ihres Portfolios zu unterstützen.

  • Du begleitest bei Bedarf unsere Vertriebspartner zu Kundenterminen vor Ort, um den Verkaufsprozess aktiv zu fördern und den direkten Austausch zu stärken.

  • Du leistest hierbei aktive Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Vertragsabschlüssen und trägst so direkt zum gemeinsamen Geschäftserfolg bei.

  • Du pflegst ein professionelles Relationship Management zu lokalen Führungskräften der Vertriebspartner und repräsentierst unser Unternehmen in allen Interaktionen souverän und überzeugend.

Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung. Du bist aber auch offen, dich in neue Themen wie PV-Vertrieb einzuarbeiten. Erfahrung in einem großen Finanzvertrieb ist ein Plus.

  • Du bringst eine ausgeprägte Eigenmotivation sowie hohe Resilienz mit und bewältigst auch anspruchsvolle Situationen zielorientiert und erfolgreich.

  • Du bist es gewohnt, viel unterwegs zu sein, und schätzt den direkten Austausch mit Vertriebspartnern sowie Kunden vor Ort.

  • Du beherrschst die deutsche Sprache fließend in Wort und Schrift, weitere Sprachkenntnisse wie Türkisch, Russisch, Polnisch oder Rumänisch sind von Vorteil.

jobs.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

As a Technical Delivery Manager at Legora, you will play a central role in ensuring customers successfully deploy, integrate, and adopt our AI-native platform. You'll lead end-to-end technical implementations, act as the primary technical point of contact, and shape how seamlessly new customers go live and scale within Legora.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead integration projects from kickoff through go-live, owning technical documentation, test plans, and rollout execution to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery

  • Serve as the dedicated technical point of contact during implementation and early adoption, including proactive monitoring and regular stakeholder updates through go-live and the post-rollout period

  • Configure and support customer environments including SSO, DMS integrations (iManage, SharePoint, NetDocuments), and API-based connections

  • Provide dedicated post-rollout technical support for enterprise clients, troubleshooting advanced issues and driving high customer satisfaction

  • Coordinate across Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success to align on requirements and ensure a smooth rollout experience

  • Deliver technical training and guidance to customer teams on configuration, workflows, and best practices

  • Feed insights from delivery projects back to product and engineering to improve future implementations

Who You Are

  • Proven experience in technical delivery, implementation, or a similar customer-facing technical role

  • Strong hands-on experience with SSO, authentication protocols, and enterprise integrations (DMS platforms, APIs)

  • Excellent project management skills with a structured, proactive approach to managing multiple parallel projects

  • Able to translate technical concepts clearly for non-technical audiences

  • Strong communicator who builds trusted relationships across customer and internal teams

  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Professional proficiency in French or German

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation: €90K – €105K
