jobs.title: IT Administrator - (Senior) IT Administrator
jobs.description:
Apex.AI is an international software company developing safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility and autonomous systems. Our technology enables companies to build software-defined vehicles and intelligent machines faster, safer, and more efficiently. 

We are looking for a hands-on IT Administrator / (Senior) IT Administrator to take ownership of the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of our IT environment in Germany while supporting our international teams. 

This is a highly practical role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, administering systems, supporting users, and continuously improving IT infrastructure. You will work across Linux and macOS endpoints, identity and access management, cloud services, networks, security tooling, and on-premises infrastructure. 

You will be a key point of contact for IT topics in our Munich office and work closely with Engineering, DevOps, HR, and other business functions. 

In addition to your core IT responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to develop your knowledge of Information Security and compliance, including ISO 27001 and TISAX. Previous compliance experience is welcome but not required—we are looking for someone who is interested in learning and growing in this area. 

As Apex.AI grows, this role offers the opportunity to take on broader ownership and help shape the future of our IT function. 

 
This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in Germany is required.

What You’ll Do

Hands-on IT Administration 

  • Own and manage the day-to-day operation of our cloud and on-premises IT environment.  

  • Administer and support Linux and macOS endpoints throughout their lifecycle.  

  • Manage MDM, IAM, user accounts, permissions, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Administer cloud-based email, collaboration, and file-storage services.  

  • Manage employee access across internal systems and business applications.  

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot wired and wireless networks.  

  • Manage VPN solutions, network segmentation, policies, and access rules.  

  • Administer and maintain on-premises and cloud-based servers.  

  • Manage endpoint security solutions, including EDR/antivirus, patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Implement and maintain integrations between different IT systems.  

  • Automate repetitive IT administration tasks wherever possible.  

  • Monitor systems and proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact users.  

    • IT Support & Service Delivery 

  • Be a primary point of contact for IT support for employees in our Munich office and provide remote support to colleagues in other locations.  

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, endpoint, network, account, and access issues.  

  • Manage IT support requests and ensure issues are resolved efficiently.  

  • Set up laptops, accounts, permissions, and required applications for new employees.  

  • Execute IT onboarding and offboarding for employees and contractors.  

  • Manage IT hardware inventory and device lifecycle.  

  • Maintain clear and useful technical documentation.  

  • Help create a reliable and user-friendly IT environment where employees can work effectively with minimal friction.  

    • IT Security & Compliance 

    You will have the opportunity to learn how to manage ISMS based on ISO 27001 and TISAX frameworks. We are looking for someone eager to develop in this area. 

    You will: 

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of technical security controls.  

  • Help maintain IT documentation, policies, procedures, asset inventories, and access records.  

  • Support evidence collection and technical preparation for ISO 27001 and TISAX audits.  

  • Work with internal and external stakeholders on Information Security topics.  

  • Support vulnerability management, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and security incident readiness.  

  • Help investigate and resolve IT security incidents.  

  • Gradually develop your knowledge of our ISMS and security/compliance requirements.  

  • Contribute ideas for improving the security and resilience of our IT environment.  

    • Collaboration & Continuous Improvement 

  • Work closely with Engineering and DevOps on infrastructure, access, networking, and security topics.  

  • Support business applications used by HR, Sales, Finance, Legal, and other teams.  

  • Work with IT vendors and service providers when required.  

  • Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to our IT environment.  

  • Support the secure adoption of AI tools and emerging technologies.  

  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and simplification.  


    • What you bring

  • Several years of hands-on experience as an IT Administrator, System Administrator, IT Engineer, or similar role.  

  • Strong hands-on experience administering Linux and/or macOS environments, with a willingness to become proficient across both.  

  • Experience with endpoint and device management, including MDM, centralized patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Experience with IAM, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Experience administering cloud-based productivity and collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.  

  • Solid networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, Wi-Fi, VPNs, VLANs, and firewalls.  

  • Experience administering servers and working with on-premises infrastructure.  

  • Understanding of endpoint security, backups, monitoring, and logging.  

  • Basic scripting or automation skills using Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.  

  • A practical troubleshooting mindset and willingness to investigate problems independently.  

  • Comfortable supporting users directly—from simple endpoint issues to more complex infrastructure problems.  

  • Ability to document technical processes clearly.  

  • Fluent English; German language skills are a must (C1 level).  


    • For the Senior IT Administrator level

    Candidates considered for the Senior IT Administrator level should additionally bring:

  • 5+ years of relevant hands-on IT administration or systems engineering experience, ideally in a technical or engineering-driven environment.
  • Strong hands-on expertise across Linux and macOS, with the ability to independently troubleshoot complex endpoint and system issues.
  • Proven experience taking ownership of MDM, IAM, SSO/MFA, endpoint security, networking, and access management.
  • Strong networking knowledge with practical experience configuring and troubleshooting VPNs, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, Wi-Fi, and firewalls.
  • Experience independently owning technical projects from solution design and implementation through documentation and ongoing operation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoints, networks, cloud services, identity, and infrastructure, with the ability to resolve complex issues without relying primarily on external providers.
  • Experience using scripting and automation to improve IT operations and reduce repetitive manual work.
  • Ability to proactively identify weaknesses in an existing IT environment and independently propose and implement secure, scalable improvements.
  • Experience acting as a technical escalation point and supporting or mentoring less experienced colleagues.
  • Ability to work confidently with Engineering and DevOps teams and communicate effectively with highly technical stakeholders.
  • A strong security mindset and interest in taking increasing ownership of Information Security, ISO 27001, TISAX, and ISMS-related topics.

    • Previous hands-on experience supporting ISO 27001, TISAX, an ISMS, or security audits is an advantage for the Senior level, but not required.

    Most importantly, you: 

  • Enjoy being hands-on and solving technical problems yourself.  

  • Take ownership instead of simply escalating issues to someone else.  

  • Are comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask for help.  

  • Enjoy working with highly technical software engineers and learning from subject-matter experts.  

  • Are curious about new technologies and continuously develop your skills.  

  • Want to broaden your experience beyond traditional IT administration into Information Security, ISO 27001, and TISAX.  

    •  


    Nice to have

  • Experience with JumpCloud or similar MDM/IAM platforms.  

  • Experience with Google Workspace administration.  

  • Experience with AWS services such as EC2, EBS, IAM, or RDS.  

  • Experience with EDR, vulnerability management, monitoring, or logging solutions.  

  • Experience supporting developer or engineering environments.  

  • Familiarity with CI/CD infrastructure and version-control systems.  

  • Previous exposure to ISO 27001, TISAX, ISMS, or security audits.  

  • IT or security certifications such as CompTIA, ITIL, CCNA, or similar.  

  • Interest or experience in AI/LLM technologies and their secure use within an enterprise environment.  


    • Why Apex.AI

  • Take real ownership of a modern IT environment rather than simply managing external providers.  

  • Work closely with world-class software engineers developing cutting-edge platforms for autonomous and software-defined systems.  

  • Gain hands-on exposure to an engineering-focused environment spanning Linux, macOS, cloud, networking, security, and developer infrastructure.  

  • Grow your Information Security expertise through practical exposure to ISO 27001, TISAX, security controls, audits, and ISMS processes.  

  • Have a direct impact on how our IT environment evolves as the company grows.  

  • Work in an international, engineering-driven culture where technical curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.  

  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for professional and career development.  

    • About Apex.AI

    Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

    The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

    • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
    • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

    Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

    • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
    • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

    Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

jobs.title: Klasselærer søges til udskolingen
jobs.description:
Vi søger en engageret og relationsstærk lærer til vores udskoling

 Aalborg Steinerskole søger en lærer med klasselærerfunktion til vores samlæste 7., 8. og 9. klasse.

 Brænder du for at skabe stærke relationer, trygge læringsmiljøer og meningsfuld undervisning? Er du en alsidig lærer, der trives med at undervise på tværs af fag og klassetrin? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Om stillingen

Vi søger en engageret og fagligt velfunderet lærer, der kan varetage klasselærerfunktionen i vores samlæste udskolingsklasse med elever fra 7., 8. og 9. årgang.

 Klassen rummer elever med forskellige faglige og sociale forudsætninger, og derfor lægger vi særlig vægt på stærke relationskompetencer, tydelig klasseledelse og evnen til at møde den enkelte elev med forståelse, nærvær og passende forventninger.

Som klasselærer bliver du en central voksen i elevernes skolehverdag og får en vigtig rolle i at skabe sammenhæng, struktur og trivsel i klassen.

Undervisningen spænder bredt over skolens fag, og vi søger derfor en lærer, der er tryg ved at undervise alsidigt og kan tilrettelægge differentieret undervisning på tværs af de tre klassetrin.

Vi søger dig, der:

Har stærke relationskompetencer og formår at skabe tillidsfulde relationer til både elever og forældre.

Er en tydelig, omsorgsfuld og nærværende klasseleder.

Er tryg ved at undervise i alle grundskolens fag og har mod på at arbejde tværfagligt.

Kan differentiere undervisningen og tilgodese elever på forskellige faglige niveauer.

Har blik for både den enkelte elevs udvikling og klassens samlede fællesskab.

Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og fleksibelt.

Ser et tæt og konstruktivt forældresamarbejde som en naturlig del af klasselærerrollen.

Har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til et mindre skolefællesskab, hvor samarbejde og gensidig støtte vægtes højt.

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har undervisningskompetence i fysik/kemi, men det er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste for os er dine menneskelige og pædagogiske kompetencer samt din lyst til at gøre en forskel for eleverne.

 

Vi tilbyder

En mindre udskolingsklasse med mulighed for at opbygge tætte og betydningsfulde relationer.

En alsidig arbejdsdag med stor indflydelse på undervisningens tilrettelæggelse.

Et tæt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper og støtter hinanden.

Mulighed for at arbejde kreativt, praksisorienteret og tværfagligt.

En skolehverdag, hvor elevernes trivsel, faglige udvikling og fællesskab er i centrum.

 

Arbejdstider

Den faste undervisningstid er som udgangspunkt fordelt således:

Mandag: 8.15–12.55

Tirsdag: 8.15–13.55

Onsdag: 8.15–13.55

Torsdag: 8.15–13.55

Fredag: 8.15–12.55

 

Derudover må der påberegnes tid til forberedelse, møder, skole-hjem-samarbejde og øvrige opgaver knyttet til klasselærerfunktionen.

 

Ansøgning og tiltrædelse

Ansøgningsfrist:

Løbende - vi indkalder til samtaler løbende

Tiltrædelse: hurtigst muligt

 

Ansøgning sendes til: kontor@aalborgsteinerskole.dk

 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte skolens ledelse på tlf.: 27587452 i følgende tidsrum: kl. 8.15-9.15; 13-14 og efter kl. 15

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

  • Stipt en je werkt in overleg met je klant.
  • Betrouwbaarheid en respect voor de privacy van je klant zijn voor jou vanzelfsprekend.

jobs.title: Operations & Strategy Manager - Energy Markets
jobs.description:
Operations & Strategy Manager

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

 

Our mission for you

European energy costs are twice as high as in the US and China, and electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. This puts European industry under massive cost pressure – and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that brings together energy procurement, energy management and the marketing of flexible assets in one product. This helps companies save up to 30% on their recurring electricity costs while switching to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast – the market window is open and we intend to own it.

Now we are looking for an Operations & Strategy Manager to own a business-critical part of our energy value chain: the processes behind how we configure, price and quote long-term energy products for our customers.

 

About trawa

trawa is a tech-driven scale-up based in Berlin with around 100 employees, combining deep energy market expertise with in-house software development. We've raised over €35M to date, most recently a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic and Tiny VC. This role is based in our Berlin office, where we work together in person most of the week. We offer flexible working hours, so you can shape your day in a way that works for you.

 

The Team

You'll join our Energy & Trading team, which owns the energy side of our business – from sourcing and portfolio management to making sure our customers' energy products work in practice. You'll report directly to our Energy & Trading Manager and work closely with the COO, our Trading Team, Sales, Pricing, Product and Tech. You start without direct reports, but with a clear mandate: own our CPQ process end-to-end and grow the margin it generates.

 

Who we are looking for

  • Strong quantitative skills: You think analytically, feel at home with numbers and data and can confidently challenge quantitative results – without having to be a quant or developer yourself. Ideally, you have a degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g. economics, engineering, industrial engineering, business administration).

  • Business acumen & process mindset: You think commercially, care about margins and unit economics, enjoy turning messy processes into robust, scalable ones and prioritise by impact. Experience with commercial processes such as pricing or deal desks, in energy, financial services or any other industry, is a plus.

  • Interest in energy markets: You are fascinated by how energy markets work – from wholesale and forward markets to PPAs, hedging and pricing – and want to dive deep into them. Knowledge of the German energy market is a plus; experience in (energy) trading is explicitly not required – what matters is your drive to understand the mechanics and make the processes behind them work.

  • Hungry & ambitious: You want to grow fast, take on responsibility early and set high standards for yourself. You don't wait for instructions and enjoy a steep learning curve, and work experience in a high-paced environment, e.g. a start-up, scale-up or consulting, is a plus.

  • High ownership & structured execution: You drive topics end-to-end, align stakeholders across departments and turn ideas into scalable processes with tangible business impact. An affinity for AI-powered tools and automation to make processes faster and smarter is a plus.

  • Strong communication: You speak German at native level and very good English, and you translate confidently between commercial, quantitative and operational perspectives.

What you'll do

As Operations & Strategy Manager, you combine a strong analytical mind with process excellence and commercial drive:

  • Own our CPQ process: You take end-to-end ownership of our CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) processes for long-term energy products – from the customer request through pricing and offer creation to trade execution, across Sales, Pricing, Trading and Operations and for all our customer segments. You make this process faster, more robust and scalable.

  • Stabilise and grow our margins: Our customers hedge their energy costs with long-term products from us, such as PPAs and Futures/Forwards. You are responsible for stabilising our margins on these hedges and increasing them in the medium term – covering a multi-million euro gross margin.

  • Pave the way to more complex products: Over the past three years, we have shown that we can profitably price, buy and sell energy. You build on that foundation and develop our long-term offering towards more complex, higher-margin products that fit our customers' needs even better.

  • Bridge between trading and business: You work closely with our quant trading and data science team and turn their models and insights into processes and systems that work across teams and markets – so that pricing, risk and market insights reliably translate into better decisions and products for our customers.

 

90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding):

  • Business understanding: You have understood trawa's business, product and energy value chain in detail and got to know all relevant internal and external stakeholders.

  • Portfolio knowledge: You understand our long-term product portfolio (PPAs, Futures/Forwards), our customers' hedging needs and how pricing, margins and risk come together in our offers.

  • CPQ mapping: You have mapped our current CPQ process – from customer request and pricing to offer creation and trade execution – and identified the key pain points and margin levers.

Month 3 (Ramp-Up):

  • Go-to CPQ owner: You are the go-to person for our CPQ process and have implemented first improvements that make it faster and more robust.

  • Margin transparency: You have created transparency on our margins across long-term hedges and derived first measures to stabilise them.

  • Target process: You have designed a target CPQ process, started its implementation and proposed first, more complex products for our long-term offering.

 

Why us?

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity – most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your work will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning and career progression.

Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply – you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

jobs.title: Staff Frontend Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.


Your Role

As a Staff Frontend Engineer at bunch, you will shape the architecture, quality, and developer experience of the product surfaces our customers and internal teams rely on every day. You will work across product teams to make our frontend systems scalable, reliable, accessible, and fast — while helping engineers ship with clarity and confidence.

This is not only a delivery role. Your decisions will influence how frontend engineering at bunch evolves: the standards we adopt, the patterns we reuse, the quality bar we hold, and the way product, design, and engineering collaborate to build excellent user experiences.

How the role contributes to our vision

bunch is building the backbone of private markets, combining exceptional expertise, operational excellence, and frictionless technology. Our platform enables funds and private investors to seamlessly and securely set up and manage their investment entities.

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in turning complex workflows into intuitive, robust, and scalable product experiences. You will help ensure our frontend foundation enables rapid delivery across teams while maintaining high standards for usability, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

Top priorities

  1. Lead our migration from Svelte to React. Hold the architectural picture across both stacks, sequence the work against product delivery, and land it without stalling teams.

  2. Maintain and evolve our design system, together with the frontend guild, so product teams ship consistent, accessible UI faster.

  3. Support and guide frontend initiatives across teams, with the frontend guild — application architecture, performance, testing strategy, developer experience, and technical debt reduction — from diagnosis through measurable delivery.

  4. Be the bar raiser for UX and UI quality, raising the standard through design reviews, reusable patterns, mentoring, and thoughtful technical writing.

  5. Advance how we build with AI — find where agentic tooling genuinely improves engineering practice, and shape the codebase (module boundaries, API contracts, documentation) so it works well for people and agents alike.

Your first 90 days

  • 30 days: map the frontend architecture, product domains, design system, team workflows, and the main bottlenecks affecting delivery and quality.

  • 60 days: publish a structured problem analysis and proposal for one cross-team frontend initiative with clear trade-offs, stakeholders, and success measures.

  • 90 days: lead a systemic improvement from kickoff to measurable progress across teams, while helping Senior Engineers grow through collaboration, reviews, and shared ownership.

About you

  • Track record — You have already operated at Staff scope, with or without the title, and have shipped systemic frontend or product-engineering improvements across multiple teams. People listen to you because of what you have delivered, how clearly you think, and how effectively you collaborate.

  • Frontend craft — Deep expertise in modern frontend engineering, with strong command of TypeScript, component architecture, state management, design systems, accessibility, performance, testing, and maintainable application architecture.

  • AI-native practice — You use AI coding tools daily and have gone past autocomplete into agentic workflows. You have a considered view on where they genuinely help, where they don't, and what a codebase needs to be a good place to work in with agents.

  • Product judgment — You care about the user experience as much as the technical solution. You can translate ambiguous workflows and business constraints into pragmatic, elegant product experiences.

  • Systems thinking — You are comfortable reasoning across frontend, backend, APIs, infrastructure, observability, security, and compliance when the problem requires it.

  • Operating style — You think in quarters and years, not only sprints. You drive cross-team change through credibility, clear writing, architectural reasoning, and strong stakeholder alignment — not through authority.

  • Collaborative Leadership: A proactive relationship-builder who can set technical direction and influence without formal authority, manage diverse stakeholders and build alignment on difficult technical decisions, while mentoring engineers.

  • Language — Fluent English, written and spoken. You can make complex technical decisions legible to engineers, product partners, design partners, and leadership alike.

Our tech stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Svelte — we are consolidating on React, and this role leads that migration.

  • Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js

  • Database: MySQL

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS

  • Source Control & CI/CD: GitHub

  • Authentication: FusionAuth, Okta

  • Internal Tools: Retool

  • Messaging: Twilio, SendGrid

  • Forms: Tally

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid setup

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. Initial screening with Talent Acquisition (30 min): get acquainted with bunch, explore your motivation, and understand whether what we offer matches what you are looking for.

  2. Hiring Manager call — Engineering (60 min): a conversation with Engineering leadership focused on your scope, frontend leadership, product-engineering mindset, and how you diagnose and lead systemic improvements.

  3. Technical Interview (60 min): a hands-on technical conversation focused on frontend engineering craft, TypeScript, component design, maintainability, testing, and pragmatic problem-solving.

  4. Technical Interview — System Design (60 min): a frontend/system design conversation focused on architecture, data flow, performance, accessibility, reliability, and trade-offs in complex product systems.

  5. VP Product conversation (45 min): a cross-functional conversation focused on product thinking, customer empathy, business acumen, and how you partner with Product and Design on ambiguous problems.

  6. Final round (45 min): a closing conversation to align on what we heard across the process, answer remaining questions, and discuss expectations for the role and trial period.

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

(Active Directory)    Erfarenhet utav CISCO.Personliga egenskaper:Som person är du är driven och kan ta självständiga beslut samt har ett stort ansvarskännande. Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.Vad kan Försvarsmakten erbjuda dig?I Försvarsmakten finns en stark värdegrund där såväl professionell utveckling som personlig hälsa ryms. Något av det vi erbjuder:    Utbildningar, certifieringar och seminarier utifrån verksamhetens behov och dina karriärsmål.    Träning på arbetstid 3 timmar per vecka och du kan även få träningskläder samt ersättning för träningsskor och startavgifter.    Flexibel arbetstid.    Semesterdagar efter ålder. 28 dagar under 31 år, därefter 31 dagar och vid 40 år 35 dagar.    Extra föräldralön vid föräldraledighet och VAB samt extra sjuklön och möjlighet att växla semesterdagar mot extra pensionsavsättning.Övrigt:I Försvarsmakten benämns tjänsten Driftingenjör.Befattning: Civil.Tjänstgöringsgrad: Heltid, dagtid.Placeringsort: Hästveda.Tjänsteresor inrikes förekommer i arbetet. jobs.title: Maintenance job in Gyro gearloose’s workshop.
jobs.description:
Vedligeholdelses job i Georg Gearløs’ værksted.

Vi søger en ny kreativ vedligeholdelses medarbejder til vores team. Vi er en unik dansk niche virksomhed, som kan tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende hverdag i et internationalt miljø. Nordisk Perlite er en dansk familie ejet virksomhed. Vi er en niche virksomhed og den eneste af sin slags i Skandinavien med eksport til det meste af Europa. Vi er en solid virksomhed med en bred kunde portefølje, som har ambitioner for fremtiden og er i vækst.  Vores team består af 30 motiveret medarbejdere flere med international baggrund. 

Vi søger en vedligeholdelses medarbejder, som kan blive en del af vores engageret team, som er motiveret for at få tingene til at lykkedes. Du vil få en varierende hverdag, hvor dagene sjældent vil være ens. Jobbet består i: Vedligeholdelse af maskiner som bliver udsat for et hårdt produktionsmiljø. Optimere på produktionsmaskinerne sammen med kollegaer.Udbygge og udvikle på vores produktionsapparat og bygninger. Være en del af projekter fra start til slut.

Vi er en virksomhed som udfordrer den kreative sjæl og laver mange ting fra bunden. Det giver derfor en god mulighed for at få en varierende og spændende hverdag, hvor man kan blive udfordret på de fleste af ens fagkundskaber og kreativitet.

Er du til:

·         At pusle med opgaver både inde og ude af værkstedet

·         Store konstruktioner som skal laves fra bunden selvstændigt eller i teams

·         Kompliceret og simple udfordringer

·         At finde på kreative løsninger

·         Alsidige og varierende arbejdsopgaver

Du har erfaring med:

·         Manuelle maskiner (drejebænk/ fræser)

·         Lidt svejse kendskab

·         Gaffeltruck, gummihjulslæser (gummiged), lift mm.

Arbejdstider vil primært foregå mandag til torsdag 7.00-16.00 og fredag 7.00-13.30. Der vil dog kunne forekomme enkelt dage udenfor dette tidsrum i løbet af et arbejdsår.

Kunne jobbet være noget for dig? Og har du en teknisk baggrund så er du muligvis den vi søger. Hvis vi har fanget din interesse så din ansøgning til Job@nordiskperlite.dk.

_______________________________

 

 

 

 

Maintenance job in Gyro gearloose’s workshop.

We’re seeking a new and creative maintenance employee for our team. We’re an unique Danish niche company, that can offer an exciting and challenging work life in an international environment. 

Nordisk Perlite is a Danish family owned business. We’re a niche company and the only one of it’s kind in Scandinavia, with export in the majority of Europe. We’re a solid company with a wide costumer portfolio, that is growing and has ambitions for the future. Our team consists of 30 motivated employees, with many having an international background. We’re looking for a maintenance employee that can be a part of our engaged team, who wants to make things work. You will have a varying work life where, days rarely look similar.

The job consists of:

Maintenance of machines that are exposed to a rough production environment.

Optimizing production machinery along with your colleagues.

Expand and develop on our production equipment and buildings.

Be a part of a project from the beginning to the end.

We’re a company that challenges the creative mind and makes a lot of things from scratch. Do to that, the job gives a good opportunity at having an exciting and varying work life, where you’ll be challenged on your professional knowledge and creativity.

Do you like:

·         Puzzling with tasks both in and out of the workshop

·         Making big constructions from scratch, both independently and in teams.

·         Having complicated and simple challenges

·         Finding creative solutions

·         Having versatile and varying work tasks

 

Working hours will primarily be Monday-Thursday 7.00-16.00 and Friday 7.00-13.30.

There might occur few days during a working year where your working hours will differ.

Is this job for you?

Do you have a technical background, and understanding of mechanics and welding, then you might be the one we’re looking for. If we have caught your interest, then send your application to job@nordiskperlite.dk

jobs.description: Description :Au sein de la franchise Best Western Plus, nous recherchons un(e) Directeur / Directrice pour notre hôtel 4 étoiles de 48 chambres, situé dans le 12e arrondissement de Paris.L'établissement fait partie du portefeuille hôtelier de Square Groupe, société d'investissement indépendante spécialisée dans le développement et la gestion d'actifs hôteliers.L'hôtel s'apprête à connaître une rénovation complète, offrant une belle opportunité de participer à la transformation de l'établissement et de contribuer à une expérience client renouvelée.En lien avec la Responsable des opérations du siège, vous assurez la gestion globale de l'hôtel, le management des équipes et le suivi de sa performance opérationnelle, commerciale et financière. VOS MISSIONS : 1. GESTION OPÉRATIONNELLE ET MANAGEMENT * Assurer le bon fonctionnement quotidien de l'établissement et coordonner les différents services : réception, étages et petit-déjeuner. * Encadrer, accompagner et fédérer les équipes au quotidien. * Participer au recrutement, à l'intégration et à la formation des collaborateurs. * Organiser les plannings et veiller à l'adéquation des ressources avec l'activité. * Assurer le lien avec le siège, les propriétaires et les divers interlocuteurs. * Veiller à l'application des procédures et à la conformité aux standards de la marque, notamment dans le cadre des audits qualité. 2. HÉBERGEMENT ET HOUSEKEEPING * Superviser l'entretien et la propreté des chambres et des parties communes. * Organiser et contrôler les plans de nettoyage et les procédures qualité. * Coordonner les prestations de la gouvernante, des équipes d'étage et des prestataires. * Assurer le suivi des inventaires de linge, des produits d'accueil et des consommables. 4. jobs.title: Strategic Finance Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
📊 Want to build the finance function of a fast-growing consumer brand from scratch, and sit right next to the founders when the big decisions get made? Then read on. 🐱

At The Better Cat, we are reinventing the pet food market. 🐾 We are a VC-backed startup (backed by FoodLabs, among others) that has become the fastest growing cat food company in Germany and won the Fressnapf Innovation Award in 2024. We sell D2C, on Amazon and increasingly in retail.

This is our first dedicated finance hire, reporting directly to our co-founder Niklas. The role is a real mix: part finance business partner, giving the founding team accurate and timely numbers to decide on, and part hands-on operational finance, building the close and working with our external accountant and tax advisor. We are AI-first and automate wherever we can, so you will have the freedom (and the expectation) to build finance processes the modern way.

Tasks

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Own forecasting, budgeting and performance analysis.

  • Analyse revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, costs and working capital.

  • Support pricing, promotion, product mix, channel and product portfolio decisions.

Business Partnering & Decision Support

  • Be the primary finance contact for our Growth & Marketing and Supply Chain teams.

  • Translate financial and operational KPIs into clear insights and actions.

  • Challenge assumptions, connect operational decisions to P&L and cash-flow outcomes, and find opportunities to improve profitability and efficiency.

Supply Chain & Working Capital

  • Partner on inventory, procurement, fulfilment, logistics and working capital decisions.

  • Identify opportunities to improve costs, cash flow and operational efficiency.

Strategic Initiatives & Business Cases

  • Build business cases and quantify the financial impact of major initiatives, such as new brand, channel or country launches, and connect them to financial operations.

  • Support the rollout of controlling processes across the organisation.

Accounting

  • Build the monthly and annual close processes from scratch.

  • Work with our external tax advisor and accountants to ensure robust VAT treatment across countries and channels.

Requirements

Experience & Background

  • 2-4 years of experience in Consulting, Investment Banking, FP&A, Finance Business Partnering, Commercial Finance or Strategic Finance.

  • Experience in e-commerce, consumer products, retail, distribution or another physical-product business.

  • At least a bachelor's degree in a relevant subject such as Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business. A professional qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CFA) in progress or newly completed is a plus.

  • Proven ability to run workstreams independently and deliver high-quality output with minimal supervision.

  • Fluent in German and English.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex financial modelling and data analysis.

  • Experience with accounting software (e.g. DATEV, Lexware) and AI and automation tools (Claude, ChatGPT, n8n, Make, Zapier) is a plus. Above all, you are curious about AI and want to use it to work smarter.

  • Comfortable working with large datasets and turning analysis into clear, concise business insights.

  • Solid understanding of financial statements, management accounting principles and business performance metrics.

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong commercial mindset and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

  • Clear and confident written and verbal communication, including presenting findings to non-finance stakeholders.

  • Proactive and self-motivated, with an entrepreneurial mindset and comfort in a fast-paced, scaling company.

Benefits

  • 🦁 An inspiring team: Ambitious, fun, down-to-earth and authentic. Come and meet us!

  • 🏗️ Build it your way: As our first finance hire, you shape the finance function, its processes and its tools from day one.

  • 📈 Direct access to the founders: You work daily with Niklas and the founding team and help make decisions instead of just reporting on them.

  • 🤖 AI-first environment: We automate wherever it makes sense and give you room to experiment with the latest tools.

  • 🐱 Great products: It is more fun to stand behind something that truly works. Read our reviews or ask us for a sample!

  • 💝 Cool benefits: Deutschland-Ticket, MacBook, Wellpass, merch, office snacks and drinks.

  • ⭐ Great workplace: Modern office in Hamburg's HafenCity, hybrid setup, flexible working hours and fast personal growth.

🐾 Ready to build the finance engine of a scaling consumer brand and make the world a better place for cats?

Then get in touch! 📩 Send us your CV and a short cover letter and tell us why you are the right person for this role. We look forward to hearing from you!

Då kan detta vara rätt tjänst för dig!Vi på IGS Assistans AB söker nu en personlig assistent till en man i 30-årsåldern som bor tillsammans med sin familj i Norrköping.Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för människor, är uppmärksam på små signaler och har förmågan att skapa trygghet genom ett lugnt och respektfullt bemötande.Kunden har cerebral pares med tetraplegi, intellektuell funktionsnedsättning och epilepsi. Han saknar talat språk och kommunicerar i viss utsträckning genom bland annat ögonkontakt och blickar.Han använder rullstol och behöver omfattande stöd och hjälp med samtliga aktiviteter i det dagliga livet, både i hemmet och vid aktiviteter utanför hemmet.Som personlig assistent kommer du bland annat att:    Hjälpa till med personlig hygien, på- och avklädning och övrig personlig omvårdnad.    Assistera vid förflyttningar och användning av rullstol.    Ge stöd vid måltider och vara uppmärksam på kundens signaler och behov.    Medverka vid olika aktiviteter utanför hemmet.    Arbeta enligt kundens individuella rutiner och instruktioner.Kunden har dubbelassistans mellan kl. 10.00 och 22.00 varje dag. Det innebär att du arbetar tillsammans med en kollega, där ett gott samarbete och tydlig kommunikation är avgörande.Vem söker vi?Vi söker dig som är en mogen, stabil och ansvarstagande person, gärna med livserfarenhet och ett genuint engagemang för människor.Du har god fysisk kondition och förmåga att utföra ett fysiskt aktivt arbete som omfattar personlig omvårdnad, förflyttningar med hjälpmedel och stöd i olika vardagssituationer.För att passa i rollen ser vi gärna att du:    Är trygg, lugn och har ett gott omdöme.    Är ansvarsfull, noggrann och pålitlig.    Har god fysisk förmåga och trivs med ett aktivt arbete.    Har tålamod och är uppmärksam på kundens kroppsspråk och små signaler.    Kan samarbeta väl med andra assistenter.    Är flexibel och kan anpassa dig efter kundens dagsform och behov.    Respekterar kundens integritet och familjens hemmiljö.    Behärskar svenska väl i både tal och skrift.    Söker en långsiktig anställning där du kan bidra till trygghet och kontinuitet.Tidigare erfarenhet av personlig assistans, epilepsi eller arbete med personer med omfattande funktionsnedsättningar är meriterande.Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. För oss är det avgörande att du har rätt inställning, ett genuint engagemang och förmågan att skapa en trygg relation med kunden.Om tjänsten    Tjänstgöringsgrad: 90 %    Anställningsform: Så länge assistansuppdraget varar    Arbetstider: Måndag–onsdag kl. 10.00–22.00    Arbetsplats: Norrköping    Tillträde: Omgående eller enligt överenskommelseVi söker dig som kan arbeta de angivna tiderna och som vill bli en stabil och viktig del av kundens assistans.Kunskaper i turkiska är meriterande, men inget krav.Om IGS Assistans ABIGS Assistans AB är ett privat assistansbolag med över 26 års erfarenhet av personlig assistans. Vi värdesätter kvalitet, trygghet och långsiktiga relationer – både med våra kunder och medarbetare.Hos oss får du en trygg arbetsplats med tydliga rutiner, en genomtänkt introduktion och närvarande arbetsledning. Vi arbetar strukturerat med god framförhållning, tydlig kommunikation och kontinuerlig uppföljning.Vi tror att trygga och engagerade medarbetare är grunden för personlig assistans av hög kvalitet. Därför strävar vi efter att skapa en arbetsmiljö där du känner dig uppskattad, delaktig och trygg i din roll.Vi erbjuder    Kollektivavtal via Kommunal    Individuell och rättvis lönesättning    Strukturerad introduktion och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling    Friskvårdsbidrag    Möjlighet till långsiktig utveckling inom företagetÖvriga krav    Giltig legitimation ska uppvisas innan avtal tecknas.    Utdrag ur Polisens belastningsregister (Arbete i hemmet med äldre och personer med funktionsnedsättning) ska uppvisas före anställningAnsökanKänner du att detta arbete skulle passa dig?Skicka gärna en kort presentation där du berättar vem du är, vilken erfarenhet du har och varför du vill arbeta som personlig assistent.Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Legal Counsel @ Ren-Gas
jobs.description: Oletko liiketoimintalähtöinen juristi, joka:- nauttii kaupallisten sopimusten neuvottelemisesta ja monipuolisten juridisten kysymysten ratkomisesta? - viihtyy itsenäisessä inhouse-roolissa, jossa pääsee ottamaan vastuuta ja vaikuttamaan liiketoiminnan kehitykseen? - haluaa valjastaa juridisen osaamisensa uusiutuvan energian ja puhtaamman tulevaisuuden edistämiseen? Jos vastasit kolme kertaa KYLLÄ, jatka lukemista, sillä tämä paikka voi olla sinua varten!_Nordic Ren-Gas Oy on Euroopan johtava vetytalouden hankekehittäjä ja ratkaisukeskeinen toimija, jonka tavoitteena on vauhdittaa kustannustehokkaita päästövähennyksiä liikenteessä ja energiasektorilla. Ren-Gas rakentaa hajautettua Power-to-Gas-tuotantoverkostoa, joka tuottaa uusiutuvaa e-metaania raskaalle liikenteelle ja teollisuudelle, päästötöntä lämpöä kaukolämpöverkkoihin sekä joustoa sähköjärjestelmälle._ _Lisätietoja Ren-Gasin kulttuurista ja tiimistä löydät osoitteesta_ **_https://careers.ren-gas.com._****Haemme nyt Ren-Gasille Legal Counselia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.** Tässä roolissa pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten kaupallisten sopimusten ja energiahankkeiden parissa sekä vaikuttamaan uuden liiketoiminnan rakentamiseen. Työpöydälläsi voi olla niin laajoja kansainvälisiä sopimuskokonaisuuksia kuin pienempiä kotimaisia liiketoimintasopimuksia ja operatiivisen toiminnan juridisia kysymyksiä. Jos innostut ongelmanratkaisusta, itsenäisestä vastuunotosta ja mahdollisuudesta oppia jatkuvasti uutta vetytalouden ytimessä, tämä paikka voi olla sinulle jackpot!**Ren-Gasilla tuet liiketoimintaa ja yhtiön hankkeiden etenemistä kehitysvaiheesta toteutukseen.** Laadit, kommentoit ja neuvottelet kaupallisia sopimuksia, suunnittelet ja toteutat neuvottelustrategioita sekä tuet hankekehitys- ja toteutustiimejä sopimuksellisissa kysymyksissä. Työpöydällesi päätyy myös hankkeiden rahoitukseen, lupa- ja viranomaisprosesseihin sekä yhtiön operatiiviseen toimintaan liittyviä juridisia kysymyksiä. Seuraat Suomen ja EU:n kehittyvää sääntelyä, ohjaat tarvittaessa ulkopuolisia juridisia asiantuntijoita ja osallistut Ren-Gasin strategian ja liiketoiminnan kehittämiseen yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.Tehtäväsi vaihtelevat liiketoiminnan ja hankkeiden tarpeiden mukaan, joten pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja tarttumaan myös uudenlaisiin juridisiin kysymyksiin. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja otat rohkeasti vastuuta, mutta et jää haastavien tilanteiden kanssa yksin – tukenasi ovat Ren-Gasin juristikollegat ja muut asiantuntijat.**Olet etsimämme Legal Counsel, jos:**- olet oikeustieteen maisteri, jolla on noin 4-6 vuotta relevanttia työkokemusta liikejuridiikan neuvonantopuolelta tai inhouse-juristina esimerkiksi teollisuuden, energia-alan, transaktioiden tai projektiliiketoiminnan parista - sinulla on kokemusta kaupallisten sopimusten laadinnasta ja neuvottelusta sekä ymmärrystä sopimuksiin liittyvistä liiketoiminnallisista riskeistä ja niiden hallinnasta - hahmotat laajoja kaupallisia ja juridisia kokonaisuuksia ja nautit työskentelystä eri liiketoimintojen ja yhteistyökumppanien kanssa – tartut sujuvasti niin vaativiin sopimuskokonaisuuksiin kuin pienempiinkin käytännön juridisiin kysymyksiin - olet aidosti kiinnostunut uusiutuvasta energialiiketoiminnasta ja haluat soveltaa oppimaasi nopeasti käytännön juridiikkaan - itsenäinen ongelmanratkaisukyky, oma-aloitteisuus ja hands-on-asenne ovat vahvuuksiasi – uskallat tehdä ratkaisuja, kantaa vastuuta ja tarvittaessa myös pyytää apua - sinulla on erinomaiset vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaidot sekä sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito **Lisäksi ilahdumme, jos** sinulta löytyy kokemusta energia-alan tai teollisten hankkeiden sopimuskokonaisuuksista (esim. offtake-, PPA-, EPCM- ja O&M-sopimukset), power-to-x-liiketoiminnasta, projektirahoituksen dokumentaatiosta tai laitoshankkeiden lupa- ja viranomaisprosesseista. Arvostamme myös kokemusta hankkeiden edistämisestä kohti investointipäätöstä, riidanratkaisuun liittyvistä neuvotteluista sekä monipuolisesta generalistijuridiikasta esimerkiksi projektiyhtiöihin, operatiiviseen toimintaan tai yhtiöoikeudellisiin kysymyksiin liittyen. Myös ruotsin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi.**Ren-Gas tarjoaa sinulle:**- **vastuullisen inhouse-roolin vetytalouden edelläkävijäyhtiössä** – pääset mukaan edistämään uusiutuvien polttoaineiden tuotantohankkeita kohti toteutusta ja vaikuttamaan konkreettisesti uuden energialiiketoiminnan rakentamiseen. - **mahdollisuuden laajentaa juridista osaamistasi ja ottaa itsenäisesti vastuuta** – työskentelet monipuolisten sopimusten ja liiketoiminnallisten kysymysten parissa yhdessä kokeneiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Pääset syventämään osaamistasi sopimusjuridiikassa, hankekehityksessä ja riskienhallinnassa sekä tutustumaan energialiiketoiminnan eri osa-alueisiin. - **osaavan ja lämminhenkisen työyhteisön, jossa ihmiset aidosti auttavat toisiaan** – Ren-Gasin asiantuntijatiimiä yhdistävät vahva yhteishenki, uteliaisuus ja halu onnistua yhdessä. Työtä tehdään kunnianhimoisesti, mutta myös hyvällä huumorilla. Arjessa pidetään huolta työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainosta, ja haastavistakin tilanteista voidaan keskustella avoimesti. - **joustavan työskentelymallin** – Ren-Gasilla työtä tehdään joustavasti hybridimallilla ja saat vapautta suunnitella omaa työarkeasi. Tehtävä edellyttää kuitenkin mahdollisuutta työskennellä ja tavata tiimiä säännöllisesti myös toimistolla (Säterinportti, Espoo) sekä matkustaa tarvittaessa. Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä meille CV:si ja hakukirjeesi hakujärjestelmämme kautta **viimeistään sunnuntaina 22.11.2026**. Jos haluat jutella positiosta tarkemmin, voit myös olla yhteydessä Minjonin rekrytoijaan Olivia Yli-Pelkoseen (olivia.yli-pelkonen@minjon.fi / +358 40 769 5401).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer  (H/F)
jobs.description: L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements, 1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité - nous recherchons un**-**e Software Engineer senior aussi bien à l'aise avec Django que React pour nous aider à accélérer, se connecter à plus de fabricants et améliorer l'impact de l'application. Tu seras au cœur de son développement sur toutes les plateformes web/iOS/Android.Chez Hello Watt, nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeur. Nous cherchons des ingénieurs enthousiastes à l'idée d'explorer et de définir, ensemble, les contours de ce que sera demain notre nouveau métier de développeur.Tes missions :- Implémenter de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android)- Développer les intégrations api de pilotage d'appareil : onduleurs solaires, thermostats, bornes de recharge de véhicules électriques- Intégrer des fonctionnalités de flexibilité énergétique et d'effacement (programmation intelligente, pilotage selon les signaux de production solaire/tension du réseau, etc.).- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes, des tests solides et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.- Contribuer activement à l'outillage et aux workflows IA de l'équipe : prompts et conventions partagés, garde-fous, quality gates et boucles de feedback pour améliorer en continu la qualité du code généré- Concevoir l'évolution de l'architecture de la plateformeProfil recherchéÀ l'ère où l'IA accélère la production de code, nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.Compétences clés recherchées :- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée- System architecture : vision système, capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable- AI-native mindset : pratique avancée des outils d'IA pour le développement, esprit critique sur leurs sorties, et envie de contribuer à élever la pratique de toute l'équipeCompétences techniques recherchées :- Expérience confirmée en développement web avec python (Django, Flask, Sanic, FastAPI.) et avec un framework javascript (React, Vue, Angular.)- Au moins 5 années d'expérience dans un poste similaire, au sein d'un environnement de travail mettant l'expérience utilisateur au coeur des préoccupations- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, architecture modulaire par domaines métieAutres compétences recherchées :- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact- Goût pour les belles choses- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflowsEnvironnement technique:Backend- Language & Frameworks : Python avec Django (REST APIs, ORM, Admin)- Orchestration de taches: Celery- Cache : RedisFrontend Web- Language : TypeScript / JavaScript- Framework: ReactJs- Styling : Design System Hello Watt + Tailwind CSS- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)- Partage de code : Réutilisation du code web en natifBase de Données- SQL : MySQL pour les données relationnelles- NoSQL : MongoDB pour la gestion de données semi-structurées / documentsInfrastructure & Déploiement- Cloud Provider : AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, S3, RDS, etc.)- CI/CD : GitLab CI pour l'intégration et le déploiement automatisésOutils & Collaboration- Gestion de projet : Linear (suivi des tâches, roadmap produit)- Documentation : Slite- Contrôle de version : GitLabTu as envie de travailler sur de multiples projets où les mises en production de tes travaux sont rapides ?Tu veux intégrer une Greentech travaillant sur des produits à la pointe en Europe ?Tu veux utiliser la data pour proposer des services permettant de réduire l'empreinte carbone et les factures d'énergie ?Ne cherche plus, viens chez Hello Watt !Nos valeurs :- Impact more : nous accompagnons les particuliers dans la transition énergétique et nous utilisons la tech pour leur permettre de maîtriser leur consommation. Nous visons grand pour maximiser cet impact.- User focused : à l'écoute de nos clients, nous cherchons à les étonner par la qualité de nos services et de nos produits.- One caring team : nous veillons au bien être et au développement de chacun en fondant nos relations sur l'humilité et l'honnêteté.

jobs.title: (Senior) Software Engineer (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:

As a (Senior) Software Engineer, you’ll build core features for our flagship product, turning complex tax scenarios into simple, reliable experiences. You’ll bring a builder-first mindset: staying close to customer problems, using AI and modern engineering tools to move from idea to impact quickly, and taking ownership of outcomes—not just code.

You’ll work hands-on in a cross-functional team and bring deep expertise in either frontend or backend engineering, while collaborating effectively across the stack. You’ll help us raise the bar for scalable design, quality, maintainability, and AI-first software development.

Your responsibilities and decisions:

  • Partner with product management, design, and engineering to understand customer problems, shape pragmatic solutions, and deliver measurable outcomes.

  • Own work end to end—from discovery and technical design through implementation, release, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Turn ambiguity into action, make sound trade-offs, and deliver valuable increments without compromising long-term maintainability.

AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.

  • Engineer with AI, responsibly. Use agentic workflows and AI tooling every day while you stay accountable for architecture, security and quality. You'll also help shape how our team builds with AI.

  • Build the new and improve the existing. Your time splits roughly evenly between new product capabilities and modernising an established codebase. Every area you touch should be better when you leave it.

  • Work beyond your team's walls. Spot dependencies with our other teams early, raise risks before they block delivery, and keep stakeholders informed.

  • Deliver as a team. Join four talented engineers who share ownership. You'll work in four-month terms with two-week sprints, keep rituals lean, and adjust scope when reality changes.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world

  • Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs

  • Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market

  • Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget

  • Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You think in problems, solutions and how to implement them properly to deliver value to customers, not tickets that should to be done.

  • You're a builder across the stack. You've shipped features on both frontend and backend. Your backend are Java, Node.js using typescript or a similar typed languages, a knowledge in ruby is a plus. Your frontend is a modern SPA framework: Vue is ideal and React works too. LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. jobs.title: Security Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security 

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) 

  • Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) 

What we offer you 

  

💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 

🏦 Excellent pension contribution. 

🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. 

⏰ Flexible working hours. 

🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 

🏋️ Free onsite gym. 

🎉 Vibrant, open culture.
