I tillegg til en sosial og trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kolleger, tilbyr vi:

  • God opplæring og tett oppfølging

  • En variert jobbhverdag

  • Karriere og utviklingsmuligheter, blant annet muligheten til å søke vår interne Butikklederskole

  • En jobb i et selskap der bærekraft er en integrert del av vår forretningsstrategi

  • Muligheten til å jobbe med kvalitetsprodukter i et dynamisk selskap som leverer solide resultater og er i stor vekst

  • Muligheter for utvidet ansvar i butikken ved behov

Vi har spurt våre medarbeidere om hva det er som gjør at de trives i VIC:

«I VIC får du muligheten til å utvikle deg. Det er veldig stas for meg å nå få fungere i stillingen som Butikkleder. Det at vi selger både dame- og herreklær gjør også at man som ansatt får lære mye om mote og tekstil på kort tid.» - Lotte, Butikkleder

«I VIC spiller vi hverandre gode, og det er alltid noen du kan spørre om hjelp hvis du trenger det. Kulturen er åpen med en flat struktur.» - Aina, Butikkleder

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Har fullført og bestått videregående skole, relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende utdannelse

  • Har lengere salgserfaring fra tilsvarende bransje, gjerne varehandel

Stillingen krever at du er fleksibel med tanke på arbeidstid, og at du kan jobbe på dag- og kveldstid i både ukedager og helger, i tillegg til i ferier. 

Mangfold er en styrke, og vi ønsker oss medarbeidere med ulike livserfaringer og perspektiver. Vi oppfordrer alle kandidater med oppgitte kvalifikasjoner til å søke.

Søkere behandles og intervjuer avholdes fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

VIC er en norsk kleskjede for kvinner og menn. Hos oss lever signaturplagg og trendprodukter side om side. Den perfekte garderobe består av et knippe hverdagsfavoritter og selskapsgleder du kan mikse og trikse i utallige kombinasjoner. Vi ønsker å bidra med plagg som skaper gode minner, og kan bli med deg livet ut. Akkurat som en trofast venn.

I VIC designer, produserer og selger vi våre egne merkevarer BLU, Mellowfield og Vesbar. Dette er tre merker vi er veldig stolte over og som kundene våre elsker. I tillegg selger vi merkevarene Jean Paul, MAC, Donna, Mario Conti, Mr Capuchin, Calvin Klein og Riccovero.

Med 45 butikker over hele Norge og en klar strategi om å fortsette vokse, er VIC en kjede med ambisjoner og hvor det er mye spennende som skjer hele tiden. Vi har mange engasjerte og dyktige medarbeidere som gleder seg til å hjelpe deg når du kommer til oss. Vi jobber daglig for å gi deg en god handleopplevelse uansett om du besøker oss i butikk, på nett eller i Sosiale Media.

Som organisasjon er vi opptatt av medarbeiderne våre og har tett dialog mellom servicekontor og hver enkelt butikk. Vi skal spille hverandre gode for å bidra til at hver enkelt medarbeider lykkes i sin rolle.

jobs.title: Er du min nye støttespiller i hverdagen?
jobs.employer: ECURA BPA AS AVD REGION VEST
jobs.description:
Er du en trygg, omsorgsfull og fleksibel person som ønsker en meningsfull deltidsjobb? Da har du kommet til riktig sted!Hva er BPA?

Brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) er en alternativ måte å organisere tjenestene praktisk og personlig bistand på for mennesker med nedsatt funksjonsevne. BPA er et likestillings- og frigjøringsverktøy, og gjennom bistand fra egne assistenter legges det til rette for at personer med bistandsbehov får et aktivt og mest mulig uavhengig liv.

Om meg og mitt behov:Jeg er en humoristisk, eldre dame som bor på Vestli og som trives med både rolige stunder og aktiviteter. Jeg sitter i rullestol, og trenger hjelp til daglige gjøremål. Det kan ta litt tid før jeg blir trygg på nye mennesker, men når tilliten er på plass, får du en nær og god relasjon med meg. Jeg liker å pusle store puslespill, gå på teater, dra på shopping og kafé, og jeg går fast i kirken på søndager, noe som er viktig for meg.

Jeg har BPA både på dagtid og natt, og søker nå etter en fast assistent som kan jobbe fast annenhver mandag i partallsuke fra kl. 13.00 til kl. 19.00, og hvilende natt samme uke fra lørdag natt til tirsdag morgen. Stillingen tilsvarer 39,43%, opplæring vil foregå i januar og du vil tiltre stillingen i februar. Det vil også være gode muligheter for å jobbe ekstra ved planlagt og uforutsett fravær.

Jeg er opptatt av å finne assistenter som ønsker å være hos meg og med meg. Evner du å se mine behov, og er selvstendig, omsorgsfull og initiativrik, tror jeg du vil passe godt inn i mitt team.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • Personlig stell (dusj, toalettbesøk, skifte bleie)

  • Forflytninger

  • Matlaging

  • Husarbeid og renhold

  • Handling og ærend utenfor hjemmet

  • Følge til avtaler

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Pliktoppfyllende og positiv

  • Trygg, tålmodig og god på å bygge relasjoner

  • Pålitelig, ansvarsbevisst og stabil

  • Serviceinnstilt

  • Ryddig

  • Humoristisk

  • Ærlig og samvittighetsfull

Personlig egnethet og kjemi vektlegges.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Har gode norskkunnskaper (nivå B2)

  • Gyldig politiattest

  • Erfaring som BPA er positivt, men vel så viktig er viljen og ønsket om å lære

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfull jobb hvor du gjør en forskjell

  • God opplæring og veiledning

  • Oppfølging og støtte av erfarne rådgivere i Ecura BPA

  • Pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Lønn etter tariffavtale: for tiden minstelønn kr. 225,4 (gjelder ved turnusarbeid, dvs. arbeidstidsordning med gjennomsnittlig 35,5 timer pr. uke i 100% stilling). For den utlyste stillingen gjelder en gjennomsnittlig arbeidstid med 35,5 timer pr uke (100% stilling).

Ved å søke på stillingen, aksepterer du at søknad og CV videreformidles til arbeidsleder i ordningen.

Aktuelle kandidater blir intervjuet fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ecura BPA er en landsdekkende leverandør av brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA). Vi jobber for at personer med funksjonsnedsettelser skal få frihet til å leve livet slik de selv ønsker. Som arbeidsgiver er vi opptatt av trygge og stabile arbeidsforhold, god opplæring og tett oppfølging av våre assistenter. Vi har lang erfaring, høy faglig kompetanse og et stort engasjement for likestilling og deltakelse. Sammen skaper vi frihet i hverdagen – for både vedtakseiere og ansatte.

jobs.title: Arbeidsveileder - Tilrettelagt arbeid
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Som arbeidsveileder bidrar du til at mennesker får utvikle kompetansen sin og finne veien videre mot arbeid eller utdanning. Du følger opp deltakere individuelt og legger til rette for mestring, læring og progresjon. I samarbeid med deltakere, kolleger, arbeidsgivere og andre samarbeidspartnere arbeider du målrettet for å finne gode løsninger og skape muligheter i arbeidslivet.

Vi ser etter deg som er

  • Engasjert: Du motiveres av å hjelpe andre med å utvikle seg og nå målene sine.

  • Inkluderende: Du møter mennesker med respekt, bygger tillit og bidrar til et trygt og støttende miljø.

  • Modig: Du tar initiativ, finner muligheter og er åpen for å prøve nye tilnærminger.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Utarbeide mål og planer sammen med deltakerne og følge opp progresjon.

  • Veilede og motivere deltakere til utvikling i arbeid.

  • Tilrettelegge i arbeidsutførelse.

  • Samarbeide med kolleger og bidra til utvikling av tilbud og arbeidsmetoder.

  • Sikre at produksjon leverer til riktig tid med rett kvalitet

  • Skaffe og følge opp kunder

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Du er nevenyttig og liker å bruke hendene, for jobben består av mye praktisk arbeid

  • I tillegg til å være en god veileder, har du en god forståelse av tekniske løsninger innen produksjon, eller bilpleie og dekk.

  • Utdanning er et krav, høyere utdanning en fordel. Vi ønsker at du konkretiserer hvordan du tenker din utdannelse vil være en styrke i denne jobben.

  • Erfaring med veiledning, oppfølging eller tilrettelegging for mennesker med ulike behov.

  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner og evne til å bygge relasjoner innad i bedriften, men også med bedrifts- og privatkunder.

  • Erfaring med samarbeid med NAV, arbeidsgivere eller andre offentlige aktører kan være er en fordel.

Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull arbeidshverdag med mulighet til å gjøre en forskjell.

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger og høy faglig kompetanse.

  • Muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

Primær arbeidslokasjon er på Sørumsand, samtidig som det må beregnes noe arbeidstid i Lillestrøm

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi er Norasonde – en inkluderende og engasjert kompetanseorganisasjon som jobber med arbeid, utdanning og sosial bærekraft. Hos oss får du jobbe med mening – og gjøre en forskjell i menneskers liv.

Våre verdier er:

Modige: Vi tør utfordre og utvikle.

Inkluderende: Hos oss er det plass til alle.

Engasjerte: Vi brenner for det vi gjør.

jobs.title: Vi søker etter Sushi-Kokker - Bergen Storsenter
jobs.description:
Vi søker etter nye Sushikokker, både heltid- og deltids-stillinger, arbeidstid er dagtid, kveld og helger.

Arbeidsted er Sabrura Bergen Storsenter. Ved tiltredelse før 01.01.2027 blir opplæring og arbeidssted Sabrura Vestkanten.

I Sabrura får du bli en del av en gjeng som ELSKer jobben sin og har det gøy hver eneste dag. For å klare det, trenger vi enda flere gladlakser med på laget🐟

Vi ønsker mangfold og variasjon blant våre medarbeidere og ønsker derfor å komme i kontakt med kvalifiserte søkere uavhengig av etnisk bakgrunn, kjønn eller alder.

I havet finnes det flust av muligheter. Hvorfor skal du velge Sabrura?Med Sabrura får du sjansen til å være med på en unik reise. Vi er et godt etablert suksesskonsept med meget godt omdømme på mat, service og atmosfære. Du vil være del av et miljø hvor det legges til rette for samspill og utvikling. Du kan forvente god opplæring og faglig påfyll hos oss🧑‍🍳Som kokk er du stjerna på vårt topp moderne kjøkken i vår restaurant. Du utstråler våre verdier, er glad i andre mennesker og gir alltid det lille ekstra. Du jobber i team, tett på dine kolleger i et arbeidsmiljø preget av et felles ønske om å levere gode gjesteopplevelser og resultater🤩

Hva er suksessoppskriften?Nysgjerrig på hvorfor gjestene fortsetter å strømme til Sabrura? Ingen bestikkelser. Kun en rå forretningsidé. Sushibuffet laget av førsteklasses råvarer – til en folkelig pris.

Det liker mannen, dama og ungene i gata.

I tillegg passer vi på å gi gjestene god stemning rundt fatet. Lokalene skaper en god atmosfære. Det er rent, pent og ryddig. Du føler deg sett og ivaretatt – også når det er full kok i restauranten. Og så har du oss, da, som gleder oss over å skape gode Sabrura-opplevelser hver eneste dag. Om vi er stolt av det vi får til sammen? Det kan du bite deg i nesa på.

Det er en fordel dersom du:

  • Trives i et arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo

  • Har erfaring fra kjøkken-eller servicebransjen

  • Har kunnskap om IK-mat og HMS

 

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK💛 og fører vei i vår arbeidshverdag:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.

  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.

  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.

  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.

Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Sabrura🥢Har du spørsmål er du hjertelig velkommen til å kontakt med Kaj Kvinge på 91625313/Kaj.kvinge@sabrurasushi.no

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Helt siden Sabrura åpnet i Trondheim i 2012 har målet vært å gjøre sushi til hverdagskost. Og det har vi klart! I 2022 har vi blitt mange restauranter som er høyt elsket av folk i alle aldre. Vi er i sterk vekst og har satt oss ambisiøse mål. I løpet av de neste tre årene skal vi vokse videre og posisjonere oss som en tydelig og folkekjær, nasjonal merkevare. For å klare dette trenger vi dyktige kokker, servitører og franchisetakere. Tar du utfordringen?

jobs.title: Vil du hjelpe meg og leve, og ikke bare eksistere
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest 📌 Stillingstype: Tilkalling ⏰ Arbeidstid: Dagtid, kveld og helg

«Det noen tar som en selvfølge, må jeg selv ha følge»

Dette er et dikt jeg har skrevet selv, og det beskriver hverdagen min ganske godt.

Jeg er 28 år og bor i Hakadal sammen med hunden min, Fri 🐶. Jeg er en kreativ person som liker å tegne, male, ta bilder, være i naturen og finne på hyggelige aktiviteter. Jeg elsker også humor, vitser og ordspill, så du må være forberedt på både latter og gode samtaler. Samtidig trenger jeg bistand til å balansere aktivitet og hvile. Jeg setter pris på ro og nærvær, og trives med vintage, det litt alternative og det å være til stede med hverandre.

Ingen dager er like for meg. Jeg har sammensatte utfordringer som gjør at behovene mine varierer fra dag til dag. På en dårlig dag trenger jeg mer ro, hvile og skjerming, mens jeg på en god dag har behov for å være mer sosial, delta i aktiviteter og eksponere meg for flere inntrykk. Derfor er det viktig at du er fleksibel og kan tilpasse deg dagsformen min. Jeg har også behov for tid til å lande og hente meg inn igjen før vakten er over.

Gjennom de siste årene har jeg gjort store fremskritt personlig, men helsen min har også vært utfordrende. Den siste tiden har jeg blitt sykere, og selv om jeg ofte kan virke frisk på utsiden, har jeg et stort behov for bistand i hverdagen. Jeg har autisme og flere usynlige utfordringer som gjør at jeg trenger trygge, stabile og engasjerte assistenter rundt meg.

For meg handler BPA om mer enn praktisk hjelp. Det handler om å få livet mitt tilbake. Jeg ønsker ikke bare å eksistere - jeg ønsker å leve. Jeg ønsker å mestre hverdagen, utvikle interessene mine, oppleve nye ting og fortsette å vokse som menneske. Kanskje kan du utfordre meg på en positiv måte og hjelpe meg med å se muligheter jeg ikke ser selv? 🌟 Jeg tror at gode dager ofte skapes gjennom de små øyeblikkene, og jeg setter stor pris på alt fra en hyggelig tur i skogen til små hverdagsgleder som gjør livet litt lysere.

Et av målene mine er å komme meg ut og bade minst én gang i måneden, fordi det gir meg både mestring og glede. Dagsformen min varierer, så det er viktig at du er fleksibel og kan tilpasse aktiviteter etter hva kroppen min tillater den dagen.

Jeg har et nært og godt forhold til familien min, og spesielt mamma har vært en uvurderlig støtte gjennom mange år. Nå er jeg voksen, og jeg ønsker at mamma skal få være mamma igjen. Derfor trenger jeg assistenter som kan ta over stafettpinnen og bli en viktig del av hverdagen min.

Som min assistent vil du bistå meg med hverdagslige oppgaver, være en trygg samtalepartner, bidra med sosial trening, ta initiativ til aktiviteter og motivere meg til å opprettholde gode rutiner og fysisk aktivitet. Kanskje kan vi øve på sosial eksponering ved å dra i bruktbutikker, loppemarked, oppleve nye steder eller ta en helgetur sammen?

Jeg ser etter deg som kan skape trygge omgivelser, samtidig som du tør å utfordre meg når det er riktig. Du er initiativrik, tydelig og omsorgsfull, men også god til å lese situasjoner og forstå når jeg trenger ro. Jeg er var på lyd, lys og lukt, så setter stor pris på om dette også bli tatt hensyn til. Det er viktig for meg at du har tid og lyst til å bli godt kjent med meg - på både gode og dårlige dager.

I tillegg er samarbeid svært viktig i min BPA-ordning. Jeg ønsker assistenter som kommuniserer og samarbeider godt både med meg og resten av teamet, som ser hva som må gjøres, tar ansvar og bidrar til at vi sammen skaper en trygg og velfungerende hverdag. Fleksibilitet og evnen til å stille opp ved behov er også noe jeg setter stor pris på.

Arbeidstid og stillinger

Jeg søker nå etter tilkallingsvikarer som kan bli en del av teamet mitt. Det er muligheter med en fast stilling på sikt.

Det vil være mulig å kombinere ukedager og helgevakter, avhengig av hva som passer for deg og teamets behov 😊

For meg er det viktig med stabile og forutsigbare assistenter som ønsker å bli værende over tid. Derfor håper jeg du ser for deg en langsiktig rolle dersom du søker.

Du blir en del av et godt og sammensveiset assistentteam hvor samarbeid, kommunikasjon og støtte for hverandre står sentralt.🌸

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Bistå med renhold og orden i hjemmet

  • Handle mat og bidra til matlaging

  • Sosial trening og støtte i sosiale situasjoner

  • Hjelpe meg med å opprettholde gode rutiner og egentid

  • Være med på aktiviteter, turer og fysisk aktivitet

  • Hjelpe meg med å finne gode løsninger og ta egne valg

  • Bidra til planlegging og gjennomføring av hverdagsaktiviteter

  • Være en trygg samtalepartner og støtte i hverdagen

  • Motivere til gjennomføring av personlig hygiene

  • Hverdagslig eksponering

Personlige egenskaper

  • Initiativrik og flink til å komme med forslag til aktiviteter

  • Ansvarsbevisst, pliktoppfyllende og lærevillig

  • Rolig, trygg og stabil

  • God til å lese situasjoner og tilpasse deg ulike behov

  • Tålmodig og omsorgsfull

  • Løsningsorientert og selvstendig

  • Komfortabel med å støtte i sosiale situasjoner og bidra til forståelse av sosiale koder

  • God på å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Personlig egenhet og kjemi vektlegges

  • Førerkort klasse B og disponere egen bil

  • Gjerne erfaring innenfor autismespekteret

  • Fremlegge gyldig politiattest

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Karen Tonette Bulæg på epost karen.bulag@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Omsorgsfull assistent søkes til kvinne i Eidsvoll (70 % vikariat)

Jeg er en 28 år gammel kvinne som bor i Eidsvoll, nær sentrum, sammen med hunden min. På fritiden liker jeg å se filmer og serier (spesielt komedier og action). Jeg har en positiv innstilling til livet, setter pris på humor og liker gode samtaler og hyggelig selskap i hverdagen.

Company Overview

Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized.

We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments.

What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare.

This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession.

You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and hard-to-fill roles spanning Product, Technology and Business. You will work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define what we actually need, identify what great looks like for each role and translate this into rigorous, efficient hiring processes.

This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a generalist People & Culture or Organizational Development position. You will personally run critical searches, source candidates, conduct interviews and close hires. At the same time, we expect you to help raise the quality of hiring across Mindpeak by challenging unclear requirements, improving interview practices and bringing structure and discipline to how we make hiring decisions.

You will not inherit a recruiting team, but you will have the mandate and budget to work with external recruiters and specialist search partners where they add value.

Your Mission

  • Own the full recruiting cycle: from search strategy, sourcing and screening through interviews, offers and closing.

  • Partner with our CEO and hiring managers as a trusted talent advisor: clarify requirements, challenge assumptionsand drive decisions forward.

  • Proactively identify and engage high-quality candidates, particularly for senior, leadership and hard-to-fill roles.

  • Run high-quality interviews that go beyond CVs and polished answers, uncovering concrete evidence of impact, decision-making and individual contribution.

  • Select, brief and actively manage external recruiters and search partners where they add value.

  • Keep pipelines, bottlenecks and risks transparent for leadership, and keep improving how Mindpeak hires without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What Success Looks Like

  • Priority searches run with clear role profiles and explicit assessment criteria, even when requirements start out ambiguous.

  • You successfully engage high-quality passive candidates and build genuine interest in Mindpeak and our roles.

  • Interviews across Mindpeak become more rigorous and consistent, based on evidence rather than titles or impressions.

  • Most importantly, critical roles get closed with people who raise the quality of the organisation.

Your Experience

  • Substantial hands-on experience owning full-cycle recruiting; a background in executive search or another environment with a strong sourcing and assessment culture is a plus.

  • Proven track record of closing senior, leadership and hard-to-fill searches, with strong active sourcing skills and confidence approaching passive candidates.

  • Experience in a technology-driven, high-growth environment, recruiting across functions such as Product, Technology and Business. You don't need to be technical, but you understand how these teams work well enough to recruit credibly.

  • Experience working directly with founders or demanding senior hiring managers and influencing their decisions rather than simply executing requirements.

  • Experience translating unclear business needs into clear role profiles, scorecards and structured interview processes.

  • Experience selecting and managing external agencies or headhunters.

  • Fluent English and German (at least C2 level)

Your Profile

  • You interview for evidence and have strong talent judgment. You can tell an impressive CV or polished answer from real evidence that someone will succeed.

  • You know what good looks like and can credibly bring that standard into an organisation still developing its own.

  • You challenge senior stakeholders constructively and communicate clearly and directly with executives, hiring managers and senior candidates alike.

  • You take ownership. When a search isn't working, you diagnose why and change the approach, and you know when requirements need to change.

  • You create structure without bureaucracy, just enough process to improve speed, quality and accountability.

  • You learn quickly and immerse yourself in unfamiliar domains until you can recruit credibly in them.

Why Mindpeak

  • Take real ownership of Talent Acquisition in a growing AI company where hiring exceptional people has a direct impact on the success of the business.

  • Recruit across some of the most interesting talent markets today – from AI and software engineering to medicine, science and commercial roles.

  • Work directly with our founders and senior leaders Shape and continuously improve how we identify, assess and hire exceptional people rather than simply executing a fixed corporate recruiting process.

  • See the impact of the teams you build on cancer diagnostics and treatment.

  • Work from our centrally located Hamburg office with a beautiful view over the harbor.

Application Details

  • Your salary expectations

  • Your earliest possible starting date

Note: Direct applicants only. We do not work with recruiting agencies for this position.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Intern
jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Learn how a global trading business really works, and build the AI tools that make it faster.

As a Forward Deployed Intern, you spend six months inside our business. You sit with the teams that buy, sell and move industrial materials, learn how their work really happens, and build tools that make it faster, with AI at the core.

You work alongside our product and engineering team, with a mentor who reviews your work and helps you grow. This is not a shadowing internship: you take on real problems, ship real tools, and see them used every day.

What you will do

Learn the business

  • Join our sales, procurement, logistics and finance teams and understand how a trade works from request to delivery.

  • Spot where people lose time to manual work.

Build , Measure & Share

  • Build automations, small agents, scripts and dashboards with AI tools such as Claude.

  • Ship first versions quickly and improve them with feedback from the people who use them.

  • Track whether what you built saves time or prevents mistakes.

  • Decide with your mentor what to improve and what to stop.

  • Document what you built so others can use it.

  • Show your work in demos to the team.

What success looks like

  • Several tools or automations in daily use by our teams

  • Measured time savings for at least one team

  • Clear documentation others can build on

  • A solid understanding of how a global trade works end to end

What you bring

  • You are enrolled in a degree in computer science, engineering, business informatics or a similar field.

  • You can code, for example in Python or JavaScript, and use AI tools in your daily work.

  • Real curiosity about how businesses work, not only about technology.

  • You communicate clearly and like working with people from other backgrounds.

  • You can commit to six months full-time in Berlin.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses.

Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward.

jobs.title: Shiftmanager
jobs.description:
Als Shiftmanager zal jij instaan voor het goede verloop van een shift op elk mogelijk vlak. Je kan ervan op aan dat wij je via opleidingen klaarstomen in no time! 

Je gaat van bij de start aan de slag in de keuken om alles te leren over de operationele werking van het restaurant: het bereiden van onze lekkere producten, het correct opstarten en instellen van alle apparatuur, het controleren en aanvullen van de voorraden, het controleren van de leveringen, het klaarzetten van de benodigdheden voor de shift,…

Ook in de lobby word je meteen ingezet om te leren hoe best-in-class hospitality eruit ziet om klanten een geluksmomentje te bezorgen bij elk bezoek. Uiteraard werk je tijdens jouw shiften mee aan alle mogelijke werkposten. Geen enkele werkpost in de keuken of zaal heeft dus nog geheimen voor jou!

jobs.title: Är du en person med bra energi och gillar att vara aktiv?
jobs.description: Vi söker nu en öppen, glad och positiv assistent till en 20-åring tjej i Kävlinge. Här blir du en del av en liten och engagerad arbetsgrupp av viktiga personer som ser till att tjejen kan leva ett aktivt, glädjefyllt och meningsfullt liv.Du som söker ska vara tjej/kvinna. Tidigare erfarenhet inom personlig assistans, skola/förskola eller annat arbete med barn/ungdomar är meriterande men inget krav. Hos oss får du gå introduktion och genomgångar på plats tills du känner dig trygg med arbetet. Tjejen har dubbelassistans, så du jobbar aldrig ensam utan har stöd av kollega eller stödassistent/stödpedagog då tjejen ev. kommer att gå på dagligverksamhet. Det innebär att din arbetsplats ev. kommer att vara förlagd på dagligverksamhet men fokus är på vår tjej.Vi söker en varm och trygg assistent som kan börjar hos oss i januari men innan dess för du gärna vara inskolad och hoppa in som vikarie vid behov.Tjänsten är ett vikariat under ett årstid motsvarande 75-80% och det finns goda chanser att den övergår till en tillsvidare tjänst längre fram. Arbetspass förekommer under vardagar (dagtid/kväll) och varannan helg. Som assistent innefattar dina arbetsuppgifter allt från personlig hygien och omvårdnad till kommunikation, träning och aktivitet. Familjen bor på gångavstånd från Kävlinges tågstation, kollektiv pendling är således inga problem!Nedan kommer lite kort information från tjejen:Jag är en glad tjej på 20 år som bor tillsammans med min familj i Kävlinge. Jag söker dig som är trygg, varm och hänsynstagande. Hos mig får du möjlighet att verkligen göra skillnad och bidra till att jag utvecklas så mycket som möjligt! Du behöver känna dig bekväm i vattnet och ett krav är att du ska vara simkunnig eftersom att bada är ett av mina största intressen! Därtill älskar jag ridning så du bör av den enkla anledning inte heller vara rädd för hästar.På vardagarna är det fullt upp med både, ridning, bad, musikterapi och träning. Uppskattar att vara utomhus och mina dagliga promenader. Under helger och lov gillar jag att hitta på roliga aktiviteter och gärna åka iväg på utflykter. Som assistent har du inflytande i min vardag och hjälper mig att ha ett aktivt liv vilket jag verkligen uppskattar. Musik är min passion, älskar att lyssna på musik och jag har flera olika instrument. Du behöver inte vara musikkunnig men du får gärna gilla att skoja och sjunga med mig. Jag är väldigt nyfiken av mig och gillar när det händer saker, hos mig får du det inte långtråkigt! Vi uppskattar om du är flexibel och har god arbetsmoral. I min assistansgrupp hjälps de åt och det är viktigt med att ge och ta. Vi är ett härligt och roligt gäng som skapar många roliga ( och oförglömliga) minnen ihop! Det viktigaste som såklart kommer avgöra är att personkemin mellan dig och mig stämmer!Krav: rökfri, simkunnig och ej rädd för hästar. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!Har du några frågor så är du välkommen att maila till sylvia@ksjab.se eller att ringa Sylvia Wallin Holmqvist på 073-706 49 94.

jobs.title: Huisartsen
jobs.description:
Ben jij een huisarts met een hart voor patiënten én een brede kijk op gezondheid en samenwerking?

Wil je deel uitmaken van een dynamisch en multidisciplinair team, in een moderne en toekomstgerichte praktijk? Crescendo Medisch Huis in Eeklo breidt uit en zoekt gemotiveerde huisartsen die integrale, kwalitatieve eerstelijnszorg willen uitdragen binnen de praktijk.

Over onze praktijk

Crescendo is een bruisende groepspraktijk waar artsen, therapeuten en zorgprofessionals dagelijks de krachten bundelen.

Van kinesitherapie, osteopathie en voedingsbegeleiding tot psychologie, logopedie, podologie en thuisverpleging: wij geloven in geïntegreerde zorg die de patiënt in zijn geheel centraal stelt.

Onze praktijk is gevestigd in het moderne, nieuwe Molenpark in Eeklo: een groene, centrale locatie met een warme en collegiale werksfeer.

Wij zoeken huisartsen die:

  • Openstaan voor samenwerking binnen een multidisciplinair model.
  • Op zoek zijn naar een moderne praktijk in een aantrekkelijke omgeving.
  • Een eigen praktijk willen uitbouwen met optimale ondersteuning en toekomstperspectief.
  • Zich thuis voelen in een praktijk waar autonomie en verbinding hand in hand gaan.

jobs.title: Kinesitherapeuten
jobs.description:
Kinesitherapeut gezocht voor onze multidisciplinaire groepspraktijk in Eeklo!

Ben jij een enthousiaste kinesitherapeut die graag werkt met een gevarieerd patiëntenbestand – van jong tot oud, recreatief tot topsport – en ben je op zoek naar een praktijk waar je jouw expertise kan verdiepen én verbreden? Dan is Crescendo Medisch Huis in Eeklo misschien wel jouw volgende stap!

Over onze praktijk:

Crescendo is een bruisende groepspraktijk in het hart van het Molenpark in Eeklo. In een moderne, groene omgeving werken we in een hecht, multidisciplinair team aan hoogwaardige, persoonsgerichte zorg.

Ons team bestaat uit kinesitherapeuten, osteopaten, psychologen, logopedisten, voedingsdeskundigen, podologen en verpleegkundigen.

We begeleiden een diverse populatie, met een sterke instroom van topsporters, recreatieve sporters, patiënten met musculoskeletale klachten en mensen met chronische of revaliderende noden.

Wat maakt werken bij Crescendo uniek?

  • Sterke sportgerichte instroom – Je werkt met recreatieve en competitieve sporters uit verschillende disciplines.
  • Ruimte voor specialisatie – Of je nu ervaring hebt of je wil verdiepen in sportkine, dry needling, manuele therapie, orthopedische of neurologische revalidatie, bij ons krijg je ruimte voor groei.
  • Multidisciplinair overleg – Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit andere disciplines voor een holistische aanpak van elke patiënt.
  • Moderne infrastructuur – Onze praktijk is uitgerust met ruime behandelkamers en functionele oefenruimtes, met een gunstige huurformule.
  • Flexibele werkregeling – Jij bepaalt je eigen agenda binnen een stabiele en ondersteunende werkomgeving.

Wie zoeken we? We zoeken een gemotiveerde kinesitherapeut die:

  • Graag werkt met een gevarieerde populatie, inclusief sporters.
  • Zich wil verdiepen in een of meerdere specialisaties.
  • Positief en professioneel samenwerkt binnen een team.
  • Op zoek is naar een warme en moderne praktijkomgeving.

jobs.title: Logopedist(e)
jobs.description:
Versterk de logopedische werking van Crescendo Medisch Huis, een warme multidisciplinaire groepspraktijk in het groene Molenpark in Eeklo (Meetjesland). Door de groeiende vraag naar logopedie breiden we uit en zoeken we een gedreven logopedist(e) op zelfstandige basis. Je werkt nauw samen met onze logopediste Justine Boelens.

Wat ga je doen?

Je begeleidt vooral kinderen rond taal- en articulatiestoornissen, leerstoornissen en foutieve mondgewoonten (OMFT). Je werkt zowel zelfstandig als in nauw overleg met collega's uit verschillende disciplines.

Wie ben jij?

- Je hebt interesse en/of ervaring in OMFT, leerstoornissen, taalstoornissen en articulatiestoornissen.

- Je werkt graag samen, maar kan ook zelfstandig werken.

- Je hebt enthousiasme, verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en een hart voor kinderen.

- Je bent beschikbaar op zelfstandige basis.

jobs.title: Podoloog
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan het podologisch aanbod van Crescendo Medisch Huis, een warme multidisciplinaire groepspraktijk in het groene Molenpark in Eeklo (Meetjesland). We zoeken een gedreven podoloog met een passie voor instrumentele behandeling, op zelfstandige basis.

Wat ga je doen?

Je behandelt en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende voetproblemen, met een sterke focus op instrumentele podologie:

- Behandeling van huid- en nagelaandoeningen

- Vervaardigen van silicone orthesen

- Toepassen van orthonyxie

- Adviseren en begeleiden rond preventieve voetzorg

Je werkt nauw samen met onze kinesitherapeuten, osteopaten en andere zorgverleners in een multidisciplinair behandelplan waarbij de patiënt centraal staat.

Wat bieden we jou?

- Een warme, moderne en multidisciplinaire werkomgeving.

- Nauwe samenwerking met een enthousiast team van zorgprofessionals.

- Veel flexibiliteit in de organisatie van je werk.

- De mogelijkheid om zelf je agenda en patiëntenbestand uit te bouwen.

- Start met één werkdag per week, met reële mogelijkheid tot uitbreiding.

- Een professionele praktijk met alle faciliteiten voor kwalitatieve zorg.

Wie ben jij?

- Je hebt een bachelordiploma Podologie.

- Je bent gepassioneerd door instrumentele behandeling, huid- en nagelproblematiek, silicone orthesen en orthonyxie.

- Je bent een teamspeler die graag samenwerkt met collega's uit verschillende disciplines.

- Je bent ondernemend en communicatief, met interesse in werken op zelfstandige basis.

- Je biedt kwalitatieve, patiëntgerichte zorg.

Interesse? Stuur je motivatie en cv naar info@praktijkcrescendo.be. We kijken ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten.

jobs.title: Studiebegeleider(ster) secundair: STEM, wiskunde, fysica en chemie
jobs.description:
Begeleid jongeren uit het secundair onderwijs op zelfstandige basis in STEM-wetenschappen, wiskunde in de eerste graad, fysica en chemie, binnen een warm, multidisciplinair team in het groene Molenpark in Eeklo (Meetjesland).

Over de functie

Bij Crescendo Medisch Huis kiezen ouders via onze website per graad en per vak de juiste begeleider. Voor de exacte vakken zoeken we een studiebegeleider die de leerstof inhoudelijk beheerst en ze helder kan uitleggen. Je helpt leerlingen de redenering achter een oefening te begrijpen, in plaats van ze enkel het trucje aan te leren. Je werkt per leerling: wat ontbreekt er in de basis, waar loopt het mis bij het toepassen, en hoe pakt de leerling een toets aan.

Vakken

- STEM-wetenschappen en natuurwetenschappen (eerste graad).

- Wiskunde eerste graad (1ste en 2de middelbaar, A- en B-stroom).

- Fysica (tweede en derde graad).

- Chemie (tweede en derde graad).

Wat je doet

- Individuele begeleiding in sessies van een uur.

- Leerstof inhoudelijk uitleggen en inoefenen, met oefeningen op maat.

- Toetsen en examens samen voorbereiden en een studieplanning opmaken.

- Studiemethode: formules begrijpen in plaats van blokken, vraagstukken stap voor stap aanpakken.

- Korte terugkoppeling aan ouders en overleg met collega's binnen de praktijk.

Wie zoeken we?

- Je beheerst wiskunde, fysica en chemie op het niveau van de derde graad secundair onderwijs.

- Je kunt abstracte leerstof concreet en stap voor stap uitleggen, ook aan een leerling die de moed verloren is.

- Je bent geduldig, gestructureerd en positief ingesteld.

- Je bent beschikbaar na schooltijd (vanaf 16u), op woensdagnamiddag en/of zaterdagvoormiddag. In examenperiodes is extra beschikbaarheid een troef.

- Je werkt op zelfstandige basis (hoofd- of bijberoep, of als student-zelfstandige).

Interesse? Stuur je cv en een korte motivatie naar info@praktijkcrescendo.be. Vermeld welke vakken en graden je kunt begeleiden. Een vrijblijvende kennismaking kan ook.

jobs.title: Studiebegeleider(ster) lager onderwijs
jobs.description:
Begeleid kinderen uit het lager onderwijs op zelfstandige basis naar meer structuur, zelfvertrouwen en plezier in leren, binnen een warm, multidisciplinair team in het groene Molenpark in Eeklo (Meetjesland).

Over de functie

Bij Crescendo Medisch Huis groeit de vraag naar studiebegeleiding voor kinderen van het eerste tot het zesde leerjaar. Je helpt hen met lezen, spelling, rekenen en wiskunde, Frans in de derde graad en het maken en plannen van huiswerk. Je zoekt per kind uit waar het vastloopt: een leerstofkloof, concentratie, faalangst of een gebrek aan structuur. Daarop stem je je aanpak af. Je geeft ouders na elke reeks duidelijke feedback en je werkt waar nodig samen met onze logopedisten, ergotherapeut en kinderkinesitherapeuten.

Wat je doet

- Individuele begeleiding van kinderen uit het eerste tot het zesde leerjaar, in sessies van een uur.

- Ondersteuning bij lezen, spelling, rekenen en wiskunde, Frans (5de en 6de leerjaar) en huiswerk.

- Leren leren: een kind leert zijn boekentas, agenda en week zelf plannen.

- Voorbereiding op toetsen en op de overgang naar het secundair onderwijs.

- Korte terugkoppeling aan ouders en overleg met collega's binnen de praktijk.

Wie zoeken we?

- Je hebt een diploma als leerkracht lager onderwijs, of een vergelijkbare opleiding of ervaring met kinderen in de lagere school.

- Je kent de leerplannen en eindtermen van het lager onderwijs.

- Je bent geduldig, gestructureerd en je kunt uitleg herhalen op een andere manier tot het klikt.

- Je hebt oog voor leerproblemen zoals dyslexie, dyscalculie of ADHD en weet wanneer je doorverwijst.

- Je bent beschikbaar na schooltijd (vanaf 16u) en/of op woensdagnamiddag.

- Je werkt op zelfstandige basis (hoofd- of bijberoep).

Interesse? Stuur je cv en een korte motivatie naar info@praktijkcrescendo.be. Een vrijblijvende kennismaking kan ook.

jobs.title: Ingénieur DevOps Réseau Cloud GCP / AWS (H/F) - Freelance
jobs.description: Lille (59), 2 jours de télétravail par semaine - Prestation - Démarrage ASAPLE CONTEXTENous recherchons pour notre client, un grand groupe international du retail, un-e Ingénieur-e DevOps Réseau Cloud pour rejoindre sa direction digitale.Vous intégrerez l'équipe réseau cloud centralisée (environ 25 personnes réparties entre Lille, Lyon et Paris), au sein d'un pôle plateforme cloud d'environ 170 personnes. Cette équipe allie expertise réseau et pratiques DevOps. Elle définit les standards et les patterns d'architecture du socle réseau cloud, les automatise et les met à disposition des équipes IT en self-service.L'environnement est cloud à 95 %, multi-provider (GCP, AWS) et multi-régions (Europe, Asie, US). La mission porte surtout sur du Build en Scrum, avec une part de MCO sur les composants livrés par l'équipe.VOS MISSIONSBuild et automatisation du réseau cloud *    Livrer des fonctionnalités techniques sur les composants réseau, en sprints Scrum *    Développer et maintenir des API Python (FastAPI) placées devant les composants réseau, pour les brancher aux chaînes de provisioning *    Faire évoluer le provider Terraform interne et les modules associés *    Intégrer les composants réseau dans les parcours self-service (déclaration par YAML ou formulaire)Architecture réseau cloud *    Gérer les VPC : Shared VPC, Private Service Connect, Network Connectivity Center, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway *    Mettre en place la segmentation et l'inspection : security groups, VPC inspection, endpoints *    Gérer le transit : Cloud Router, Partner Interconnect, Direct Connect *    Faire évoluer l'architecture : hub-and-spoke chiffré (VPN), NCC (hubs, peering), raccordement de projets isolés via NAT, proxys et filtrage InternetRéférentiel, IPAM et DNS *    Alimenter le référentiel Netbox (assets, adressage) et développer les endpoints API qui le lisent et l'alimentent *    Gérer le DNS privé multi-cloud : Netbox, Cloud DNS, Route53, OctoDNS, InfobloxRun et amélioration continue *    Assurer le MCO des composants réseau, modules, scripts et automates de l'équipe *    Proposer et mettre en œuvre des améliorations techniques *    Participer aux projets d'innovation réseau, avec une veille IAOps *    Plus de 3 ans d'expérience en DevOps sur des composants réseau ou infrastructure *    Une expérience solide sur GCP, complétée par AWS *    Vous aimez autant concevoir des architectures réseau que les automatiser par le code *    Vous êtes attentif-ve aux enjeux de sécurité *    Français bilingue et anglais courant (contexte international)

jobs.title: Order & Delivery Coordinator (C-UAS)
jobs.description:
Your next mission

Anchor our system deliveries. Connect internal teams seamlessly – so our life-saving radars reach the front lines without delay.

As our Order & Delivery Coordinator (C-UAS), you run the administrative engine behind dispatching our IRIS radar systems. You take charge of order flows in Odoo ERP, align documentation, and organise clean internal handovers from Operations to dispatch readiness. Working alongside Project Management, Customer Success, and Operations, you keep our internal gears turning smoothly. Your sharp attention to detail ensures our teams stay focused and our radars deploy on schedule.

What you'll do

  • Order processing and data integrity: Process incoming sales orders in Odoo ERP across the entire lifecycle. Verify system data, hardware configurations, and commercial terms with high accuracy. Maintain order statuses, serial numbers, and delivery confirmations daily.

  • Compliance and export documentation: Compile and verify complete delivery documentation packages before dispatch. Review export control paperwork, QA certificates, shipping manifests, and packing lists. Ensure every system leaves our premises with watertight paperwork.

  • Logistics coordination and internal handovers: Coordinate handovers with the Warehouse and Logistics crew with complete shipping files. Monitor dispatch statuses once Operations releases each radar system. Keep internal handovers structured, clean, and ready for physical freight execution.

  • Cross-functional status tracking: Supply real-time ERP delivery status updates to Project Management and Customer Success. Share accurate tracking data and handover packages across departments. Monitor administrative workflows proactively to eliminate handover bottlenecks and protect dispatch targets.

What you bring

  • Vocational degree (MBO Level 4 / Associate degree) or equivalent practical experience in administration, supply chain, or logistics

  • 3+ years of experience in administrative support, order processing, or logistics coordination, preferably within a high-tech manufacturing or hardware environment

  • Practical experience working with ERP systems and databases (experience with Odoo is a strong advantage)

  • Experience handling compliance or logistics paperwork, such as shipping manifests, export control documentation, or QA certificates

  • Strong command of English (both written and spoken) and working proficiency in Dutch is considered a strong asset

  • High attention to detail with a methodical approach to data accuracy and documentation

  • Strong organisational and coordination skills to handle multiple handovers efficiently

  • Collaborative, supportive mindset suited for cross-functional internal operations

What we offer

  • Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

  • Commuting allowance;

  • 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

  • Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

  • High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role

  • An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning?

You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

jobs.title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 23 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition at Polarsteps - Senior Data & Analytics Engineer

Over the past 10+ years, Polarsteps has grown massively through word-of-mouth, thanks to our product and tech department building a top-quality user experience for all our travelers.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

We're expanding our protein expression into mammalian cell culture, for example in CHO and HEK cells. Our mammalian expression volume is growing fast. We're looking for a Cell Culture Engineer who has spent years growing and transfecting mammalian cells and knows what to do when a run goes wrong.

You'll work alongside our production and mammalian cell teams as a hands-on expert in the cell culture lab. You'll keep cultures healthy and on schedule, run transfections and expressions, and be the person the team turns to when yields drop or cells misbehave. This is a hands-on role, not a management role.

What You'll Do

  • Run mammalian expression. Maintain, expand, and passage cell lines, and run transfections and expressions on a production schedule.

  • Troubleshoot. When viability, growth, or yield falls off, find the cause and fix it.

  • Own the cell bank. Thaw, freeze, and track cell stocks, and protect the lines from contamination and drift.

  • Optimize conditions. Test culture and transfection conditions, and turn what works into the standard protocol.

  • Scale with automation. Work with our automation team to move cell handling onto liquid handlers as volume grows.

  • Hand off clean material. Deliver harvests ready for purification and downstream assays.

  • Keep the lab running. Look after incubators, biosafety cabinets, and cell counters, and keep the BSL-2 space organized and compliant.

  • Write SOPs and train. Document protocols that others can follow, and train the team on aseptic technique and our cell culture workflows.

What We're Looking For

  • Extensive hands-on experience with common mammalian model cell lines, for example CHO and HEK, including transfection and expression.

  • BSc / MSc in biotechnology, cell biology, or a relevant field.

  • A troubleshooting track record. You've rescued failing cultures and expressions and can explain what went wrong and why.

  • Flawless aseptic technique and experience working under BSL-2 conditions.

  • Experience with high-throughput formats: multi-well plates and many conditions in parallel, not only flasks.

  • Experience with liquid handlers is a plus.

  • Experience with antibody or Fc-fusion production is a plus.

  • Organized and precise. You track every stock, passage, and transfection, and you follow protocols exactly.

  • You use AI tools effectively and with discernment. We use them across the company and expect you to check, edit, and stand behind what they produce, not pass along unreviewed output.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift. Cells don't keep office hours, so you plan around them.

jobs.description:
Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer.

Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam krijg jij de kans om midden in de actie te staan. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze projectleider in de praktijk van energietransitie en energie-armoede. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over interventies: jij maakt impact.

Dit wordt jouw stage 

Wil jij meedenken over een maatschappelijk vraagstuk dat steeds urgenter wordt? Tijdens deze stage duik je in het thema energiearmoede: wat is het precies, waar speelt het en wat betekent dit voor ons als organisatie? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede 

 

Wat ga je doen? 
Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn. 

Je houdt je bezig met: 

  • Het in kaart brengen van wat energiearmoede betekent;  

  • Inzicht krijgen in waar het speelt en welke doelgroepen geraakt worden; 

  • Gesprekken voeren met corporaties en marktpartijen (interviews, ophalen van ervaringen en data); 

  • Onderzoeken welke oplossingen er zijn, zoals passief bouwen, minder installaties of slimme energieoplossingen; 

  • Vertalen van jouw inzichten naar een duidelijke visie: waar moeten wij ons op richten en hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? 

 

Het gaat hierbij niet om de techniek alleen, maar juist om de combinatie van sociale impact, marktontwikkelingen en strategie. 

Dit is jouw team

Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam is een ontwikkelende bouwer met zo'n 220 enthousiaste collega’s. Wij zijn onderdeel van de Divisie Bouw en Vastgoed en herkenbaar in groen en geel. Onze ambitie is groot en met veel enthousiasme ontwikkelen en bouwen we gezonde en fijne leefomgevingen, waar mensen zich thuis voelen. Benieuwd waar wij ons mee bezig houden? Bekijk hier een paar van onze huidige projecten: Projecten Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam


Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week;

  • Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven;

  • Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens;

  • De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer;

  • Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan!

 

Dit breng je mee 

  • Je doet een hbo- of wo-studie in de richting van bouwkunde, built environment, duurzaamheid, technische bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare studie; 

  • Nieuwsgierigheid naar veiligheid in de praktijk, vooral in de bouwsector;

  • Niet bang om je handen uit de mouwen te steken;

  • Proactief, sociaal en je werkt graag samen, maar weet ook zelfstandig je weg te vinden;

  • Beschikbaar vanaf februari 2027 voor minimaal 4 dagen per week.

 

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze Campus recruiter!

Heb je nog overige vragen? Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Sanne Jonk via 06 34955966 of  

Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel!

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Control Node
jobs.description:
About the Role

Destinus is looking for a highly motivated and hands-on mechanical engineer capable of delivering engineering solutions as part of the research and development in the Destinus Systems department. In this role you will design and develop a control node for air defence and strike systems, including all relevant mechanical subsystems. The ideal candidate is a strong team player with good social and communication skills to continuously coordinate with the peers of the respective engineering disciplines and teams, has a demonstrated ability to take technical ownership during development and drive technical solutions.

What you will do

· Generate 3D CAD models, drawings, schematics, bills of material, and other related documentation required for manufacturing, integration and testing

· Deliver technical documentation including any engineering calculations, analysis and assumptions required to substantiate your design decisions and solutions

· Create engineering design, prototypes, and manufacturing plans for an air defence and strike systems control node

· Manage suppliers and manufacturers by addressing any technical questions and resolving any issues which may arise during the manufacturing process.

· Select standard parts, fasteners, equipment, and consumables following best practices and industry standards

· Take ownership of your design work and closely coordinate with your peers in the engineering department across the involved engineering disciplines (systems, safety, electrical, aerospace, etc.)

· Coach junior engineers and interns in mechanical design, manufacturing and CAD.

· Support the product development process through the design review process (SRR, PDR, CDR etc.)

· Support and accompany the integration, assembly and manufacturing phases of the control nodes from a mechanical engineering point of view

· Drive innovation with new ideas to keep Destinus’ air defence and strike systems

· Support both the structured product development process as well as the rapid prototyping approach at the engineering department

Requirements

What you will need

· BSc. In Mechanical Engineering, Design Engineering or a related discipline.

· Ideally, technical training as a mechanical designer / drafter

· 2-5 years of working experience in mechanical engineering in defence or in a related industry sector (e.g. aerospace) with close ties to manufacturing

· Experience with design of automated solutions, special machines or test benches is a benefit

· Experience with Siemens NX is a must, experience with Teamcenter is a plus

· Ideally, experience in several different phases: design, build, integration, test, and operation.

· Knowledge of military standards (MIL-STD, STANAG, AECTP) and engineering and requirement management tools (Jama, Jira, Confluence etc.)

· Knowledge of relevant technical topics for military control nodes (communication protocols, tactical data links, firing control, radar sensors, safety etc.) is a plus

· Willingness to travel to different Destinus sites (max. 20%)

· Strong communication skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, international and multidisciplinary development team

· Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities

· Strong analytical skills and ability to work autonomously

· Fluency in English is required; German is a plus.

jobs.title: Data Platform Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week.

You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver.

At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people.
  • Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do.
  • Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source.
  • Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business.
  • Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence.
  • Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge.
  • Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question.
  • Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake.
  • Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5-8 years of data engineering experience, including real ownership of a lakehouse architecture rather than only delivering against someone else's.
  • Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience is strongly preferred — OneLake, lakehouses, Delta tables, the SQL analytics endpoint, Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks, and semantic models in Direct Lake mode. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously.
  • Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does.
  • Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL, solid PySpark, and comfort building and orchestrating pipelines yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams.
  • Practical understanding of Fabric capacity: how workloads consume it, how to spot what is burning it, and how to keep the platform inside its envelope.
  • Experience leading engineers — formally, or as a technical lead who set direction and mentored others. A first step into people management is welcome if the technical leadership is already there.
  • Proven integration experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, as well as APIs, flat-file landings, and change data capture from operational databases.
  • Solid data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling and an understanding of how a semantic layer serves Power BI.
  • Working knowledge of lineage, data governance, and access control in a cloud platform; exposure to Microsoft Purview is a plus.
  • Interest or experience in the data foundations behind AI assistants — retrieval, knowledge graphs, and preparing data so that an agent can answer with it.
  • Aerospace or another regulated industry is an advantage; so is experience in a start-up or scale-up.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Who You Are

You are an architect who never stops building. You have strong opinions about how a platform should be structured, and you earn the right to them by being in the code. You would rather make a design decision explicit and documented than let it live in one person's head.

You care more about reliability than novelty. You know that the measure of a data platform is whether people trust the numbers that come out of it on a Monday morning, not how modern the stack looks on a slide. When something breaks, you want to know why it was possible, not just how to patch it.

You enjoy growing engineers, and you understand that leading a small team means doing the work alongside them. Above all, you want to build something durable — a foundation that holds while the company scales on top of it.

jobs.title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Finance)
jobs.description:
About the role

Every number that reaches our leadership team, our board, and our auditors has to be right the first time — and that is where you come in. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Finance at Destinus, you are the bridge between the owners of our financial data, the CFO, and the wider finance team and the data in our lakehouse. You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it.

This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what finance needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the finance data in the lakehouse and building the dashboards the CFO and the finance team rely on. You will also improve the processes and systems that create the numbers in the first place, automate the manual work that eats the month, and make our finance data understandable to everyone who needs it, including our AI assistants.

At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). We are a fast-growing international group operating across several European entities, and the standards we hold our financial data to are rising just as quickly. Join us in building a finance reporting foundation that is accurate, traceable, and ready for any question asked of it.

What You'll Do

  • Be the go-to contact between the business owners of finance data — the CFO, accounts payable and receivable, and treasury — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards covering cash flow, receipts and collections, payables, and spend across the group, built on certified lakehouse data.
  • Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for finance: specify the tables, fields, and business rules — entities, currencies, financial dimensions, intercompany — and validate the result against the ledger before anyone relies on it.
  • Prepare and quality-check entity-level data extractions from our lakehouse and ERP in support of the external audit, and keep audit requests tracked from request to delivery.
  • Define and document finance KPI definitions in our KPI catalog — formulas, inclusions, exclusions, owners, and sources — to a standard that withstands external review.
  • Describe our finance data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first.
  • Automate what is manual today: turn recurring spreadsheet work, audit packs, and month-end routines into repeatable processes that largely run themselves.
  • Improve the finance processes and system configuration that create the data, working with the finance team and our ERP specialists, so that issues are fixed at source rather than corrected every month.
  • Help the finance team get more from the tools through training and self-service, so they can answer their own questions.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Economics, or a related field.
  • A genuine finance background is essential — experience in external or internal audit, controlling, financial reporting, or FP&A. This is not a data role with finance on the side; you need to understand the accounting behind the figures.
  • Confident with general ledger and subledger structures, trial balances, accounts payable and accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and the principles of IFRS.
  • Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills.
  • Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back.
  • Able to explain data to finance colleagues and accounting logic to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance is a strong advantage — the general ledger, accounts payable and accounts receivable modules, and the data structures underneath them. We run on D365, and someone who already knows it will be effective months earlier. An interest in improving how the system is configured and used matters as much as knowing where to click.
  • A track record of simplifying or automating a process, not only reporting on it.
  • Experience supporting an external audit, or working in a multi-entity, multi-currency international group, is a strong advantage.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred.

Who You Are

You are precise, and you are curious about where a number came from before you are comfortable reporting it — whether that means reading the ledger or querying the lakehouse. You know the difference between a figure that looks right and a figure that can be traced back to its source, and you care about the second one.

You are not content to rebuild the same report every month. When something is manual, repetitive, or fragile, your instinct is to go upstream and fix it rather than absorb it. You enjoy working with finance colleagues who ask hard questions, and you would rather be challenged on a detail than have it slip through.

Above all, you want your work to be relied on, by the CFO, by the board, and by anyone who audits it.
