jobs.title: Pharmacien.ne (Hospitalier.ère /Non-Hospitalier.ère - CDD - 38H - 2026-139
jobs.description:
Travailler au CHU Saint-Pierre, c'est rejoindre un hôpital universitaire de référence où l'expertise, l'innovation et la qualité des soins sont au cœur de chaque action. Notre institution place le patient au centre de ses priorités tout en poursuivant activement ses missions d'enseignement, de recherche et de santé publique.

Que vous soyez déjà spécialisé·e en pharmacie hospitalière ou en voie de spécialisation, cette fonction vous offre l'opportunité d'exercer un rôle central au sein d'un hôpital universitaire de référence, où l'expertise pharmaceutique est pleinement intégrée au parcours de soins du patient.

Bien plus qu'une fonction de dispensation, ce poste vous permettra de participer activement au développement de projets pharmaceutiques, à l'optimisation du circuit du médicament, à l'accompagnement des équipes soignantes et à l'amélioration continue de la qualité des soins.

En tant que Pharmacien.ne (Hospitalier.ère / Non-Hospitalier.ère), vous participez activement aux missions du Département Pharmacie et contribuez à la qualité, à la sécurité et à l'efficience de la prise en charge médicamenteuse des patients.

Vos responsabilités au quotidien sont :

Activités pharmaceutiques
  • Assurer la gestion quotidienne de l'officine hospitalière.
  • Réaliser la validation pharmaceutique des prescriptions.
  • Garantir l'approvisionnement des unités de soins, consultations et services.
  • Participer à la dispensation, la préparation et la délivrance des médicaments.
  • Participer aux activités de préparations magistrales, officinales et, le cas échéant, aux préparations stériles injectables.
  • Veiller à la bonne exécution des tâches administratives liées aux activités pharmaceutiques.
  • Contribuer à l'optimisation du circuit du médicament et à la sécurité médicamenteuse.
Qualité et amélioration continue
  • Participer à la démarche qualité conformément aux exigences PIC/S, BPF et aux processus d'accréditation.
  • Contribuer aux projets de développement, de modernisation et d'amélioration du Département Pharmacie.
  • Participer à l'élaboration, à la révision et au respect des procédures et recommandations internes.
  • Collaborer à la mise en œuvre de projets institutionnels et transversaux.
Formation et collaboration multidisciplinaire
  • Participer à la formation et à l'encadrement des assistants pharmaceutico-techniques, collaborateurs et étudiants.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les médecins, infirmiers et autres professionnels de santé.
  • Participer aux groupes de travail, commissions et comités multidisciplinaires.
  • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la qualité des soins et des pratiques pharmaceutiques.

Continuité des soins

  • Participer au rôle de garde selon l'organisation du service.
  • Assurer toute autre mission contribuant au bon fonctionnement de la pharmacie hospitalière.

Profil recherché :

  • Disposer d'un Master en pharmacie et/ou hospitalier.ère acquis au cours d’un MC (Master Complémentaire) en Pharmacie hospitalière ou DES (Diplôme d'Etudes Spécialisées) ou d'une licence spéciale en pharmacie hospitalière ou vous êtes porteur du titre de pharmacien(ne) hospitalier(ère).
  • D'une qualification de pharmacien Hospitalier ou êtes en cours de spécialisation (dernière année) est un atout majeur.
  • Etre en possession du visa, de l'agrément requis pour l’exercice de la profession et être inscrire à l'ordre des pharmaciens.
  • Une expérience en pharmacie hospitalière ou en pharmacie d'officine constitue un réel atout.
  • Satisfaire aux conditions légales de bilinguisme : vous avez de bonnes connaissances de la seconde langue nationale ou vous êtes disposé à les acquérir (cours de langues organisés en interne sur le temps de travail, possibilité d’obtenir une prime de bilinguisme SELOR de 150€ bruts sous réserve de la remise du Selor Art. 10).
  • Satisfaire à l’entretien de sélection.
  • Satisfaire aux conditions du profil.

Qualités requises :

  • Maîtrisez les connaissances en pharmacologie, thérapeutique et réglementation pharmaceutique.
  • Possédez une excellente connaissance du circuit du médicament et des bonnes pratiques pharmaceutiques.
  • Faites preuve de rigueur, d'organisation et de méthode.
  • Disposez d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.
  • Êtes capable de travailler de manière autonome tout en favorisant le travail d'équipe.
  • Avez le sens des responsabilités et une approche orientée qualité et sécurité.
  • Maîtrisez les outils informatiques et les logiciels de gestion pharmaceutique.
  • Faites preuve de discrétion, de disponibilité et de réactivité.

Le CHU Saint-Pierre est un hôpital public et universitaire de référence, offrant des soins de grande qualité accessibles à tous.

Dans ce cadre, il relève quotidiennement les défis de la santé publique tout en déclinant son caractère universitaire via une implication active dans l’enseignement et la recherche.

Les chiffres clés qui caractérisent l’hôpital sont les suivants :

  • 450.000 consultations/an
  • 45.000 admissions/an
  • 23.000 opérations chirurgicales/an
  • 85.000 passages aux urgences/an
  • 2900 accouchements/an
  • 3200 collaborateurs dont 400 médecins

Le respect, l’innovation, l’engagement, la qualité et la solidarité sont les valeurs clés de l’hôpital. Toutes et tous s’attèlent à placer le patient au centre de leur action. Les réponses aux réalités sociales, la tolérance, le libre-examen et la capacité à se mobiliser au quotidien pour les patients, bruxellois et non-bruxellois, sont les moteurs de ses actions.

La quête de l’excellence en médecine de pointe et l’approche multidisciplinaire, font de l’hôpital une référence sur le plan national.

Le CHU St Pierre travaille également en étroite collaboration avec de nombreux partenaires comme les médecins généralistes, médecins spécialistes référents, les CPAS et les autres institutions d’aides et de soins en Région bruxelloise.

Travailler au CHU Saint-Pierre, c’est à la fois faire partie d’un hôpital ancré dans la Ville depuis plusieurs siècles et d’un réseau hospitalier moderne en développement rapide, CHORUS, plus grand réseau hospitalier en Belgique. Travailler au CHU Saint-Pierre, c’est faire partie d’un groupe soudé, soutenant, au sein duquel chaque personne a sa place, afin d’offrir un service optimal. La satisfaction de nos patients et notre bien-être au travail sont nos priorités.

Offre:

Rejoindre le CHU Saint-Pierre, c'est intégrer un hôpital universitaire dynamique où l’expertise, l’innovation et la collaboration multidisciplinaire sont au cœur de la prise en charge des patients.

Nous vous offrons un environnement de travail stimulantdes perspectives d'évolution et l'opportunité de contribuer activement à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée pour les patients et les équipes.

Barème de rémunération

  • Fonction IFIC : Pharmacien hospitalier (3070) / Pharmacien Non Hospitalier (9000)
  • Fonction interne : Pharmacien hospitalier - FI5 / Fonction manquante (FI6)
  • Catégorie IFIC : un salaire attractif en lien avec votre niveau de formation et votre expérience

Des avantages extra-légaux

  • Des chèques repas d’une valeur de 7,30€
  • Des tarifs préférentiels en matière de soins médicaux dans tous les hôpitaux du réseau IRIS (pour vous, votre conjoint, vos ascendants ou descendants à charge)
  • La gratuité des transports via la STIB et un remboursement de 80% dans les frais de transport en commun et/ou des indemnités vélo
  • Une prime annuelle d’attractivité
  • Une assurance Plan Pension (de 1 à 3% à charge de l’employeur)
  • Une allocation mensuelle de bilinguisme de 150€ bruts (sous réserve de la remise du brevet Selor Art. 10)
  • 24 jours de congés légaux et 5 jours de congés extra-légaux (+ les différents congés de circonstance)
  • Des réductions chez de nombreux fournisseurs via le système Benefits@work
  • De multiples opportunités de carrières au sein d’un grand réseau (IRIS)
  • Un parcours d’intégration personnalisé pour vous accompagner dans votre prise de poste
  • Un programme de formations qui vous permettra d’évoluer tout au long de votre carrière.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical & Piping Project Engineer - Technical Lead
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

This position centres on senior technical project engineering rather than administrative coordination or traditional project management. As Technical Lead on multidisciplinary CAPEX projects, you help develop and deliver solutions that are safe, feasible and maintainable within a controlled project setting.

You will work in an operational brownfield environment where safety, reliability, technical quality and minimal disruption to production are key considerations. The role combines specialist Mechanical & Piping expertise with a broad understanding of engineering, execution and handover activities.

Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain the technical basis, design philosophy, project scope and battery limits.
  • Coordinate engineering activities across disciplines, with Mechanical & Piping as the core area and close collaboration with process, E&I, automation, civil, safety and infrastructure teams.
  • Plan and lead design reviews, assessing solutions against safety, compliance, functionality, reliability, maintainability, constructability and lifecycle value.
  • Translate process and project requirements into Mechanical & Piping concepts and oversee the quality of layouts, P&IDs, equipment specifications, piping classes, routing and isometrics.
  • Assess technical alternatives in terms of feasibility, safety, reliability and cost-effectiveness.
  • Provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors, while critically reviewing their content, quality, planning and completeness of deliverables.
  • Support technical decisions, document assumptions and deviations, and keep decisions and follow-up actions traceable.
  • Identify technical and project risks and evaluate the impact of changes on scope, schedule, cost, execution and business continuity.
  • Contribute to technical specifications, tender packages, bid evaluations, supplier selection and technical clarifications related to contracts.
  • Follow up relevant Mechanical & Piping activities, including fabrication, inspections, FAT, delivery, installation, SAT and punch-list management through mechanical completion.
  • Provide engineering support during construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover.
  • Assist the Project Manager with clear technical recommendations and transparent reporting to stakeholders.
  • Coach engineers and help develop project engineering standards, methodologies, lessons learned and knowledge sharing.

Location

Olen, with 100% onsite presence.

Selection procedure

The selection process includes two interview rounds: an initial interview via Teams, followed by an on-site interview with a business case.

  • You hold a master's degree in a technical discipline, or have reached an equivalent level through relevant experience. A background in electromechanics or chemical technology is particularly relevant.
  • You have extensive experience in technical design and engineering in an industrial or process environment.
  • You bring demonstrable specialist knowledge of Mechanical & Piping engineering within the process industry or another heavy industrial environment.
  • You have proven experience with multidisciplinary CAPEX projects, from concept and basic engineering through execution and completion.
  • You are able to provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors and critically evaluate their deliverables.
  • You are familiar with applicable Mechanical & Piping standards and good engineering practices, including PED, ATEX and EN 13480.
  • You hold a VCA-VOL certificate or are willing to obtain one before starting.
  • Knowledge of AutoCAD Plant 3D is an advantage.
  • You can work with project controls covering scope, schedule, costs, risks, changes and stakeholder management.
  • You combine technical depth with a broad overview, decisiveness and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
  • You explain complex technical topics clearly and collaborate effectively with different stakeholders.
  • You work in a structured, autonomous and results-oriented way and demonstrate a strong sense of ownership.
  • You communicate fluently in Dutch and professionally in English. Other languages are an advantage.

The Brussels Pfizer Clinical Research Unit, Participants and Recruitment and Engagement Lead (BR PCRU Participants and Recruitment and Engagement Lead) provides strategic and operational leadership for participants recruitment at the Brussels Pfizer Clinical Research Unit, ensuring high-quality service delivery. The Lead ensures ethical, inclusive, and participant-centred identification, engagement, pre-screening, and enrolment of healthy volunteers and special populations while safeguarding participants' rights, safety and privacy. The role supports timely, compliant study delivery and translates site and portfolio priorities into data driven recruitment strategies aligned with R&D goals. The Lead builds high-performing teams that responsibly use approved AI, automation, risk based strategy and analytics to improve targeting, forecasting, database management, and decision-making while maintaining human oversight, ethics, and participants data privacy.

Key accountabilities include:

  • local recruitment strategy and delivery;
  • study feasibility and portfolio forecasting;
  • enrolment-risk management;
  • participant experience and ethical recruitment;
  • team, capacity and budget leadership;
  • recruitment data quality and privacy compliance;
  • vendor/channel performance;
  • digital enablement and continuous improvement;
  • local cross-functional coordination; and
  • cross-site sharing of practice through PCRU governance

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Recruitment Governance and Resource Oversight:

  • Capacity and resource planning
  • Colleague and contractor allocation
  • Recruitment channel and vendor management
  • Advertising, outreach and budget management
  • Workload, training and competency oversight
  • Team Performance management
  • Inspection and audit readiness
  • Business continuity to sustain critical recruitment activities during operational disruption or resource constraints.
  • Database health and participant-contact quality supporting privacy, data quality and positive participant engagement.

Strategic Participant Recruitment & Portfolio Delivery

  • Recruitment strategy: Lead the development and delivery of the Brussels PCRU participant recruitment strategy in line with site priorities and the resource parameters established by the Brussels Site Head.
  • Predictive planning and protocol feasibility: Shape early study strategy by assessing recruitment feasibility, developing evidence-based plans aligned with timelines, quality and budget, and proactively mitigating or escalating risks.
  • Compliance, ethics and process improvement: Develop, implement and continuously improve applicable local procedures, ensuring team compliance with relevant Pfizer policies, SOPs and work instructions.
  • Participant data stewardship: Ensure recruitment data are collected, maintained, accessed and used in accordance with privacy requirements, consent provisions, Pfizer standards and defined data-owner and data-steward accountabilities.

Digital Innovation, Automation & Responsible Adoption

  • Digitalization and automation opportunities: Identify high-value opportunities to simplify processes, increase efficiency and improve operational outcomes through appropriate digital t...

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in life science, health-related, data science, or healthcare administration discipline is required.
  • Clinical Experience: Minimum of 15 years of experience in clinical trial operations or participant recruitment, with at least 7 years within a pharmaceutical company or a Contract Research Organization (CRO) environment.
  • Digital & Analytics Literacy: Demonstrated experience evaluating, adopting, or implementing advanced digital systems, automated databases, or AI-enabled tools to optimize operations, analyze datasets, and support executive-level business decisions.
  • Leadership Track Record: Minimum of 5 years of experience leading teams, managing personnel, directing complex operational processes, and navigating organizational change management.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strategic & Systems Thinking: Outstanding capability to translate complex operational data, digital dashboards, and AI-generated models into clear, actionable recruitment strategies and executive-level recommendations.

Head of Product
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

The opportunity

Our engineering teams build a product that enterprises run their purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes on every day. Much of the product knowledge behind it sits with our founders and domain experts. As we grow, we are moving from a project-oriented model, where features come top-down and success is measured by output, to a product-oriented one: empowered teams that own problems end-to-end and are measured by their impact on customers and the business.

As Head of Product, you lead that shift. You build the product management practice for the BLP Platform from an early stage. Our first product managers are joining stream-aligned teams, starting with Invoice and Procurement, and the team will grow to 4–5 PMs as we expand. You hire them, coach them, and set the standard for what great product work looks like at BLP.

You report to the CTO and work closely with Engineering, Projects, Sales, and our founders.

What you’ll do

  • Build and lead the product management practice for the BLP Platform: hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers as we scale.

  • Move the product organization from an output-driven model to an outcome-driven one.

  • Establish the product management craft at BLP: discovery practices, evidence-based decision making, and a clear standard for what “good” looks like in the role.

  • Transfer product knowledge out of the experts’ heads and into the teams, without losing the domain depth that got us here.

  • Build the direct line between our teams and our customers.

  • Make our data usable for product decisions. We have BigQuery, PostHog, and prediction-rate analytics available, and we want product managers who reach for them by default.

  • Shape how the product organization works as we grow: intake, prioritization, roadmapping, and the operating rhythm.

  • Contribute directly to product strategy for the platform.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in product management, including experience leading or formally coaching product managers, with a real point of view on how product people are developed.

  • Experience working in an empowered product model, where teams were assigned problems to solve rather than features to build.

  • A track record of shipping enterprise B2B software that customers actually adopted.

  • Experience moving an organization toward an empowered product model, including the political and cultural side of it.

  • The ability to hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives, and to say no in a way that keeps the relationship.

  • Entrepreneurial judgment: comfortable operating with incomplete information, choosing a direction, and owning the result.

  • Fluent English.

  • Enterprise ERP or finance exposure, experience with AI or agentic products in production (particularly reliability, evaluation, and trust in enterprise settings), and German are a plus.

Why BLP

  • Build a function: you shape how product management works at BLP while the team grows.

  • Direct work with the CTO and founders on product strategy for the platform.

  • A product with deep domain substance and a large enterprise customer base to learn from.

  • Employee participation plan.

How we work

  • Impact: We create measurable business outcomes.

  • Transparency: We build trust through openness.

  • Ownership: We take responsibility for outcomes.

  • Excellence: We relentlessly strive for greatness.

Practical information

  • Location: hybrid from our Zurich, London, Munich or Cologne offices, or remote elsewhere in Europe.

  • Employment: full-time, permanent.

dnata is more than a global air and travel services provider. We connect people with possibilities and opportunities across 130+ airports in 34 countries through ground handling, cargo, travel, and catering & retail services. Our purpose is clear: to deliver on the promises our customers make. We are powered by a bold vision to be the world’s most admired air and travel services provider, which guides our strategy, culture, and every role across our teams. Our core values fuel everything we do: we are safe, we play to win, we respect everyone and work together as a team, and we are future thinking. At dnata, we foster diversity, nurture ambition, and celebrate achievement. If you're inspired by purpose and motivated to be part of a global team shaping the future of aviation and travel, we’d love to have you onboard.

Over de rol

Een goede stage kan het begin zijn van een mooie carrière. Als Stagecoördinator bij dnata Passenger Services speel jij een belangrijke rol in het creëren van een leerzame, veilige en succesvolle stageperiode. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan de ontwikkeling van jonge professionals, maar ook aan de toekomstige personeelsbezetting en talentontwikkeling van Passenger Services!

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Instroom en introductie: Je brengt de behoefte aan stagiairs en de beschikbare begeleidingscapaciteit in kaart. Je voert sollicitatiegesprekken, stemt de selectie en plaatsing af met Recruitment en leidinggevenden en coördineert de introductie, trainingen en stageafspraken.

  • Talentontwikkeling en doorstroom: Je volgt de stage-ervaring en toekomstwensen van stagiairs, signaleert mogelijke uitval en onderzoekt de redenen voor voortijdig vertrek. Je adviseert Duty Managers en Recruitment over geschikte kandidaten voor een dienstverband en coördineert de overdracht na afloop van de stage.

  • Monitoring en verbetering: Je houdt gegevens bij over instroom, lopende stages, afronding, uitval en doorstroom. Je rapporteert over de voortgang en begeleidingscapaciteit, signaleert knelpunten en doet voorstellen om het stageproces continu te verbeteren.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Security Engineer - Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Security Engineer. Iemand die veel energie krijgt van het opbouwen van een nieuw technisch securitydomein. Een gedreven specialist die graag zelf de regie neemt over de inrichting van moderne tooling en veilige architectuur.

Jouw rol

Als Security Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de technische beveiliging van onze infrastructuur, interne werkplekken en cloudomgevingen. Je bouwt het securitydomein verder uit en selecteert de juiste tooling voor Dawn. Je beheert de gekozen systemen en richt deze tot in de puntjes in. Daarbij vertaal je complexe techniek naar een gedegen en onderbouwd advies voor verschillende afdelingen. Je vormt hiermee de verbindende brug tussen tech leads, hostingteams en Interne IT. Beleid en compliance pakt het ISO-team op, zo kun jij je volledig op de techniek focussen.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Je werkt mee aan en verbetert centrale security-tooling zoals EDR en SIEM.

  • Je werkt hands-on aan kwetsbaarhedenbeheer, actieve detectie, monitoring en het ontwerpen van hardening-standaarden.

  • Je adviseert tech leads en hostingteams over veilige architectuur en helpt hen bij security-initiatieven.

  • Je fungeert als het vaste technische aanspreekpunt voor het SOC en beoordeelt samen escalaties.

  • Je draait mee in de technische analyse bij incidenten en bewaart de rust binnen het crisisteam.


Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een hbo-denkniveau en bij voorkeur een achtergrond in Cyber Security of Informatica. Je brengt een stevige basis mee in security engineering of infrastructuurbeveiliging. Je bezit hands-on ervaring met moderne security controls, IAM, secure configuration en kwetsbaarhedenmanagement. Kennis van cloudomgevingen zoals AWS en affiniteit met netwerkarchitectuur is een grote pré.

Je bent zeer leergierig naar nieuwe technieken en toetst gemaakte keuzes altijd scherp en kritisch. Je zoekt actief de verbinding met collega's om samen de beveiliging naar een hoger niveau te brengen. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels en bent bereid om (hybride) te werken op onze kantoren in Geldermalsen en Hilversum.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: Je beveiligt cruciale systemen voor Dawn Technology en haar klanten.

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €6.000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om volop te ontspannen.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Gezellige werksfeer, flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en verzorgde lunch op kantoor (verschillende locaties maar je bent voornamelijk te vinden in Geldermalsen en Hilversum).

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding en een fiscaal fietsplan.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen, van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit op deze rol, nodigen we je juist uit om te solliciteren. We denken namelijk graag met je mee! Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment om de match met de rol objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

jobs.title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
jobs.description:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. 

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.

 
Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.

 
Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.

 
Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.

 
Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

•    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;   

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
•    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
•    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
•    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
•    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
•    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
•    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
•    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.

 
•    ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
•    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
•    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
•    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
•    sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
•    onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
•    afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
•    samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
•    signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
•    richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
•    kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
•    organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.
 

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. 


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

Onze missie is om nieuwe technologie praktisch en veilig toepasbaar te maken en daarmee de Nederlandse (en Europese) industrie en overheid te helpen om voorop te lopen. We geven goed onderbouwde adviezen aan beleidsbepalers, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Afgeronde WO master in een technische richting zoals luchtvaarttechniek, elektrotechniek of informatica;

  • Tenminste 5 jaren relevante werkervaring;

  • Ontwikkeling van lucht- en ruimtevaarttuigen en klimaat neutrale luchtvaart spreken je aan als werkgebieden;

  • De ambitie om expert te worden op het gebied van flight test en certificatie;

  • Affiniteit met werken voor Defensie, en liefst kennis van de Defensie organisatie;

  • Bewezen capaciteiten als projectleider voor grote projecten;

  • In staat zijn om klantenwensen te vertalen en een brug te slaan tussen techniek en operationele impact;

  • Positieve instelling, initiatiefrijk, flexibel, resultaatgericht;

  • Communicatief vaardig in het Nederlands en Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau)

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightech omgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden wij jou onder anderen:

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer;

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA, als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

De afdeling Flight Test en Certificatie (ASTC) richt zich op het ondersteunen van de Nederlandse overheid (Defensie, EZK, IenW) en markt waarin thema’s als "bescherming van de samenleving" en “Klimaat neutrale luchtvaart” belangrijke uitgangspunten zijn. We voeren experimenten en vliegproeven uit met onze eigen vliegtuigen, geschaalde vliegtuigen en drones. We ondersteunen vliegproeven met vliegtuigen van klanten. Dit kan zijn voor een onderzoeksprogramma’s of om te bewijzen dat we radicale en nieuwe concepten op een veilige manier effectiever en sneller kunnen certificeren. We zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor modificaties aan onze research vliegtuigen en bewijzen dat deze veilig zijn.

We zijn georganiseerd in twee marktgeoriënteerde teams, Flight Test Support en Certification Support. Veel collega’s zijn in beide teams actief en werken vaak buiten de afdeling in multi-disciplinair verband. Er worden goede mogelijkheden geboden om je eigen ontwikkeling vorm te geven.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Bel of mail dan met Frank Bax (recruiter) via 0615676915 of Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

 

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

jobs.title: Integration Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Role - Integration Test Engineer

Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy

Location - Utrecht

About iwell

At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof. 

We are a fast-growing international team of driven and collaborative talents, from engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact: iwell is committed to form a diverse and inclusive team to tackle the challenges of the energy transition.  

The Role

The proof is in the pudding, they say in the UK, however, we believe proof is in the test data. All our systems and their interactions within the larger energy ecosystem are thoroughly tested. We are serving a diverse customer base with strict demands, our services power business and key infrastructure. We demand that our products are subjected to a wide range of testing during the integration and development phase. We're seeking a talented and curious test engineer with a passion for sustainability and battery energy storage. 

You will handle a wide variety of topics from different customer requirements and have a lot of freedom to develop the test methodology and strategy. You will work within the battery system team, where software and hardware come together in the products we develop for our customers.  We will rely on your experience, hands-on approach and judgment. You will be crucial in driving our mission of transitioning from fossil-fuel dependence. If you're passionate about sustainability and have the technical skills to bring our vision to life, we want to hear from you.

What you will do

  • Develop test campaigns based on internal and external requirements

  • Discuss and present test results internally and externally

  • Execute tests and document the result

  • Support the integration of hardware components into iwell’s BESS, ensuring compatibility and performance.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, such as system specifications,  processes, and instructions.

  • You will become one of the practical system experts within iwell, interacting with field service, product development and engineering teams.

What are looking for

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering (HBO/WO) or equivalent experience.

  • Experience in electrical design of high power and energy conversion systems.

  • Knowledge of technical standards and grid operator connection requirements.

  • Able to make the basic design for a site with energy production and storage, feeding into the Medium Voltage AC grid, including cable system design, PE system design and according to national installation guidelines.

  • Strong communication skills and attention to quality assurance

  • Ability to read and produce technical drawings and schematics

  • Ability to speak and write German is a plus

Note: at iwell, we value growth potential over perfection. Feel free to respond if you can see yourself meeting this list in the (near) future.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary within the range of EUR 5,200 - 5,800 (plus 8% holiday allowance)

  • 30 holidays per year, plus an annual company trip of 3 days

  • The opportunity to do volunteer work, by offering 1 volunteer day per year

  • Learning & Development budget of EUR 1,500 per year 

  • Attractive pension plan with Brand New Day 

  • Working remotely for 2 weeks per year 

  • We cover your travel costs, regardless of whether you come by bike, car, or public transport.

  • A mobile phone allowance of EUR 25 per month

  • Additional activities such as a bootcamp, volleyball tournament, company drinks etc.

  • iwell is a family friendly company and employs many employees with care-taking responsibilities

Interested?

For more information about iwell, what we do, why we do it, and an overview of our partners, visit https://iwell.eu/. 

Our application process

  1. Apply. Our People & Culture Team and the hiring manager will review your application and will respond within 2 weeks.

  2. Phone screening. Are you an iweller-in-the-making? We will invite you for an introductory call.

  3. Are you the one? You will have two or more interviews. For some roles, you will also be asked to work on a case.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role

At ClickHouse, we believe in making product decisions grounded in data, not gut feelings. To support that, we've built a comprehensive internal data warehouse — read more about it on our blog. It powers analytics, forecasting, and decision-making across every team in the company.

Our stack centers on ClickHouse as the core storage and processing engine, complemented by dbt, Airflow, S3, AWS, Superset, and GitHub Actions. We ingest data from 30+ distinct external sources, process over 2.5 PB of data, and deliver most data marts to business consumers with a 1-hour end-to-end latency - a standard that demands highly optimized, rock-solid transformation pipelines.

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help evolve the DWH platform, push its technical boundaries, and deliver reliable, high-performance data models to business users across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  1. DWH Platform Development

    • Design and develop reusable Airflow components - operators, connectors, and hooks - along with custom integrations tailored to our data architecture.

    • Build reusable dbt macros and abstractions: incremental strategies, ETL building blocks, and generic data quality tests, all optimized for ClickHouse-specific behavior and our data patterns.

    • Develop DataOps tooling - CI pipelines, data migration frameworks, and security controls - with a strong focus on reliability, self-service usability, and scale.

  2. Team contributions

    • Conduct thorough code reviews for team members and other team contributors.

    • Actively participate in technical and architectural design discussions.

    • Drive technical leadership in specific areas of our stack.

    • Continuously improve the team's development environment, with a focus on automation - including AI-assisted workflows.

    • Contribute to platform stability through proactive troubleshooting and timely incident resolution.

  3. Data modeling

    • Develop, refactor, and optimize business data models in line with our modeling standards and ClickHouse best practices.

    • Mentor and support contributors through code reviews and technical guidance.

    • Lead the design and implementation of the most technically demanding data marts - particularly those involving high data velocity, large volumes, or complex business logic.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Exceptional SQL skills - this is non-negotiable.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Airflow, dbt, and Python.

  • Proven track record building and optimizing large-scale, high-throughput data pipelines.

  • Solid understanding of data warehousing fundamentals: ETL/ELT, dimensional modeling, and data quality.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • Comfortable thriving in a fast-paced startup environment — exciting and dynamic, but sometimes wonderfully chaotic.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with ClickHouse - a significant advantage.

  • Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms.

  • Experience with CI/CD development, especially using GitHub Actions.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

The Product Metrics team owns the collection, storage, and serving of metrics collected from customers' ClickHouse instances. As a part of the team you will be responsible for designing, building, operating and maintaining components of the petabyte-scale platform that stores trillions of records and processes millions of new events every second, owning its reliability, performance and availability. Our stack is built using Golang, runs in Kubernetes, and is, of course, stored in ClickHouse. The team’s responsibilities include gathering and processing data for the internal billing and accounting system as well as customer-facing dashboards that provide our customers with immediate insights and analytics. The Product Metrics system is specifically designed to prioritize delivery guarantees, precision, and accuracy in handling extensive data volumes. Its primary goal is to provide data that is both prompt and accurate, supporting reliable operational decisions and enhancing the overall customer experience.

jobs.title: Senior Partnership Manager Germany
jobs.description:
Help build fair, engaged and high-performing teams.
We believe everyone deserves a fair opportunity to develop and be rewarded for the value they bring. That's why we build software that helps organizations set clear expectations, define what a role entails, assess performance fairly, support employee growth and make compensation transparent and explainable. From clear roles to fair rewards, all within one continuous process. 

We do this with a driven team of 55+ colleagues. Hundreds of companies in the Netherlands, from scale-ups to corporates, already use Learned. Now we're taking the next step: Germany. 

As Senior Partnership Manager Germany you're part of our founding DE team. You build the partner channel from scratch and become the face of Learned in the German HR ecosystem.

Lay the foundation for our partner channel in Germany

You build our German partner channel from the ground up. You decide how we do partnerships in Germany, and then you make it happen: from the first partner to a network that brings in a steady flow of new business.

Our network has two parts:

  • Implementation partners: HR consultants and advisory firms that bring Learned to their clients.

  • Learning partners: companies specialized in job evaluation and learning & development.

What you’ll do

  • Set the strategy. Map the German HR ecosystem and decide which partners to focus on first. Set clear targets for the channel and make sure partners and direct sales strengthen each other.

  • Build the foundation. Shape the partner model for Germany: partner tiers, the commercial terms, and the playbook and processes that let the channel grow. Our Dutch partner programme is your starting point. You adapt it to the German market.

  • Find and close new partners. Start conversations at board level, then negotiate and close partnerships.

  • Turn partners into growth. Onboard and enable partners, build joint plans and turn them into a steady source of new business.

  • Activate the market. Put Learned on the map in Germany with partner and customer events, such as roundtables, webinars and breakfast sessions. You work together with marketing and get operational support for running them.

How your time is split (at the start)

  • ~50%: Finding new partners

  • ~30%: Partner management

  • ~10%: Events and activation

  • ~10%: Strategy

As the network grows, your focus shifts towards partner management and scaling the channel. You might also build a team around it.

Who you work with

You report to our Partnership Lead in NL and work closely with our Founding Account Executive Germany..

Where you'll work

You choose one of two setups:

  • Based in or around Düsseldorf or Cologne. You work remotely in North Rhine-Westphalia, close to your partners and visit our office in Utrecht regularly. We plan to open an office in Düsseldorf or Cologne, and you'll help build it.

  • Based in or around Utrecht (NL). You work from our office in Utrecht and travel to the NRW region about twice a month for a few days.

Either way, you start with an onboarding at our office in Utrecht.


Who you are

  • A bachelor's or master's level of thinking and working

  • At least 8 years of experience in business development, partnerships, sales or account management, ideally in SaaS or HR tech

  • A track record of building partner channels or new markets from scratch

  • An existing network in the German HR, consulting or HR-tech ecosystem is a big plus

  • Native German speaker and fluent in English. Dutch is a plus.

  • You're an entrepreneurial hunter: you open doors, talk easily at board level and close deals on your own

  • You're organised, think strategically and keep the overview while doing the hands-on work

  • You have an affinity with HR, learning & development or technology

What we offer

We're ambitious and entrepreneurial, and we take steps towards our big goals together every day. Having fun matters just as much. You get:

  • €70,000 – €80,000 base salary and €90,000 – €100,000 OTE gross per year

  • A rare chance to be part of our founding team in Germany and shape the market from day one

  • A local employment contract in Germany through our employer of record partner (or a Dutch contract if you're based in the Netherlands)

  • A MacBook and everything you need to do your job well

  • 25 vacation days (full-time)

  • Travel allowance and travel costs for your trips to Germany or the Netherlands

  • A personal development budget of €1,000 per year

  • An ambitious, international team with 7+ nationalities, where we keep each other sharp and celebrate successes

  • When you're in Utrecht: a daily (healthy) lunch with the team and a fun team activity every month

Excited to learn more about this opportunity and whether there’s a potential match? There's only one way to find out. Apply now as Senior Partnership Manager Germany!

jobs.title: Legal, Risk & Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
ZTL Payment Solution | Oslo, Norway

Help shape the future of B2B payments while building trust, sound governance and responsible growth.

About ZTL Payment Solution

ZTL is a pioneering Fintech company revolutionizing B2B payments by leveraging the Open Banking initiative and PSD2 regulations. Our innovative platform integrates seamlessly with ERP Accounting Systems, enabling SMEs to execute domestic and international invoice payments efficiently while accessing real-time balances and transaction data. With PSD2 licenses for Payment Initiation and Account Information, plus a money-transfer license from the Norwegian Financial Supervisory Authority, we are poised to become the leading B2B payment platform in the Nordics and beyond. Join us to shape the future of payments with a dynamic, entrepreneurial team.

The opportunity

We are looking for a pragmatic and commercially minded Legal, Risk & Compliance Officer to help ZTL scale responsibly across the Nordics and Europe. You will be a trusted adviser to colleagues across the business, translate complex regulatory requirements into practical solutions, and strengthen our risk and compliance framework without slowing innovation. This is a broad, hands-on role with visibility across management, product, technology, operations and external partners.

What you will do

  • Provide clear, solution-oriented legal advice on payment services, commercial agreements, partnerships, products and regulatory matters; coordinate external counsel where appropriate.

  • Monitor and interpret relevant Norwegian and EU requirements, including PSD2/payment services regulation, AML/CTF, sanctions, data protection and DORA; assess impacts and coordinate implementation.

  • Maintain and improve ZTL’s compliance programme, policies, procedures, controls and regulatory obligations register, applying a proportionate, risk-based approach.

  • Coordinate enterprise and operational risk assessments, risk appetite and control follow-up; maintain actionable risk and issue reporting for management and the Board.

  • Plan and perform independent compliance monitoring, thematic reviews and control testing; document findings, agree remediation actions and track them to closure.

  • Support regulatory reporting, supervisory dialogue, inspections and responses to Finanstilsynet, in collaboration with relevant accountable functions.

  • Partner with technology, security and operations on ICT third-party risk, incident management, business continuity, operational resilience and changes to products and processes.

  • Advise on customer and partner due diligence, financial crime controls and safeguarding-related governance, working closely with the designated AML and operational owners.

  • Draft and negotiate contracts, assess new markets and partnerships, and help embed compliance-by-design into product development.

  • Build awareness through concise training, practical guidance and constructive challenge; foster a culture of integrity, ownership and sound decision-making.

What you bring

  • A degree in law (Master of Laws / cand.jur. or equivalent) is preferred; a relevant higher degree combined with strong legal and regulatory experience may also be considered.

  • Relevant experience in legal, risk or compliance roles within regulated financial services, payments, banking or Fintech.

  • Working knowledge of Norwegian and EU financial-services regulation, with the ability to navigate complex requirements and explain them simply.

  • Experience with risk assessments, compliance monitoring, policy frameworks, governance and/or commercial contract work.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a Scandinavian language and English; strong judgement, integrity and attention to detail.

  • A collaborative, self-directed approach: comfortable prioritising, challenging constructively and turning advice into workable action.

Why join ZTL?

  • Meaningful influence on how a regulated Fintech scale-up builds its next phase of products and partnerships.

  • Close collaboration with decision-makers and a talented, entrepreneurial team.

  • A varied role combining strategic judgement with practical execution, professional development and real ownership.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, and an open, inclusive working environment.

Interested?

We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives. If you meet many, but not all, of the criteria and are excited about our mission, we encourage you to apply. Learn more at www.ztlpay.io. Any background or suitability checks will be proportionate to the role and carried out in accordance with applicable requirements.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

ZTL is a challenger to the banks' "Transactional Services". We're a cloud-native SaaS hybrid B2B payment company in the early expansion phase. We integrate our Open Banking APIs into various ERPs and API platforms to build new business models within payment services. Drop us an email if you want to explore opportunities.

jobs.title: VODITELJ / VODITELJICA SKLADIŠTA
jobs.description:
Mesna industrija Ravlić jedna je od vodećih hrvatskih mesnih industrija s dugogodišnjom tradicijom u proizvodnji i prodaji svježeg mesa i mesnih proizvoda. Tvrtka je prepoznata po kvaliteti proizvoda, modernoj proizvodnji te razvijenoj mreži vlastitih mesnica diljem Hrvatske. Kako bismo osigurali nesmetan tijek robe, sigurno skladištenje i očuvanje kvalitete naših proizvoda od zaprimanja do otpreme, kontinuirano unaprjeđujemo naše skladišno poslovanje te tražimo odgovornu i organiziranu osobu koja će svojim radom pridonijeti pouzdanom upravljanju skladištem. Postanite dio našeg tima i prijavite se za poziciju:

Voditelj skladišta (m/ž)

Opis posla

  • organizacija i koordinacija cjelokupnog rada skladišta, uključujući zaprimanje, skladištenje, manipulaciju, pakiranje i otpremu robe
  • osiguravanje pravilnog skladištenja i očuvanja kvalitete robe te nadzor hladnog lanca, sljedivosti i rokova trajanja
  • provedba i nadzor primjene HACCP sustava i integriranog sustava upravljanja (ISU)
  • vođenje i kontrola skladišne dokumentacije, uključujući ulazne i izlazne dokumente te evidencije skladišnog poslovanja
  • organizacija, koordinacija i praćenje rada skladišnih djelatnika, uključujući raspored radnih zadataka i evidenciju radnog vremena
  • svakodnevna suradnja s ostalim odjelima radi osiguravanja pravovremenog i učinkovitog odvijanja poslovnih procesa

  • Uvjeti

  • srednja, viša ili visoka stručna sprema
  • najmanje 2 godine radnog iskustva na sličnim poslovima, poželjno u prehrambenoj industriji
  • poznavanje HACCP sustava i zahtjeva higijene hrane
  • iskustvo u organizaciji i vođenju tima
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu i iskustvo u vođenju skladišne dokumentacije
  • izražene organizacijske i komunikacijske vještine, odgovornost i samostalnost u radu

jobs.description: Na temelju članka 12. Statuta Sveučilišta Jurja Dobrile u Puli, a sukladno članku 24. st. 1. Pravilnika o raspisivanju i provedbi javnih natječaja za zapošljavanje na službenička i namještenička radna mjesta, rektor Sveučilišta Jurja Dobrile u Puli prof. dr. sc. Marinko Škare, raspisuje NATJEČAJ za izbor zaposlenika na radno mjesto IV. vrste – pomoćni radnik u Odsjeku za tehničko održavanje i pomoćne poslove na određeno vrijeme u trajanju od 7 mjeseci, u punom radnom vremenu – 1 izvršitelj (m/ž), uz obvezni probni rad u trajanju od jedan (1) mjesec; Uvjeti: - završena osmogodišnja osnovna škola - posjedovanje vozačke dozvole B kategorije Opis poslova: obavlja fizičke poslove (popravci, košnja trave, grabljanje lišća, zalijevanje biljaka, ličenje zidova, zamjene žarulja, montiranje i skidanje zavjesa, vješanje i premještanje slika i dr., montaža namještaja i dr.), pregledava zgrade prilikom otvaranja i zatvaranja, pregledava napuštene prostore Sveučilišta, obavlja poslove vozača te prevozi zaposlenike Sveučilišta i vanjske suradnike, prema nalogu nadređenih, pomaže pri organizaciji događanja, predavanja, sastanaka i drugih aktivnosti na Sveučilištu, prikuplja, sortira i distribuira dokumente i poštu unutar i izvan Sveučilišta, zadužen je za dostavu pošte i internih dokumenata po zgradama Sveučilišta, zadužen je za pregled, otvaranje i zatvaranje svih zgrada i prostorija, utvrđuje da li su zgrade ispravno zaključane, brine o sigurnosti, uključuje i isključuje alarmne sustave, provjerava sve prozore po zgradama i općenito brine o sigurnosti zgrada, komunicira sa nadležnom službom za sigurnost održavanja objekata, kosi travu i brine o održavanju zelenih površina oko sveučilišnih objekata, brine o održavanju, urednosti i čistoći okoliša i vanjskih prostora sveučilišnih objekata, brine o urednom odlaganju i sortiranju otpada, pomaže u održavanju čistoće i urednosti radnih prostora, hodnika i zajedničkih prostorija, prevozi i premješta materijal, knjige, opremu, namještaj i ostali inventar unutar zgrada Sveučilišta te izvan Sveučilišta, izvodi i ostale fizičke poslove prema uputama nadređenih te obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu tajnika Sveučilišta i voditelja Odsjeka za tehničko održavanje i pomoćne poslove. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj pristupnici su obvezni priložiti: a) životopis b) preslik svjedodžbe c) presliku važeće vozačke dozvole B kategorije d) dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika osobne iskaznice, putovnice, domovnice ili elektronički zapis iz knjige državljana) e) dokaz o radnom iskustvu (elektronički zapis ili potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje („ispis staža“) iz koje je razvidan poslodavac, trajanje staža osiguranja, stvarna i potrebna stručna sprema ili potvrda poslodavca odnosno druga isprava (preslik ugovora o radu, rješenja i sl.) iz koje je vidljivo u kojoj struci, na kojim poslovima i u kojem trajanju je ostvareno radno iskustvo. Napominjemo da se ne dostavlja potvrda Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o plaći.), ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja f) uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak, ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja Pristupnici se primaju u radni odnos uz probni rad u trajanju od jedan mjesec. Navedene isprave i prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici na hrvatskom jeziku i latiničnom pismu. Na natječaj se pod ravnopravnim uvjetima imaju pravo javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na oba spola. Pristupnici koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu na natječaj pored navedenih isprava odnosno priloga dostaviti potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz kojeg je vidljivo spomenuto pravo. Pristupnici ostvaruju prednost prilikom zapošljavanja u odnosu na ostale pristupnike, samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Za pristupnike koji se u prijavi na natječaj pozivaju na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja prema Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), popis dokaza potreban za ostvarivanje tog prava dostupan je na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/userdocsimages/ng/12%20prosinac/zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20pri%20zapo%C5%A0ljavanju.pdf Za pristupnike koji se u prijavi na natječaj pozivaju na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja prema Zakonu o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine br. 84/21) popis dokaza potreban za ostvarivanje tog prava dostupan je na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Za pristupnike prijavljene na javni natječaj koji podnesu pravovremenu i urednu prijavu te ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja provest će se intervju. O vremenu i mjestu održavanja intervjua pristupnici će biti pravodobno obaviješteni. Ako pristupnik ne pristupi intervjuu smatrat će se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj. Sveučilište zadržava pravo ne izvršiti izbor niti jednog pristupnika na natječaj. Urednom prijavom smatra se vlastoručno potpisana prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj o čemu joj se dostavlja pisana obavijest. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Na temelju članka 12. Zakona o plaćama u državnoj službi i javnim službama (Narodne novine br. 155/23) osnovnu plaću čini umnožak koeficijenta za obračun plaće radnog mjesta na koje je službenik i namještenik raspoređen i osnovice za obračun plaće. Člankom 18. Zakona utvrđen je dodatak za radni staž koji iznosi 0,5% na osnovnu plaću za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža. Osnovica za izračun plaće za zaposlenike u javnim službama određena je Odlukom o visini osnovice za obračun plaće u javnim službama u 2026. godini koju je Vlada RH donijela 30. siječnja 2026. godine, te od 1. travnja 2026. godine osnovica iznosi 1.015,00 eura bruto. Koeficijent složenosti poslova radnog mjesta suradnik sukladno Uredbi o nazivima radnih mjesta, uvjetima za raspored i koeficijentima za obračun plaće u javnim službama (Narodne novine br. 22/24) iznosi 1,06. Prijavom na natječaj, pristupnici natječaja su izričito suglasni da Sveučilište Jurja Dobrile u Puli kao voditelj zbirke osobnih podataka može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka, u skladu s nacionalnim propisima i internim aktima o zaštiti osobnih podataka, osiguravajući pravilnost postupanja s tim podacima na strani svih osoba kojima će na zakonitoj osnovi biti omogućen pristup podacima što uključuje njihovo korištenje isključivo u zakonite svrhe i ni na koji način koji bi se mogao smatrati suprotnim interesima pristupnika. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 (osam) dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama Sveučilišta i službenim internet stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Prijave s prilozima podnose se osobno ili putem preporučene pošte u rektorat Sveučilišta Jurja Dobrile u Puli, Zagrebačka 30, 52100 Pula (1.kat Odsjek za upravljanje ljudskim resursima s naznakom "Za natječaj" uz navođenje naziva radnog mjesta). Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka biti će objavljena na mrežnim stranicama Sveučilišta. Rektor prof.dr.sc. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj) samoupravi te sljedeće posebne uvjete: •sveučilišni ili stručni prvostupnik tehničke, biotehničke, društvene ili humanističke struke •najmanje tri godine radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima •položen državni stručni ispit •poznavanje rada na računalu •aktivno poznavanje jednog stranog jezika •položen vozački ispit za B kategoriju vozila. U službu ne može biti primljena osoba kod koje postoje zapreke prijema u službu propisane člancima 15. i 16. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj) samoupravi. 2. Osoba se prima u službu na neodređeno vrijeme u punom radnom vremenu, uz probni rok od 3 mjeseca. 3. Na natječaj se, pod jednakim uvjetima, imaju pravo javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u ovom javnom pozivu za osobe u muškom rodu uporabljeni su neutralno i odnose se na muške i ženske osobe. 4. Opis poslova i podaci o plaći radnog mjesta koje se popunjava javnim natječajem, način obavljanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti kandidata i iz kojeg područja te pravni i drugi izvori za pripremanje kandidata za provjeru navedeni su na web-stranici Općine Motovun-Montona: www.motovun.hr. 5. Kandidati koji imaju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po posebnom zakonu, obvezni su se pri prijavi na oglas pozvati se na to pravo, uzevši u obzir da imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, kandidat koji ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje tog prava, dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i rješenje o priznatom statusu, odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka i slično) te dokaz da je nezaposlen (uvjerenje ili evidencijski list Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje). Pod jednakim uvjetima podrazumijeva se da na kraju provedenog pisanog testiranja kandidata i provedenog intervjua s kandidatima, kandidati koji su po rang-listi ostvarili najveći i isti broj ukupnih bodova, prednost pri zapošljavanju ima onaj kandidat koji se u svojoj prijavi pozvao na to pravo i dokazao ga. 6. Uz pisanu prijavu na natječaj obvezno se prilaže: 1.životopis, 2.dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (domovnica ili osobna iskaznica), 3.dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi (diploma odnosno odgovarajuća isprava o stečenom stupnju obrazovanja), 4.dokaz o ukupnom radnom stažu (elektronički zapis - potvrda o podacima evidentiranima u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, koja sadrži podatke o poslodavcu, osnovi osiguranja, početku i prestanku osiguranja, radnom vremenu, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi te trajanju staža osiguranja), 5.uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni i istražni postupak, ne starije od 3 mjeseca (članak 15. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj) samoupravi), 6.dokaz o položenom državnom stručnom ispitu, ako ima, 7.vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu da za prijam u službu ne postoje zapreke iz članaka 15. i 16. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj) samoupravi (izjavu nije potrebno ovjeriti), 8.presliku vozačke dozvole, 9.dokaz o poznavanju rada na računalu (svjedodžba, potvrda, vlastoručno pisana izjava i slično). Svi navedeni dokumenti mogu biti dostavljeni u preslici, a nakon prijma u službu izabrani kandidat/kandidatkinja dostavlja tražene dokumente u izvorniku ili ovjerenoj preslici. Uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti dostavlja izabrani kandidat, a prije donošenja rješenja o prijemu na rad. 7. Na mrežnoj stranici Općine Motovun-Montona (www.motovun.hr) dostupan je opis poslova te podaci o plaći radnog mjesta koje se popunjava, kao i podaci o prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti kandidata te ostale informacije o natječajnom postupku. 8. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadržava sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepravovremena i neuredna prijava na natječaj neće se razmatrati niti će podnositelj nepotpune prijave biti pozvan na dopunu prijave. Osoba koja podnese nepravovremenu ili neurednu prijavu na natječaj ili ne ispunjava uvjete natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj. 9. Podnošenjem prijave na javni natječaj smatra se da je kandidat suglasan da se podaci iz dokumentacije obrađuju i koriste isključivo u svrhu provedbe javnog natječaja te da se objavljuju na službenoj mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Općine Motovun-Montona. Natječajni postupak obuhvaća obvezatnu provjeru znanja i sposobnosti kandidata. Prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti kandidata mogu pristupiti samo kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Na mrežnoj stranici (www.motovun.hr) i oglasnoj ploči Općine Motovun-Montona objavit će se vrijeme održavanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti kandidata, najmanje pet dana prije održavanja provjere. Ako kandidat ne pristupi provjeri, smatrat će se da povlači prijavu na javni natječaj. 10. Prijave na natječaj s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta podnose se u roku od 8 dana od objave natječaja u Narodnim novinama, s naznakom: „Prijava na natječaj za radno mjesto - Stručni suradnik - ne otvaraj“, na adresu: Općina Motovun-Montona, HR-52424 Motovun-Montona, Anticov trg 1. 11. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku od 60 dana od isteka roka za podnošenje prijava. Ako se na javni natječaj ne prijave osobe koje ispunjavaju propisane i objavljene uvjete odnosno ako prijavljeni kandidati ne zadovolje na testiranju, pročelnik će obustaviti postupak po ovom natječaju.

jobs.title: PRIPRAVNIK ZA HOTELSKE REZERVACIJE I PRODAJU PUTOVANJA (M/Ž)
jobs.description:
Voliš putovanja i hotele? Započni karijeru u turizmu s nama! Pripravnik za hotelske rezervacije i prodaju putovanja (m/ž) 📍 Sesvete, Zagreb | Puno radno vrijeme | 1.500 EUR bruto 1 Završio/la si školovanje u turizmu i tražiš svoj prvi posao u struci? U Konturama tražimo novu osobu koju ćemo naučiti kako funkcioniraju hotelske rezervacije, prodaja turističkih aranžmana i savjetovanje gostiju. Naši gosti traže sve, od obiteljskog odmora na moru do wellness vikenda ili posebne ponude za godišnji odmor. Naš je posao razumjeti što žele, pronaći im odgovarajući hotel i pobrinuti se da rezervacija prođe bez komplikacija. A upravo to želimo naučiti tebe. Što ćeš raditi? Tvoj posao bit će prvenstveno vezan uz hotelske rezervacije i prodaju aranžmana domaćim gostima. U početku ćeš uz pomoć kolega učiti kako:
  • Pronaći hotel i aranžman koji najbolje odgovara željama i budžetu gosta.
  • Provjeravati cijene, raspoloživost i uvjete rezervacije.
  • Pripremati i slati ponude te komunicirati s gostima.
  • Dogovarati i potvrđivati rezervacije s hotelima.
  • Voditi rezervacijsku dokumentaciju i pratiti rezervacije do realizacije.
  • Rješavati upite, izmjene i posebne zahtjeve gostiju.
Kako budeš stjecao/la iskustvo, postupno ćeš preuzimati sve više odgovornosti, samostalno savjetovati goste i voditi vlastite rezervacije. Važno je znati: Ovo je uredski posao koji uključuje puno rada za računalom, e-mailova, telefonskih razgovora i administracije. Ali ako voliš turizam, organizaciju i komunikaciju s ljudima, iza svakog upita krije se novi izazov. Koga tražimo? Ne očekujemo prethodno iskustvo u turističkoj agenciji. Tražimo osobu koja ima volju naučiti posao i koja:
  • Ima odgovarajuće završeno obrazovanje i ispunjava uvjete HZZ-ove mjere pripravništva.
  • Dobro se snalazi na računalu, brzo i točno tipka.
  • Jasno, pristojno i gramatički ispravno komunicira.
  • Dobro poznaje engleski jezik.
  • Organizirana je, odgovorna i obraća pozornost na detalje.
  • Voli raditi s ljudima, snalaziti se u različitim situacijama i pronalaziti rješenja.
  • Pokazuje inicijativu i želi napredovati.
Što ti nudimo?
  • Početnu plaću od 1.500 EUR bruto 1.
  • Mentorstvo i postupno uvođenje u posao.
  • Priliku da upoznaš hotelsku ponudu Hrvatske i regije.
  • Praktično znanje o prodaji, rezervacijama i organizaciji putovanja.
  • Rad u manjem timu u kojem ćeš moći učiti od iskusnih kolega.
  • Mogućnost dugoročnog zaposlenja i profesionalnog napredovanja.
Kako se prijaviti? Pošalji nam svoj životopis i napiši nekoliko rečenica o sebi i tome zašto želiš raditi u turizmu. Ne tražimo iskustvo. Tražimo odgovornost, znatiželju i želju da postaneš dobar u svom poslu.
